[list][*]Black Market has been improved.[/*][/list]
[quote]Our priority is to prevent and fix errors related to the Black Market and newly applied features, and to ensure their stability.

Therefore, the Costume Combo Sales feature, originally scheduled to be implemented along with the Black Market improvement, has been postponed.

A separate notice will be made when the Costume Combo Sales feature is implemented in the future. We sincerely apologize for not being able to update according to the previously announced schedule.[/quote]

[h3][b]▶ Event Overview[/b][/h3]

[table][tr][td]
[b]What are [Firecracker]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*][Firecracker] is an event item that is only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period and can be acquired from both the Cash Shop and in-game.[/*][*]Using [Firecracker] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are [Festival Points]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*][Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points has been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival] Server Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The[b] [/b]Server Buff[b] [/b]applies buff effects to all players and all characters.[/*][*]The Server Buff is stacked up to level 10 and will give better buff effects as the level goes up.[/*][*]All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival Gift] Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The Buff is acquired when using Cash Shop Firework (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, Wildhüter, and Rattus)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are some other benefits?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]Collect ‘Fireworks Event Souvenirs’ every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain the Troubleshooter outfit (B type) and other exclusive rewards![/*][*]The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards![/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What determines the ranks?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The ranking is determined by the accumulation of [Festival Points] attributed to each character, with rewards allocated to Ranks 1 through 5.[/*][*]The Dragon Chair for Rank 1–3 is a newly introduced visual item.[/*][/list]

notes.title: [GM Note] Together, We Go Further! PD Leadership Update!
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today, I would like to share an important announcement with all Agents.

In order to provide long-term service for Closers and to strengthen our communication with all Agents, we are pleased to inform you of an update to our PD leadership.

PD Hyun-Jun Kang who is currently managing Closers will oversee the overall management. In addition, a new PD has joined the Closers project to further support and enhance the game's direction.

With both PDs now working together, Closers will continue to develop in a more positive direction, with increased communication and engagement with all Agents.

Accordingly, we have conducted an interview with each PD to address the questions you may have.

We are pleased to now share their responses with you.
Shall we begin?


[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]▶ Interview with PD Hyun-Jun Kang[/b][/color][/h3]

[b]Q. Over the past two years, you’ve overseen many updates as the dedicated PD of Closers. To what extent do you feel your initial goals have been achieved?[/b]

A. When I first assumed the role of PD for Closers, my top priority was “optimization.”
As the game had been live for many years, various efforts had been made to enhance the environment—such as transitioning to 64-bit, supporting 120 FPS, and upgrading to DirectX 11. However, these improvements had sometimes led to unintended issues, including frame drops and performance degradation.

With that in mind, I firmly believed that establishing a stable and seamless environment should come first.
I would say that approximately 85% of the goals I set have been achieved over the past two years.

Another objective was to revitalize the narrative flow among the teams.
To that end, we actively developed new characters and made considerable efforts to integrate them naturally into the existing teams—for example, characters such as Ria Yoon and Triss. I'm grateful that many Agents responded positively to these additions.


[b]Q. There have been various updates, including Break Challenge, new characters, raids, and QoL improvements. What were the guiding principles behind these decisions?[/b]

A. Rather than following a rigid structure, I focused on identifying what was most needed at each point in time.
During summer and winter, we prioritized large-scale content, while spring and fall were typically dedicated to system improvements and quality-of-life updates.

At each stage, we carefully examined what the Agents most needed and what areas required enhancement, allowing us to determine the proper priorities. Thanks to this approach, each seasonal update took on its own unique characteristics.


[b]Q. Among the updates that have been released thus far, is there anything you found regrettable?[/b]

A. In our efforts to enhance the enjoyment of farming, we implemented various initiatives—one of which was Break Challenge: Fly King.

At the time, we wanted to introduce an element of randomness to break away from the monotony of existing farming structures. Additionally, we sought to reinterpret existing raid bosses in new ways to offer a fresh combat experience.

However, in hindsight, we recognize that this approach may not have aligned with the expectations of our Agents. The random nature without guaranteed drops, and the lack of intuitive combat patterns, ultimately caused inconvenience. I feel bad that we were not able to fully deliver the enjoyment we had intended.


[b]Q. On a different note—could you tell us a bit about the newly joining PD?[/b]

A. The new PD has a wealth of experience operating a wide range of games, having worked with our company for many years. Most importantly, he has a genuine affection and passion for Closers.

With his diverse background, he brings a fresh perspective and new approaches. I firmly believe he will offer new enjoyment and improved experiences for our Agents. As I continue to oversee overall management, I will work closely with him and share insights to ensure consistent quality going forward.

I kindly ask for your warm support and encouragement for our newly joined PD.

 
[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]▶ Interview with PD Lee Hyun Soo[/b][/color][/h3]

[b]Q. You seem like a familiar face. Could you please introduce yourself briefly?[/b]

A. Greetings. My name is Lee Hyunsoo, and I have recently joined Closers as its sixth PD.
It has now been over seven years since I joined NADDIC Games. Although I officially became part of the Closers team around May of this year, I had already been observing the project and the work of previous PDs closely in the company.

While I am no longer active in broadcasting area, there may be some who recognize me from occasional appearances on game-related broadcasts. If, by unfortunate algorithmic recommendation, my face happened to reach your screen, I extend my apologies for any visual inconvenience caused.


[b]Q. How do you feel about stepping into the role of PD following PD Hyun Jun Kang?[/b]

A. I feel a great sense of responsibility.

“Sixth.”

The fact that the number has increased by one may seem trivial, but it carries significant weight. Of course, the number itself is not as important as the role it signifies. I hope to serve as a “Bridge”, maintaining the positive legacy built by the previous PDs while also steadily addressing areas for improvement. Rather than declaring a complete overhaul, I intend to take a thoughtful approach—focusing on consistent improvement and advancement based on the foundation that has already been established.


[b]Q. Have you been playing Closers since the beginning?[/b]

A. Closers is a title I have followed since its early development phase. Although circumstances led to it being serviced by another publisher at the time, I continued to observe its progress with interest. After joining NADDIC Games, I became even more closely involved with the project. There was a brief period when I had to step away due to other responsibilities, but I have since returned and am now fully dedicated to the project.


[b]Q. Which characters are you currently playing?[/b]

A. While I do play all characters, I currently focus primarily on five:
Yuri, Triss, Mistel, Lucy, and Ria.


[b]Q. Many Agents may feel uncertain due to the leadership change. Will this shift in PD result in any significant changes to update schedules or overall direction?[/b]
A. While the change may appear sudden from the perspective of our Agents, I have in fact been working alongside PD Kang prior to formally taking on the role, sharing in decision-making as part of the transition process. Both PD Kang and I have placed strong emphasis on striking a balance between continuity and change. 

Major scheduled updates will proceed as planned, without significant alterations. In between, we intend to introduce improvements to outdated systems where necessary. 

In particular, we are committed to responding promptly to ongoing concerns raised by our Agents—such as service stability and suggestions regarding update content. While we recognize that there may still be room for improvement, we are actively gathering feedback across various channels and will do our best to address it accordingly. We ask for your continued patience and support as we move forward.


[b]Q. Were there any aspects of Closers you personally hoped to improve upon once you became PD?[/b]

A. One of my medium- to long-term goals is to move beyond repetitive gameplay loops, such as “Xue/Triss/Gildal” or “Dogra/Magra/Integrated Farming Dungeon,” and instead create spaces and moments where Agents can truly enjoy staying within the game. In addition, as the service lifespan of Closers grows longer, we have seen a gradual decline in accessibility for new and returning Agents. I aim to explore ways to open up these entry points once again. Of course, no single solution can address everything. Therefore, I hope to experiment with various approaches and remain open to strong feedback if our direction ever diverges from expectations. Our Agents’ voices will serve as the foundation for growth and positive change.


[b]Q. There are a few updates that were previously announced but have yet to be implemented—for example, the Crew Leader Delegation system and bundled costume sales. What is the current status of these items?[/b]

A. These features have not been abandoned. They remain on our list of pending development tasks. We fully understand that many Agents are awaiting these updates and have expressed their opinions regarding them. Although their implementation has been delayed due to a focus on service stability, we will make every effort to resume development and apply them as soon as possible. 
Given that Closers is a title that has been developed over many years and by many hands, certain changes—even minor ones—can produce unexpected ripple effects. Some delays arise from the need to introduce new systems while also ensuring overall stability. That said, we recognize the importance of keeping our Agents informed and offering transparency about the status of such developments. We will work to not only deliver quality content, but also to communicate more frequently with you—sharing our thoughts and development progress more openly and regularly.


[b]Q. Do you have any unique strategies or approaches to further revitalize Closers?[/b]

A. First and foremost, we are preparing a space and time in which we can actively listen to the voices of our Agents. While we are still finalizing the schedule and format, we plan to hold a session where feedback can be heard in real time—or as close to it as possible. We will provide detailed information regarding the schedule and method in the near future.


[b]Q. Could you share your vision or any final message for the Agents of Closers?[/b]

A. This coming winter, Closers will celebrate its 11th anniversary, launching in Korea. While it may sound cliché, our development team—including PD Hyun Jun Kang as the overall manager—will continue to unite our efforts in order to ensure that Closers remains a game you can enjoy with satisfaction not only now, but all the way to its 20th anniversary and beyond.

Thank you for your continued support.

Today, we have shared interviews with PD Lee Hyun Soo, who has newly joined Closers, and PD Hyun-Jun Kang, who will continue to oversee overall management.

Lastly, both PDs have each written a special message for all Closers Agents.
 
Please click the link below to read their letters:
[list][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/developer-s-letter-hyun-jun-kang-WHJnIe1493][b]PD Hyun-Jun Kang’s Developer's Letter[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/developer-s-letter-pd-lee-hyun-soo-4dsn331494][b]PD Lee Hyun Soo’s Developer's Letter[/b][/url][/*][/list]
To commemorate the appointment of the new PD, we are pleased to provide a special reward to all Agents.

We look forward to your continued interest and support as Closers strives to grow and communicate more closely with all Agents.

Thank you.

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Raid Entry System[/b][/color]
[list][*]A new [Raid Entry System] has been added starting with the new raid.[/*][*]While in a party, the leader can access the Dungeon Entry System from the Dungeon Entry NPC or the ‘Unified Entry System.’[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Raid Theme Select Window[/b][/color]
[list][*]Left click the Form Raid button to display the Raid theme select window.[/*][*]You can only enter the Raid when you are in a party.[/*][*]Only the party leader can initiate raid entry.[/*][*]If the entry requirements are not met, a message will appear stating you cannot enter the raid, along with the name of the required mission.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Raid Status Board[/b][/color]
[list][*]The leader can use the Dungeon Status Board to select a dungeon, check party information, and view active effects and dungeon details.[/*][*]The Raid Status Board can be closed using the [X] button on the right side of the status window or the [ESC] key. Chat and other functions are available in town.[/*][*]Leaving the squad will immediately remove you from the raid party and close the Raid Status Board.[/*][*]Only the leader can use the [Forfeit Raid] button. When the leader gives up the raid, then the raid will end immediately, but the party will remain intact.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Raid Status Board - Squad Info[/b][/color]
[list][*]Displays character names and TCP of the members.[/*][*]Right clicking the character area in the Squad Info window will display related details.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Raid Status Board - Select Dungeon[/b][/color]
[list][*]Effect will be disappear from the dungeon where already cleared once. [/*][*]A buff icon will appear below the name of any dungeon that provides a buff.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Raid Status Board - Active Effects[/b][/color]
[list][*]Displays the buff obtained after clearing the specified buff dungeon.[/*][*]Shows the total values of all acquired buffs.[/*][*]Buff effects shown under ‘Active Effects’ apply only to the current dungeon in progress.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Raid Status Board - Dungeon Info[/b][/color]
[list][*]Displays the selected dungeon’s name, recommended TCP, dungeon type, Bonus REWARD count, and gear level.[/*][/list]

notes.title: July 9th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Characters[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. 1st Skill System Revamp[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Skill system has been revamped.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Skill Point Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Character lv. specific Skill Points are applied to all characters regardless of the character’s current SP.
[*] All characters now receive 3 Skill Points for each level increase.
[*] All characters receive 5 Skill Points for each 10 level increase. (i.e. At lv.10, lv.20... lv.90)
[*] Skill Points granted every 10 levels will not be distributed together with Skill Upgrade Points.
※ It will be 303 Skill Points when the character reaches lv.95.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Active Skill Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Active Skills no longer consume Skill Points directly.
[*] Skills are now learned automatically based on Promotion requirement and level.
[*] [Support] skill items are no longer consumed. Skills will be automatically learned once the requirements are met.
[*] All eligible skills will auto-level when the character levels up.
[*] Skills eligible for EX conversion will be automatically converted.
[*] The passive learning requirement has been removed from the 5th Skill's learning requirement.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Passive Skill Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Polish Passive Skills remain unchanged and are still optional to use.
[*] Passive Skills remain unchanged and levels can still be adjusted.
[*] Character specific Passive Skills no longer consume Skill Points to level up.
[*] 5th Passive Skill level is no longer adjustable, stat increase is now fixed at the current max level.
※ All Passive Skill Points will be reset after the update. Please redistribute them accordingly.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Skill Ticket Item Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] Skill Tickets are no longer usable following the skill system revamp. 'Unusable' has been added to the item description.
[*] Skill tickets have been discontinued from the UNION Store.
[*] The following methods are no longer available to acquire Skill Tickets:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bc0589ee90de3259e8f5ab077aa111dca9db88da.png[/img][/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ UI Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list][*] [Skill Reset] check box in the Active Skill tab: the [EX] and [Master] buttons are no longer displayed.
[*] In Skill Tip descriptions, the requirements for already fulfilled conditions are no longer displayed.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Additional Notes on the UI Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list][*] Active skills are now automatically sorted by learning order in the character’s skill window.
[*] A notification will be displayed when a new skill is learned through upgrading.
[*] A notification will be displayed when a learned skill is upgraded.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]New Contents[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Integrated Farming Dungeon[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Introduced the ‘Integrated Farming Dungeon’.
[*] Collectable items such as Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residues etc can be acquired in the ‘Integrated Farming Dungeon’.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Entering the Integrated Farming Dungeon[/b][/color]
[list][*] Complete the [Triumph] Mission in the [Scenery Beyond the Gate] episode with character Lv 95 or higher, and you can enter the dungeon via <Unified Entry System>.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Integrated Farming Dungeon Details[/b][/color]
[list][*] You can enter each dungeon via <Unified Entry System> and acquire different rewards in each dungeon.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/eef3c41d4896ef9b435feda18b0dadfd844f5630.png[/img]


[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Available Rewards[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f15a66143ddf5588dcd230c6807a6f29aef27ca5.png[/img]

[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Additional Details[/b][/color]
[list][*] Certain dungeon rewards have been removed due to the introduction of the Integrated Farming Dungeon.
[list][*] The following dungeon rewards & PNA EXP have been removed:[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60302a13efe8bf05d4307056d7fb70cd12556c2b.png[/img]

[list][*] Certain drop rewards listed above have been transferred to the Integrated Farming Dungeon reward pool.
[*] With the removal of certain material acquisition methods, related crafting recipes and upgrade materials will be adjusted.
※ The current crafting recipes will be removed in the future. A separate notice will be issued before removal.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bb491851c270a99edf01c4d25b7dac0e8b9b2f49.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Systems[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Matter Mixer Update[/b][/color]
[list][*] Matter Mixer has been updated.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Material Item Search[/b][/color]
[list][*] Introduced a new material item search feature.
[*] You can toggle the [Material Item Search] button at the top left to enable or disable the [Material Item Search] feature.
[*] With [Material Item Search] enabled, you can search for a material in the search window to view the items that can be crafted with it.
[*] With [Material Item Search] disabled, it functions the same way as the current Matter Mixer.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Selecting Inventory Item Search[/b][/color]
[list][*] With [Material Item Search] enabled, it will enable the Inventory Item Search feature.
[*] With [Material Item Search] enabled, left-clicking a selected item in your inventory will search for the material by its item name.
[*] A “No search result” pop-up will appear when no matching results are found.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Additional Notes on the Matter Mixer Update[/b][/color]
[list][*] The contents of the Matter Mixer Guide have been modified and removed to reflect adjustments.
[*] The Matter Mixer overall UI has been revamped to reflect the latest update.
[*] [Crafting time] has been removed in the Matter Mixer UI and replaced with [Crafting Item Expiry].[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Entry Limit for Each Character[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Entry counts for each character have been applied to dungeons that previously had account-based entry limits.
[*] e.g. If a dungeon has 6 weekly entries, the entry count per character is 2 — at least 3 characters are required to use all 6 entries.
※ Entry count per character currently applies to ‘Integrated Farming Dungeons’ and will be expanded to other dungeons in the future.
[*] Move the mouse over the top of a character’s Entry Limit to view which characters are eligible to enter the dungeon.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Chip Crafting Recipe Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Chip crafting recipes have been adjusted following the introduction of the Integrated Farming Dungeon.
[*] The following crafting recipes have been removed:[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6f553cc33c6a8d4d3cde21876488495bb2203024.png[/img]
[list][*] The new recipes are listed as follow:[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dd897bcaee1aece5eccb4cdcc666703654a7a567.png[/img]

[list][*] The following recipes have been adjusted:[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1f0a5a96f46ce6e0a4aff22bfc53335a197dd228.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Added Awakening Cube Crafting Recipes[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Added character’s awakening cube crafting recipes to the Matter Mixer.
[*] Awakening Cubes can be crafted by consuming 1m Credits.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Added a New Dungeon Feature to confirm Shared Entry Limits[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Move the mouse over the upper area of the Confirm Dungeon Entry Account / Character, the dungeon name will be displayed if a Shared Entry Count dungeon exists.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/95e4cbc4cf601948f8669a88d01933c17e047ddf.png[/img]

[h3][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/new-extra-first-drop-acquire-celebration-event-ALpOzF1406][b]1. New Extra First Drop Acquire Celebration Event[/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: [Developer Diary] Quick Evasion Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today, we're back with a new type of content called the “Developer Diary,” which we introduced in the May 2025 Developer Letter to foster closer communication with all Agents.

Our first topic is the behind-the-scenes story of the Quick Evasion improvements.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]0. About Quick Evasion[/b][/color][/h3]
 
Agents, what do you think about Quick Evasion?

At present, it's usable even in midair, and it's seeing more frequent use thanks to its ability to counter Gewurah’s mechanics and synergize with Hetero Genes that grant additional benefits.

But before the overhaul, Quick Evasion felt lacking if it wasn’t equipped, yet awkward to actually use when needed.

Even when it seemed like the right time to use Quick Evasion, it was often more effective to use an invincibility skill or an ultimate move to bypass the pattern instead.

So, how did this ambiguous skill turn into the improved Quick Evasion we have now?

Let’s find out.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. The Beginning of Quick Evasion Improvements[/b][/color][/h3]

“What if we improved the inconvenience of the current Quick Evasion and encouraged more frequent use? Wouldn’t that make combat feel more dynamic and action-packed?”

That’s where the idea began.

The first step was identifying the problems with the existing Quick Evasion system.

[b]■ Inconvenient because it couldn't be used in midair[/b]
[list][*]Many aerial skills exist, but Quick Evasion couldn't be used while airborne[/*][*]Being in the air often means using skills, but you couldn't use Quick Evasion while using a skill[/*][/list]
[b]■ High risk, little reward[/b]
[list][*]Successfully using Quick Evasion gave almost no benefit, while failure came with significant risk[/*][/list]
[b]■ Questionable value[/b]
[list][*]High risk, hard to use, and few rewards[/*][*]Other skills provided invincibility and let you attack at the same time, so there was little need to use it[/*][/list]
It was clear that Quick Evasion needed several improvements. Our first priority was to make it easier and more rewarding to use.

While considering what kind of improvements would enhance player convenience, we explored the idea of allowing Quick Evasion to be used in midair, and of granting greater rewards when it is successfully executed.

As such, we decided to first provide this convenience of midair usage and moved quickly into development.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Gewurah and Quick Evasion[/b][/color][/h3]

The Quick Evasion revamp began during the development discussions of the new boss “Gewurah” in the Limbo of Ignorance content.

Gewurah’s concept was crystal clear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a75677b3f34c9faf343c5411e9be6cb5b22321ef.png[/img]
[list][*]A battle maniac obsessed with fighting.[/*][*]Seeks out any strong opponent and fights them without hesitation.[/*][*]A wild, gladiator-like centaur.[/*][/list]
The first things that stood out in Gewurah’s concept art were the charging silhouette on all fours and the sharp, solid horns.

[i][b]“The art of combat lies not in fleeing, but in meeting your opponent head-on.”[/b][/i]

It reminded us of fierce Spartan warriors in film.

While discussing Gewurah’s development, an idea hit us.

[i]“What if, instead of dodging a charging monster with a movement or invincibility skill, players could execute a well-timed evasion to face the charge head-on?”[/i]

Picture a Closers character narrowly dodging a frontal charge with precise timing.

We envisioned players using Quick Evasion in that moment to make the dungeon more exciting.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Development of the Hetero Gene[/b][/color][/h3]
 
We designed Gewurah’s battle structure to match its personality and centaur design, emphasizing powerful charging attacks.

While developing this battle structure, our biggest challenge was creating a meaningful benefit for breaking its patterns.

Since players could already evade these charges using movement or invincibility skills, Quick Evasion needed a greater incentive.

We decided to introduce a clear reward system: [Fail the evasion = Gewurah powers up / Succeed = your character powers up.]

This way, instead of just dodging, players could feel the satisfaction of precisely breaking a pattern with Quick Evasion and being rewarded with more power.

To extend this rewarding feeling beyond Gewurah, we also looked at adding similar benefits to Hetero Genes.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Development of Midair Quick Evasion[/b][/color][/h3]

We returned to Quick Evasion with renewed focus of improving the existing problems.
Refining the skill was essential for implementing Gewurah’s pattern and the Hetero Gene.

The most critical problems were the inability to use it in midair and the inability to trigger it while using other skills.

Because Quick Evasion was originally designed for ground use, we improved it to make the skill available in the air.

We also expanded the skill cancel system so that Quick Evasion could smoothly cancel other skills in progress.

To make successful evasions more noticeable, we added a visual effect to “Just Evasion,” so players could clearly see when they pulled it off.

[table][tr][th]
Prototype 1 (Yellow Effect)
[/th][th]
Prototype 2 (Blue Effect)
[/th][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/30ce71bc013c0118695125604bdd536647326a6c.gif[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a265e12e2fd58b6cdfcd78c2ad74388bb11e3656.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
In the early concept, we considered two options for the Just Evasion effect color: yellow and blue.

[b]■ Blue Effect[/b]
[list][*]Matches many blue-tone world backgrounds (sky blue, navy, violet, etc.).[/*][*]Blends smoothly with other skill effects, providing visual stability.[/*][/list]
[b]■ Yellow Effect[/b]
[list][*]High visibility due to its brightness.[/*][*]A flashy effect that clearly says “You nailed the Just Evasion!”[/*][/list]
Although blue was the initial favorite due to familiarity, repeated testing swayed opinions toward yellow. It was ultimately selected for the final version.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Test Play[/b][/color][/h3]

Through multiple stages of planning and in-depth discussions, we completed the Quick Evasion improvements.

As with any feature, we test it before releasing, so we ran a test of the new Quick Evasion.

[table][tr][th]
Quick Evasion Test
[/th][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f34e9c65b1233945ede799414333d379d83ee4eb.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
Thanks to all the development steps and refinements, the test results were satisfying, and we were able to confidently present the revamped Quick Evasion to you.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. In Closing[/b][/color][/h3]

After a great deal of planning and discussion, Quick Evasion was first updated on June 11. With the addition of Gewurah in the June 25 update, Quick Evasion became even more widely used.

Despite many challenges in both planning and development, seeing how much you Agents enjoy the improved system has made it all worth it.

Every new feature requires careful planning and collaboration with many teams. It takes time, but thanks to your continued support, we can continue to move forward.

We will keep working hard to provide more convenience and exciting improvements for a better gameplay experience.

Thank you.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,    

The first phase of the Skill System Renewal is scheduled to be implemented on [b]July 9, 2025[/b].

In line with this update, the sale and acquisition of Skill Tickets will be fully discontinued. Additionally, any Skill Tickets currently in your possession will be changed to unusable items.

[i][b]Therefore, if you currently have any skill ticket items, please use them all up before the update on July 9, 2025 to avoid any inconvenience.[/b][/i]

Please refer to the detailed information below:

[color=#89CFF0][b]■ [Pre-Notice] Changes to Skill Tickets Due to Skill System Renewal[/b][/color]

[b]Schedule:[/b] After maintenance on July 9, 2025

[b]Details:[/b][list][*]Due to the skill system renewal, Skill Ticket items will become unusable.
※ After the update, Support Skills previously obtained via Skill Tickets will be automatically granted based on character level.[/*][*]Skill Ticket products will be removed from the shop.[/*][/list][*]The following sources will no longer provide Skill Tickets:[/*]
[color=#FFE135][b]Source[/b][/color]
[table][tr][td]

One-shot Growth Lv.95

[/td][td]

NPC shop

[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0][b]■ Other Notes[/b][/color]
[list][*] Skill Tickets in your inventory or storage will not be deleted.
[*] These items will be updated according to the new system.
[*] Further details on the renewal will be announced in upcoming notices.
[*] The schedule for the system update may change, so please stay tuned for future announcements.[/list]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/523831205fe9db127e6cd888bbcdaf695468ab22.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: [Updated] Known Issue Notice - March 19th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of the following issues that occurred after the March 19th patch update, which we are currently working on:

[list][*] [b]Missing Forum Photos[/b]
[list][*] Some uploaded photos in the Forums have gone missing after the recent website update. Our team is actively investigating this and will do our best to recover them soon.[/list]
[*] [b]Incorrect Tooltip on [April Fool] Dyeing Ampoule Lucky Pouch[/b]
[list][*] The tooltip is missing information about the Guaranteed Dyeing Ampoule. You can acquire 2~20 of Dyeing Ampoule or 1 Guaranteed Dyeing Ampoule.[/list]
[strike][*] [b]Payment Issue on Steam Platform[/b]
[list][*] We have identified an issue where N-coin charge on the Steam platform is currently not functional. Our team is investigating the cause and working to resolve this as quickly as possible.[/list]
[*] [b]Email-Related Functions Not Working at the Website[/b]
[list][*] Functions that require email sending, such as Create Account and Find Password, are not working correctly. We are aware of the issue and working to restore these functions.[/list][/strike][/list]
[color=#c3a3ff][b][Updated] Those two topics with strikethrough above are resolved as of Mar 19, 2025 07:20 AM UTC. [/b][/color]

notes.title: Pre-Notice: Pet Food Item Adjustments following Pet Stamina Removal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,    

We would like to inform you in advance about the change regarding Pet Food items, which will no longer be consumable following the removal of the Pet Stamina feature during the regular maintenance on April 16th. Please refer to the following details:

[color=#89CFF0][b]■ Notice: Pet Food Item Adjustments following Pet Stamina Removal[/b][/color]
[b]Schedule:[/b] During maintenance on Apr 16th, 2025
[b]Details[/b]
[list][*] Pet Food items will no longer consumable following the removal of the Pet Stamina feature.
[*] Methods to exchange Pet Food for other items will be added.
[*] The following methods will no longer available for Pet Food item acquisition:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/489275d43a87a7a9e6141d57e3f7b6a29201f889.png[/img][/list]
[b]Reference[/b]
[list][*] Pet Food items will no longer be offered as future event rewards.
[*] We will issue another announcement to explain further details on Item Exchange Method and Adjustments in the future Update Patch Notes notice.
[*] Pet food items will be discontinued in UNION Store Sales and Everyday Transmitter.[/list]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

Reaching a certain score allows you to claim rewards.
Added Dungeon Skills. After using Dungeon Skills, it provides instant recovery buff for MP 100% and reset all skills cooldown besides Ultimate Skills.
Gain points given to each monster after defeating monsters in the Legion Program
After defeating monsters within the time limit and gaining points, you will be rewarded according to the number of your accumulated points.
Dungeon clear will be counted when the dungeon timer expires
The following rewards up to the accumulated points will be dropped from the dungeon:
Common Shop – Added 2 types of Legion Program items
Expand PNA Mutant level, added manifestation body
Max. Mutant level expanded from 75 > 100
Manifestation body slots expanded from 15 > 45

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/80cd3c27fe6029acb9b2be2bd060a6e979ac8456.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that a temporary server maintenance will be conducted to resolve the Event Shop Exchange error, where some items were counted as exchanged even though they were not yet claimed.

Please refer to the schedule by time zone:
[list][*] UTC: November 20, 2024 from 12:00 PM to [strike]1:00 PM[/strike] 12:50 PM

[*] GMT+7: November 20, 2024 from 7:00 PM to [strike]8:00 PM[/strike] 7:50 PM[/list]
We appreciate your patience and apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

Additionally, we will offer a compensation package for this temporary maintenance during the next scheduled server maintenance.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url]

[b]support@closersonline.com[/b]

notes.title: November 20th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Character Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some characters' skill balance have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Character: Bai, Lucy, Aeri
[*] Character's some skill tooltip and option have been changed.
[*] Character's some skill coefficients have been adjusted. 
[list][*] Skill Remake Details[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0c34d7a6332a6bf288ba5c0b92b61f37d2bdbcc6.png[/img][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Black Market Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Black Market Search System has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] When clicking on each tab in the Black Market, the display method has been improved so that the color of the tab you are currently viewing changes.
[*] The ‘Character’ filter has been added to the <Detailed Settings> of the Costume and Accessory category in the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs.
[*] In the Accessory category, the ‘Character’ filter can only search ‘All’.
[*] The default filter settings for the Costume and Accessory category in the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs have been changed. [list][*] Rarity: All / Equipped Part: All / Character: All[/list][*] The ‘Favorites List’ button has been removed from areas other than the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs.
[*] When you click on the ‘Favorites List’ in the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs and move to the market or tab, the Favorites List will automatically close.
[*] The item type filter in the ‘All Search’ category in the [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market] item search tabs has been subdivided.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5e7f832bc8a0cb2781f0cb291316ee4675a2af27.png[/img][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The method of registering and purchasing Black Market items and displaying Purchase History has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*] When registering items for sale in [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market], the ‘Lowest Registration Price’ in each tab has been changed to be displayed in the ‘Unit Price’. 
[*] When registering items for sale in [Private Sales Black Market], the ‘Lowest Registration Price’ in the [Black Market] tab has been changed to be displayed.
[list][*] If there are no items currently for sale, the ‘Recent Average Price’ will be applied as the selling price per unit when registering items for sale.[/list][*] When purchasing items in the Black Market, the N mark has been Changed to be immediately applied to the ‘Purchase History’ tab without having to re-open the Black Market or click the Purchase History tab.
[*] The method of removing the N mark in the Black Market ‘Purchase History’ tab has been changed. 
[list][*] Before: N mark removed when receiving items with [Receive all Credits / Items] button
[*] After: N mark removed when receiving all items in Purchase History[/list][*] When purchasing the last item registered in [Black Market] or [Purchase Reservation Black Market], a system message is displayed instead of a pop-up window.
[list][*] When purchasing the last item, the screen is refreshed to the previous search screen. [/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some items have been changed to untradeable at Black Market Specification.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Items that are currently unobtainable, items that have rarely been traded in the past 6 months, old items, or items with very low necessity have been changed to specifications that cannot be traded in the Black Market.
[list][*] Target Item: Malek's Legacy, Skull Queen's Sight, Corrupted Treasure Shard, Magical Horn, Dragon's Broken Blade, Otherworldly Refugee's Horn and more
[/list][*] For items other than the announced Items, please refer to the Black Market Trade Specification through the Tooltip. 
[*] Gear Items that were changed to Untradeable specification at Black Market have been changed to Cannot Repackage Specification. 
[*] All items registered in the Black Market before the maintenance on Nov 20, 2024 have been processed as failure in bidding during the maintenance on Nov 20, 2024.
[list][*] Items that have been changed to be untradeable for black market among the items that have been processed as failure in bidding cannot be re-registered after the maintenance.[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/95e4cbc4cf601948f8669a88d01933c17e047ddf.png[/img]

[color=#5f95cc][b][START][/b][/color]

[h3][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/ria-s-wheel-of-trinity-update-events-Fe0GyI1181][b]1. Ria's WOT Update Celebration Attendance[/b][/url][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Event Period: [/b]November 20, 2024 maintenance - December 4, 2024 maintenance[/list]
[h3][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/black-force-ria-included-thanksgiving-event-sIrqPs1178][b]2. Thanksgiving Accumulative Login[/b][/url][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Event Period: [/b]November 20, 2024 maintenance - December 4, 2024 maintenance[/list]
[h3][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/black-force-ria-included-thanksgiving-event-sIrqPs1178][b]3. Black Force Event[/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Pre-Notice on Black Market Renewal planned on Nov 20, 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance about the planned Black Market Renewal scheduled on November 20, 2024 maintenance.

Please check the following information for more details.
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]■ Black Market Renew Pre-Notice[/b][/color]
[b]Schedule:[/b] During the maintenance on November 20, 2024

[b]Details[/b]
[olist][*] [b]All items registered in the Black Market will be processed as failure in bidding during the maintenance on Nov 20, 2024.[/b]
[list][*] Items that are currently unobtainable, items that have rarely been traded in the past 6 months, old items, or items with very low necessity will be changed to specifications that cannot be traded in the Black Market after the maintenance.

(Example : Malek's Legacy, Skull Queen's Sight, Corrupted Treasure Shard, Magical Horn, Dragon's Broken Blade, Otherworldly Refugee's Horn and more)
[color=#89CFF0]* Costume Items are excluded from specification changes.[/color][/list]
[*] [b]In the Item Search tab of the ‘Black Market’ and ‘Purchase Reservation Black Market’, the ‘Character’ filter will be added to the <Detailed Settings> of the [Costume] and [Accessory] categories, and the default rarity filter will be changed to ‘All’.[/b]
[list][*] When you select the desired information for rarity, equipped part, and character and press the [Search] button, the currently sold costumes with the corresponding conditions will be displayed in the item list.[/list]
[*] [b]In the main category of the search <Item Type> of the ‘Black Market’ and ‘Purchase Reservation Black Market’, ‘Enhancement/Tuning Materials’ will be changed to ‘Consumables’, and the subcategories of potions, boxes, and consumables will be added/changed.[/b]

[*] [b]When an item is first registered, the unit price will be changed to be applied as the ‘Lowest Registration Price’ of the currently registered item by default.[/b]
[list][color=#89CFF0]* Applied as the lowest price in each tab of Normal, Private Sale, Purchase Reservation.[/color][/list][/olist]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/523831205fe9db127e6cd888bbcdaf695468ab22.png[/img][/url]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2.Purification Ops Dungeon Renew[/b][/color][/h3]

[*] ‘Mission Drive Ver.1.0’ Item has been changed to Consumables Item from Material Item.
[list][*] You can acquire the Contribution by using ‘Mission Drive Ver.1.0’ Item, after maintenance on Nov 6, 2024.[/list][*] The ‘Mission Drive Ver.1.0’ item registered in the Black Market before the maintenance on Nov 6, 2024 has been changed to failure in bidding status during the maintenance on Nov 6, 2024.[/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The entrance method and clear reward of Purification Ops Dungeon have been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Purification Ops Dungeon has been changed to enterable without consuming entrance items.        
[*] ‘Contamination Purifier Capsule’ has been changed to untradeable at Black Market and saleable at shop.
[*] The ‘Contamination Purifier Capsule’ item registered in the Black Market before the maintenance on Nov 6, 2024 has been changed to failure in bidding status during the maintenance on Nov 6, 2024.
[*] The sale of ‘Contamination Purifier Capsule’ item at Contribution Shop and PVP Point Shop has been ended.
[*] Credit Reward and Clear Rank Reward have been removed from the acquirable reward by clearing Purification Ops Dungeon.
[*] Visual (Costume) Item, Gear, Consumables and Material Item have been removed from Purification Ops Dungeon's monster drop reward.[/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Purification Ops related quest has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Following the Purification Ops Dungeon Renew, sub-lvl text has been removed from relevant quest goals.
[*] Purification Ops Dungeon-related Repeat Quests have been removed.
[list][*] Removed Quest: Repeat: Jisu Seo, Repeat: Enter Hell[/list][*] Purification Ops gear, some material items, and credit reward have been removed from the Quest Rewards related to Purification Ops.
[*] The ‘Contamination Token’ item amount required for the ‘Purification Ops - Commencing the Purification Ops’ quest has been changed from 4 to 3.[/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Purification Ops related craft recipe has been renewed.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Craft NPC > Gear, Skill Cube craft recipes in the ‘Purification Ops: Gear’ Category located in the [Purification Ops Center] tab have been removed.
[*] Craft recipes related to ‘Transcendence Stone Extract’ in the ‘Purification Ops: Conversion’ and ‘Purification Renew Conversion’ Categories have been moved to the [Conversion] Category.
[*] Craft recipes that consume exclusive material items related to Purification Ops have been changed to be crafted by replacing them with other material items or credits.
[list][*] Even if the material of a craft recipe is changed, the craftable count is not reset and is maintained.[/list][*] The specification for the Purification Ops-related Exclusive Material Item has been changed to salable.[/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Mock Battle Renew[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ V.HARD Difficulty Dungeons have been added to Mock Battle.[/b][/color]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance about the planned removal and change of some sub level dungeons, reward/craft recipe in Purification Ops Area scheduled on November 6, 2024 maintenance.  

Please check the following information for more details.

[*] [b]Details[/b]

[list][*] All dungeons' credit rewards will be removed.
[*] All dungeons' Operation Progress (Report Operation Result) will be removed and sale of Mission Drive Ver.1.0 will be ended at Contribution Shop.
[list][*] [color=#89CFF0]Please acquire the reward before the maintenance on Nov 6, 2024, if your Operation Progress is accumulated.[/color][/list][*] ‘Material/Consumable Item’ will be removed from dungeon clear reward, monster/boss monster drop reward.
[*] Gear item will be removed from Monster/Boss Monster drop reward.
[list][*] [color=#89CFF0]You can acquire Visual (Costume) Item depending on each rate same with existing.[/color]
[*] [color=#89CFF0]EXP, Contribution, and Event Item drop will be maintained.[/color][/list][*] ‘Purification Ops Exclusive Material’ Item will be changed to available for sale.[/list]
[b]4.) Purification Ops area's dungeon-related quests will be changed. [/b]
[list][*] The sub lvl. phrase will be removed from Purification Ops area's dungeon-related quest goal.
[*] Purification Ops Area's repetitive quest will be removed. 
[*] Purification Ops Gear, some material item, and credit item reward will be removed from Purification Ops Area Quest Reward.
[*] The required amount of ‘Contamination Token’ item for ‘Puriciation Ops/Commencing the Purification Ops’ quest will be reduced from 4 → 3.[/list]
[b]5.) The craft recipe of ‘Purification Ops Center’ tab from craft UI will be changed.[/b]
[list]
[*] The ‘Purification Ops: Gear’ Category, and the craft recipe for Awakended Cube and Gear in the category will be removed.
[*] Among the craft recipe materials from ‘Purification Ops : Materials’, ‘Contamination Hell Gear’, and ‘Yod’s Sea’ Category, items that consume ‘Purification Ops Exclusive Material’ for craft will be changed to consume other material item or Credit.
[list][*] [color=#89CFF0]Even if the craft recipe's material is changed, the craft restriction will not be reset but maintained.[/color][/list][*] The craft recipe regarding ‘Transcendence Stone Extract’ from ‘Purification Ops : Conversion’ and ‘Purification Renovation’ Category will be moved to ‘Conversion’ Category.[/list][/list]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.content:
[h1]Memorial Fireworks Festival[/h1]
[i]Join the excitement at the dazzling Fireworks Festival![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b103446a399727724c614b367f35b96c97c973a8.jpg[/img]
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
October 8, 2024 at 7:00 AM - November 6, 2024 at 7:00 AM UTC
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Firecracker Material Removal[/b][/color]
November 6, 2024 at 7:00 AM UTC

[color=#89CFF0][b]Common Removal Date[/b][/color]
December 31, 2024 at 9:00 AM UTC


[color=#FFAC1C][b]1. Event Overview[/b][/color]

[table][tr][td]
[b]What are [Firecracker]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*][Firecracker] is an event item that is only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period and can be acquired from both the Cash Shop and in-game.[/*][*]Using [Firecracker] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are [Festival Points]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points has been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].[/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival] Server Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The[b] [/b]Server Buff[b] [/b]applies buff effects to all players and all characters.[/*][*]The Server Buff is stacked up to level 10 and will give better buff effects as the level goes up.[/*][*]All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival Gift] Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The Buff is acquired when using Cash Shop Firework (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, Wildhüter, and Rattus)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are some other benefits?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]Collect ‘Fireworks Event Souvenirs’ every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain the Troubleshooter outfit (B type) and other exclusive rewards![/*][*]The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards![/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What determines the ranks?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The ranking is determined by the accumulation of [Festival Points] attributed to each character, with rewards allocated to Ranks 1 through 5.[/*][*]The Dragon Chair for Rank 1–3 is a newly introduced visual item.

notes.title: Pre-Notice on UMP Shop Renewal planned on Oct 8, 2024
notes.content:
Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance about the planned UMP Shop Renewal scheduled on October 8, 2024 maintenance.

Please check the following information for more details.

[color=#5f95cc][b]■ UMP Shop Renew Pre-Notice[/b][/color]
[list][*][b]Schedule[/b]: During the maintenance on October 8, 2024
[*][b]Details[/b]
[list][*] The following items will be added/removed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bd3f23e383cc9c8352b269bad405be5317222cc0.png[/img]

[*]Costume tab will be created, and the following items will be added there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f88b799924c1fbb33f94686c31ffabc4f9ceae34.png[/img]
[color=#89CFF0][list][*] For some costume selectable boxes, you can purchase and use it by characters that have not yet been released for that costume, but you cannot equip the costume for that character.
[*] Each costume box can be purchased once per character, in 3-star and cannot repackage specification.[/list][/color]
[*]The following items will have changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/76f487a77c8ea7a53a94c8f34f8cdb91eaacb787.png[/img]

[list][color=#89CFF0][*] The purchase restriction of ‘Gear Booster +15’ and ‘Phase Wings Essence’ will be reset with the update, as there will be purchase restriction changes on them.[/color][/list][/list][/list]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/09e80334f73f4ab5dc983f95743d961b7394fa33.png[/img][/url]

[list][*] Passive Skill ‘Polish’ can be opened and learned when each character's Prime Agent/Fatal Crew/Shadow Agent Promotion.
[*] In order to apply the Polish effect, you must acquire the active skill to which you are applying up to the maximum level.

[list][*] You can convert the Dragon Core by consuming credits and ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ or ‘Noble Dragon Core’ through the Upgrade NPC in each town.

[list][*] 2 kinds of ‘Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic)’ have been added to ‘Chapter of Infinite Gluttony’ Dungeon Clear Reward.

[*] The ‘Glutton King’s Trigger Box (Epic)’ Item Name added as a Clear Reward is the same but can be distinguished through the number displayed on the upper right of the icon and item tooltip.
[*] The two types of ‘Glutton King’s Trigger Box (Epic)’ added as a Clear Reward are tradeable for Black Market and can move to Account Bank.
[*] The ‘Glutton King’s Trigger Box (Epic)’ acquire method that cab be acquired as a ‘Chapter of Infinite Gluttony’ Dungeon Clear Reward has been changed to Drop Reward.
[*] ‘Glutton King's Memory Crystal’ item has been changed to ‘Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic)’, from the dungeon clear reward of 3kinds of Elite Dungeons.              
[list]
[*] [color=#89CFF0]※ Please note that if you enter the 3 types of Elite Dungeons between 4:00 AM on Sept 21st, 2024 and before the maintenance on Sept 25th, 2024 the number of entries you can make will not be reset after the maintenance on Sept 25th, 2024.[/color][/list][*] ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’ craft recipe has been removed and ‘Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic)’ craft recipe has been added.[/list]

[*] ‘Glutton King's Memory Crystal’ item has been changed to ‘Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic)’, from the dungeon clear reward of 3kinds of Elite Dungeons.              
[list]
[*] [color=#89CFF0]※ Please note that if you enter the 3 types of Elite Dungeons between 4:00 AM on Sept 21st, 2024 and before the maintenance on Sept 25th, 2024 the number of entries you can make will not be reset after the maintenance on Sept 25th, 2024.[/color][/list][*] ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’ craft recipe has been removed and ‘Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic)’ craft recipe has been added.[/list]
▶ Yoon Ria Character's 'Special Move: Extreme Boom! - Sound Wave Emission' attack's effect visibility has been improved.
▶ Yoon Ria Character's [Sound Signal] stack's effect visibility has been improved.
▶ The floor visibility of Dragon King Hecatoncheir's ‘You dust-like tiny being!’ pattern has been improved.
▶ The barrier size of objects summoned in Paris Under Dragon's Domination dungeon has been adjusted.
▶ 'Gluttony Execution' and 'Infinite Gluttony Execution' items are changed to be available in Salvage.
▶ The description regarding the application of the invincibility effect when using the skill has been added to the Levia Character's 'Snake Signet' Skill Tooltip.

▶ The guide regarding the Guaranteed Conditional judgment of the additional hit that occurs when acquiring the 'Remote Aiming Support' buff has been added to some of the Tina Character's skill tooltips.[list][*] Target Skill: Heat Shot, Special Move : Battlefield, EX Thunderbolt[/list]

tags.bug: ▶ The issue where the game would occasionally end abnormally during Batch Exploration Progress in UNION Camp - Your Room has been fixed.
▶ The issue where the Closer name before the change was displayed in the Friend List and Crew Information after changing the Closer name has been fixed.
▶ The details that the Open Condition (Level) was displayed differently in the Levia Character's 'EX Horn Smash - Advanced' Skill Tooltip has been fixed.
▶ The issue where [Explosion] damage is applied when using 'Dropping the Crescent Moon - [Strong] downwards strike' with the Mirae Character has been fixed.

▶ The issue where [Instant Judgment] was not applied when using ‘Shotgun Outburst’ attack after using ‘[Sense]-Explosion Soul’ on a Monster with [Judgment Mark] engraved with the Cheolsu Kim Character has been fixed.
▶ The issue where the basic illustration for Team Rattus is not displayed has been fixed.

notes.content:
Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance about the planned Dragon Core Convert & Break Challenge Trigger Farming adjustments scheduled on September 25, 2024 maintenance.

Please check the following information for more details.

[/td][td]
20,000,000 Credits

[color=#89CFF0][b]■ Break Challenge Trigger Farming Ease[/b][/color]
[list][*][b]Schedule[/b]: During the maintenance on September 25, 2024[/*][*][b]Details[/b][list][*]Break Challenge Trigger ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ item farming will be alleviated.  [/*][*]Please note that if you enter any of the 3 types of Elite Dungeons between 4:00 AM on September 21, 2024, and before the maintenance on September 25, 2024, your entry count will not be reset after the maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: September 11th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/reign-of-the-dragon-king-new-dungeon-gears-events-DIbDHe1106][b]1. New Dungeon <Reign of the Dragon King>[/b][/url][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Dungeon ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon is available by completing each corresponding quest, after accepting [False Preparation] Quest at Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>> Town.
[list][*] Cradle of Dragons (1 player), Paris under Dragon’s domination (1 player): [The Power of the Dragon] Quest
[*] Cradle of Dragons (4 players), Paris under Dragon’s domination (4 players): [The Two Dragons] Quest[/list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon is available by <Commander Subjugation Supporter - LeBlanc> NPC at Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>>, The end: The world in flames, and Noah's Museum town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bd049d41455c38a7748410224ae404f374b9275a.png[/img]

[*] You can enter ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ dungeon, which has a fixed entry limit of 1 player, using the entrance ticket that can be obtained from 4 players dungeon.
[list][*] Entrance Material Item: Dragon Queen Astarte (1 player) Entrance Ticket, Dragon King Hecatoncheir (1 player) Entrance Ticket
[/list][*] You can acquire the additional reward through Bonus Reward System, at ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ 4 players Dungeon. (Once per character per week)
[*] You can acquire New Chip, Boss Accessory and Armband depending on the rate by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon.
[*] You can acquire Material Item and ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ Item which are required for New Gear Craft and Upgrade, by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ dungeon.[list]
[*] New Gear: Furious Dragon Queen Staff/Whip, Furious Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram, Astarte Disc
[*] Material Item: Shining Dragon Core Piece, Noble Dragon Core[list][color=#5f95cc]※ ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ can be acquired by Bonus Reward of 4 players' dungeon, and ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ can be acquired by Bonus Reward of 4 players' dungeon or Drop Reward of 1 player dungeon. 
※ ‘Noble Dragon Core’ can be acquired when opening Dragon King's Noble Random Chest, and Tradable Extra Core can be acquired with low probability.[/color][/list][/list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon-related New UNION Watch, Growth Guide Mission, Farming Guide, and Achievement have been added. [/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Dragon King Boss Accessory & Illust Armband have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Dragon King Boss Accessory 6 kinds and Boss Illust Armband 2 kinds have been added.
[list][*] Dragon King Boss Accessory and Illust Armband can be acquired depending on each rate by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ 1 player/ 4 players dungeon.  
[*] Dragon King Boss Accessory and Illust Armband can be crafted through Craft NPC, by consuming ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit.[/list][list][list]However, accessories and illustration armbands are obtained as non-repackaging specifications in case of craft.[/list][/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Bonus Reward System[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Bonus Reward System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Bonus Reward System is a system that allows you to obtain additional rewards equal to the number of times you can receive rewards without having to click a separate button after clearing a dungeon.
[*] Dungeons with the Bonus Reward System set will display the icon and the number of times you can receive rewards on the lower left of the dungeon image in the entrance UI.
[list][*] Target Dungeon: Cradle of Dragons (4 players), Paris under Dragon’s domination (4 players), Castle of Darkness[/list][*] When you hover over the Bonus Reward icon and the number of times you can receive the reward in the dungeon entry UI, a description of the Bonus Reward will be displayed.
[*] Items and specifications obtained as Bonus Reward will be displayed in the Bonus Reward UI after clearing the dungeon.
[*] If you have used up all the number of times you can receive the Bonus Reward, the Bonus Reward UI will not be displayed even if you clear the dungeon.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. New Epic Core[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Epic Core ‘Furious Dragon Queen Staff/Whip’ and 'Furious Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram’ have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] 4 kinds of New Epic Core have been added, and all can be equipped regardless of character's battle type. 
[*] New Epic Core's Enhancement Transfer Group has been added. 
[*] New Epic Core can be crafted and upgraded by consuming main materials, ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit through Craft NPC. 
[*] New Epic Core's Required Level is 94 and can be upgraded by Atropos grade.
[*] New Epic Core will have the Unleash Option activated and applied when it reaches Enhancement Lv. 18, 22, 26, and 30.
[list][*] New Epic Core 4 kinds Option[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/71bb190274e1b06783a9466c191988376786654d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e011caeae43cf69541015a07dc2037a60352742d.png[/img]
[*] New Epic Core Triggering Effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7240fee06632e8119d287b6b7e574ee8fc11875b.png[/img]

[*] New Epic Core Unleash Option
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/22936a6c6f8e56ec48671bd81daa6baf11760bdf.png[/img][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. New Extra Core[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Extra Core ‘Fallen Dragon Queen Staff/Whip’, ‘Fallen Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram’ have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] 4 kinds of New Extra Core have been added and all are equippable regardless of character's battle type.
[*] New Extra Core's Enhancement Transfer Group has been added.
[*] New Extra Core can be obtained from ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon, and details are as follows.
[list][*] Acquire by opening ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ depending on each probability that can be obtained from Reign of the Dragon King (4 players) Dungeon Bonus Reward and Reign of the Dragon King (1 player) Dungeon Drop Reward.
[*] Upgrade Dragon King Epic Core of Atropos grade into Extra Core, by consuming ‘Noble Dragon Core’ that can be acquired from Dragon King's Noble Random Chest, and Credit.[list][*] (Extra Core obtained through the upgrade cannot be traded on Black Market or cannot move to Account Storage.)[/list][/list][*] New Extra Core displays effects around the character or monster depending on the triggering effect, when applying it.
[*] New Extra Core will have the Unleash Option activated and applied when it reaches Enhancement lv. 18, 22, 26, and 30.
[list][*] New Extra Core 4 kinds Option[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e331f05a847e1fc517092aab46a74e783f0f5142.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e246b7d1d2b99a5ca16b87e21faa214174f128fa.png[/img]
[*] New Extra Core Triggering Effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/54383fc751f84fc599f9a48be1339b459d04bcd6.png[/img]

[*] New Extra Core Unleash Option
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/53066212abf119efd474a029f618af542e4c0863.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. New Phase Awakening & New Chip[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Phase Awakening Gear ‘Astarte Disc’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] ‘Astarte Disc I’ can be obtained by upgrading ‘Dragon Disc III’ item by consuming main materials ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit. 
[*] ‘Astarte Disc I’ can be upgraded by ‘Astarte Disc III’ through  Upgrade NPC.
[*] ‘Astarte Disc’ can't be traded on Black Market Trade and can't be moved to Account Storage.
[*] When opening Chip Slot, you can equip a new chip that can be acquired from ‘Dragon's Vanguard’ or ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon.
[*] You can use the active option by equipping ‘Astarte Disc’ at Skill Slot.
[list][*] New Phase Awakening <Astarte Disc> Option[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/35e5ffbe11d71c5b20ddadb549f9ef99cb8abb29.png[/img][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. Enhancement System Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Enhancement System has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Physical/Psi Attack Power, Physical/Psi Crit Damage amount that would be increased when trinket item enhancement success has been increased.
[*] The Enhancement Rate Increase used to be applied through Enhancement Buff Voucher Item has been applied to the Basic Enhancement Rate. [[url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/enhancement-rate-notice-DD1ioZ1117][b]Go to Enhancement Rate Notice[/b][/url]]
[*] Enhancement fail rate targeting Enhancement +16, +17 grade has been removed.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Guaranteed Enhancement System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Guaranteed Enhancement System is a system where the Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulated in an item according to the enhancement result value, and the enhancement is guaranteed to succeed when trying enhancement after reaching the maximum point value.
[*] If the Guaranteed Enhancement Point is accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Points are displayed in the lower right corner of the Enhancement System UI and in the Gear Item Tooltip.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Points accumulate when enhancement failure is prevented by adding Gear Booster Fortifier or when there is no change in enhancement.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is reset when enhancement success/great success or using Gear Booster or Enhancement Transfer Device.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is maintained when Enhancement Fail, Black Market Item Trade, Item Upgrade.  
[list]However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.
(ex: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.[/list][*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is acquired differently depending on the material item used for Enhancement.
[list][*] Acquire Guaranteed Enhancement Point 100pt when using ‘Gear Booster Fuel I’
[*] Acquire Guaranteed Enhancement Point 130pt when using ‘Lucky Gear Boost I’[/list][*] The maximum value of the Guaranteed Enhancement Point is different depending on the enhancement level.
[*] If you have acquired the Guaranteed Enhancement Point Maximum of the current Enhancement stage during continuous Enhancement, continuous Enhancement will end and the Guaranteed Enhancement Pop-up window will be displayed.
[*] When you try Enhancement in a status that has reached the Guaranteed Enhancement Point Maximum, Enhancement Material/Enhancement Additives/Credit will not be consumed.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ All Gear Items' enhancement stage has been expanded to a maximum of 30.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Gear effects for the expanded enhancement stages have been added.
[*] Chip Overclock's maximum level expansion will be applied through future updates.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]8. Unleash Option[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Unleash Option has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] A new system, ‘Unleash Option’, has been added to some Gear Items.
[list][*] Target Gear: Dragon King Epic Atropos Core, Dragon King Extra Core, Furious Dragon Module[/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Unleash Option has been added to Furious Dragon Module.[/b][/color]
[list]

[*] Activated Unleash Option is displayed in ‘light blue’ in Item Tooltip, and Deactivated Unleash Option is displayed in ‘gray’.
[*] The effect of Deactivated Unleash Option is not applied.
[*] Unleash Option related game guide has been added.[/list]

[list][*] Guaranteed Enhancement Points are acquired differently depending on the fuel item used for Enhancement.[/*][*]If Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.[/*][*]Guaranteed Enhancement Points are reset when Enhancement Success/Great Success, Gear Boosters are used, and Enhancement Transfer Devices are used.[/*][*]Guaranteed Enhancement Points are maintained when Enhancement fails, Black Market item Trades, and item Upgrades.
  However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.  
* Example: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.[/*][/list]

tags.feature: Guaranteed Enhancement Points are acquired differently depending on the fuel item used for Enhancement.
If Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.
Guaranteed Enhancement Points are reset when Enhancement Success/Great Success, Gear Boosters are used, and Enhancement Transfer Devices are used.

Guaranteed Enhancement Points are maintained when Enhancement fails, Black Market item Trades, and item Upgrades. However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.

Example: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.
If the Enhancement Try Result with Gear Booster Fuel I is Enhancement Stage <No Change>, you will be able to acquire 100pt of Guaranteed Enhancement Point.
If the Enhancement Try Result with Lucky Gear Boost I is Enhancement Stage <No Change>, you will be able to acquire 130pt of Guaranteed Enhancement Point.

tags.feature: Guaranteed Enhancement Points are acquired differently depending on the fuel item used for Enhancement.
If Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.
Guaranteed Enhancement Points are reset when Enhancement Success/Great Success, Gear Boosters are used, and Enhancement Transfer Devices are used.

Guaranteed Enhancement Points are maintained when Enhancement fails, Black Market item Trades, and item Upgrades.
However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.
* Example: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.
If the Enhancement Try Result with Gear Booster Fuel I is Enhancement Stage <No Change>, you will be able to acquire 100pt of Guaranteed Enhancement Point.
If the Enhancement Try Result with Lucky Gear Boost I is Enhancement Stage <No Change>, you will be able to acquire 130pt of Guaranteed Enhancement Point.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Character Yoon Ria Update[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Character Yoon Ria has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Black Lambs team's 6th member ‘Yoon Ria’ has been added.
[*] Yoon Ria Character can start at Level 67 upon creation, and the Maximum Level is set to 88.
[list][*] Yoon Ria Character's maximum level is planned to be expanded by lv. 95 during the next maintenance.[/list][*] Yoon Ria Character's rank consists of Trainee, Novice Agent, and Regular Agent.
[*] Yoon Ria Character can use Gangnam District and International Airport town.
[*] Noah's Museum, Planar Gate/Planar Gate : Deep Layer, Ancient Dragon Historic Site, and Fantasy World : Dream Theater/Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>> Town are available.
[*] UNION Camp (Your Room, Farm) entrance is available.
[*] UNION Arena (PVP) entrance is not available.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria Skill List[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fa500295800e27875e7619e314f5a5f9aaa5391c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/360c72e7c23fcf9f5ef9a481866d36b853b0a371.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/65c51d2dd78df0fb48b48c4477dfd280e9f54544.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c675677a4b431546e819cbfdf630601baa705573.png[/img]
