[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria Resource Status Window[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/72ed720b0249603cdf4bcc195013e5459b3f74c8.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's Quest has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Yoon Ria 1~2Area, Planar Gate, Ancient Dragon Historic Site, and Fantasy World : Dream Theater Quest have been added.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's Achievement & Title have been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's exclusive gear / item has been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's 2kinds of Emotes have been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's exclusive emotion has been added.[/b][/color]
[color=#c3a3ff]※ Yoon Ria Character can't craft and equip ‘Purification Ops Gear’.
※ Yoon Ria Character can't equip ‘Auto-Growth Core’ and ‘Auto-Growth Module’.
※ Yoon Ria Character can only use Boss Skin Pack for contents that are available for Yoon Ria character, after maintenance on Aug, 7th, 2024.[/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Growth Guide System[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Growth Guide System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] <Growth Guide> is a system that guides you through various content by clearing each stage's mission consisting of main content.
[*] When you click the Growth Guide button on the upper right, a dedicated UI will appear.
[*] When you click the 'Guide' button for each mission, a guide UI window related to the corresponding mission will open.
[*] When you click the 'Move Now' button for each mission, a UI window required for clearing the mission will open or you will move to the location of the related NPC.
[list]
[*] If the town you would move to is not open yet, the 'Move Now' button will be disabled.
[color=#c3a3ff]※ Some missions cannot be performed with the character Yoon Ria, and you will be able to move and clear it after the upcoming promotion update.[/color][/list][*] All mission clear rewards can be obtained once per account.
[*] Even if you have obtained the reward, you can click the 'Guide' button and 'Move Now' button for the mission.  
[*] The displayed TCP is the recommended TCP for performing mission, and you can check and clear the next stage's mission not clearing the previous mission.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Washing Machine Accumulative Purchase Reset[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The function to reset accumulated purchases for Washing Machine has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] [Accum. Purchase Reset] button will be created after acquiring all the accumulative purchase rewards from the Washing Machine.
[*] When the [Accum. Purchase Reset] button is clicked, the ‘Accumulated purchase reward record’ for the corresponding washing machine will be reset, and rewards can be obtained from the beginning again depending on the accumulated purchase quantity.
[*] [Accum. Purchase Reset] button will disappear when the accumulated purchase reward record is reset by clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button.
[*] If clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button, [Current Accumulative Purchase] amount will be deducted by the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement.[list][*] e.g.: When the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement for washing machine is 800 and the [Reset accumulated purchases] button is clicked after purchasing it 850 times, the current accumulated purchase quantity will be changed to 50.[/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Script Window Hide Function[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The function to hide the script window for enjoying quest illust has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] When you press [V] while the Quest script window is open, the script window will be hidden.
[*] After the Quest script window is hidden, pressing [V], [X], [Z], or [ESC] will reappear the hidden script window.[/list]

[b]▶ The issue where shading was not applied when searching for items in the storage and account storage has been fixed.

▶ The issue where the upgrade UI would not close when clicking the [X] button in the upgrade UI window has been fixed.

▶ The issue where the option for Mini Aeri Pet(adult) ‘Focused Phase Force’ skill was not applied correctly has been fixed.[/b]
[list][*] Changed to the same option as the ‘Focused Phase Focus’ skill of other mini playable character pets.

[b]▶ The issue where HP would occasionally appear to be remaining when a character or monster died has been fixed.

▶ The forced camera direction of 'Red Scavenger' featured in Flame Wave Dungeon has been removed.[/b]

Yoon Ria Character's rank consists of Trainee, Novice Agent, and Regular Agent.
Yoon Ria Character can use Gangnam District and International Airport town.
Noah's Museum, Planar Gate/Planar Gate : Deep Layer, Ancient Dragon Historic Site, and Fantasy World : Dream Theater/Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>> Town are available.
UNION Camp (Your Room, Farm) entrance is available.
UNION Arena (PVP) entrance is not available.

Yoon Ria's Achievement & Title have been added.
Yoon Ria's exclusive gear / item has been added.
Yoon Ria's 2kinds of Emotes have been added.
Yoon Ria's exclusive emotion has been added.
▶ Growth Guide System has been added.
<Growth Guide> is a system that guides you through various content by clearing each stage's mission consisting of main content.
When you click the Growth Guide button on the upper right, a dedicated UI will appear.
When you click the 'Guide' button for each mission, a guide UI window related to the corresponding mission will open.
When you click the 'Move Now' button for each mission, a UI window required for clearing the mission will open or you will move to the location of the related NPC.
All mission clear rewards can be obtained once per account.
Even if you have obtained the reward, you can click the 'Guide' button and 'Move Now' button for the mission.
The displayed TCP is the recommended TCP for performing mission, and you can check and clear the next stage's mission not clearing the previous mission.
▶ The function to reset accumulated purchases for Washing Machine has been added.
[Accum. Purchase Reset] button will be created after acquiring all the accumulative purchase rewards from the Washing Machine.

When the [Accum. Purchase Reset] button is clicked, the ‘Accumulated purchase reward record’ for the corresponding washing machine will be reset, and rewards can be obtained from the beginning again depending on the accumulated purchase quantity.
[Accum. Purchase Reset] button will disappear when the accumulated purchase record is reset by clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button.
If clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button, [Current Accumulative Purchase] amount will be deducted by the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement.

When you press [V] while the Quest script window is open, the script window will be hidden.

notes.title: [Developer Letter] Summer 2024 Update Plan
notes.content:
Hello, dear Agents!

I am the PD of Closers, Hyun-Jun Kang.

Greetings once again through this August Developer's Letter.

In this Developer's Letter, we aim to address any curiosities that our Agents may have by providing additional information about the upcoming summer updates.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][August 7th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<New Character Yoon Ria Launch>[/b][/h3]
The 21st new character, Yoon Ria, joins Closers after about a year and a half.

The new character, Ria, initially awakened her phase force early on, underwent some trials, gave up being a Phase user, debuted as an idol, and then returned as a Closer.

The story of how Ria returned to being a Closer from being an idol will unfold through the update on August 7.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/285177ab838878874952086276bff3730efc072c.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Novice Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We have put our best effort into capturing Ria's narrative and personality through details such as taking selfies and gestures where she holds a microphone to sing.

We have meticulously created each motion and effect from scratch to present an attractive character, and we look forward to seeing many players enjoy Closers with the new character.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5ed9fda072495e0729d7e0632090e4baaafc0048.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Regular Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Especially since Ria is joining the Black Lamb team for the first time since Misteltein, we plan to introduce new chemistry with the existing Black Lamb members and showcase another charm of the Black Lamb team.

[h3][b]<Growth Guide>[/b][/h3]
A Growth Guide will be added to help the New/Returning Agents to get back into the game faster.

For Agents who are struggling to settle in due to the old systems and accumulated content, we have prepared a system in the growth guide. Upon first logging into the game, you can immediately check which dungeons you should go to at your current level, what actions to take next, and move directly to the relevant area with just a click.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][August 21st][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Yoon Ria Special, Prime Agent & Other Stories>[/b][/h3]
The update for Yoon Ria's Special Agent and Prime Agent will include the continuation of the story from the International Airport.

You can also look forward to a specially produced ending video for Yoon Ria. We hope you look forward to it!

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/08bde016c7c2272852b334d5af779c2c8b69cc0a.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Special Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Regarding Yoon Ria's skills and promotion configuration, as you might expect, Ria does not have a Task Force promotion.

This means that her Special Agent promotion will include three normal skills and one Special Move, while her Prime Agent role will add two normal skills and one Special Move, similar to other characters.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a5ee4ce33951e70a3d7dedff0b0cb18cea9049a5.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Prime Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We aim to present Yoon Ria’s Special and Prime Agent updates with a high level of quality.

[h3][b]<Summer Dungeon: Dragon's Vanguard>[/b][/h3]
The highly anticipated 'Dragon's Vanguard' update, the prelude of Dragon King, is coming soon.

You will have the opportunity to face the 'Indomitable Gatekeeper,' Andras, and 'Violet Vanguard,' representing the younger years of Astaroth.

A new story and battles involving these characters await you.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/401814be406eb1d8deead4568ab752cec5d59ca2.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d89ac04ccd78703906a36d1d48eb4314dd03e674.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Indomitable Gatekeeper[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Violet Vanguard[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In 'Dragon's Vanguard,' along with 'DRAGONISH Trans Discs,' announced in 'Closers Channel ON Ep.2', there has been a change to update two types of craftable modules. This update aims to enhance the gameplay of 'Dragon's Vanguard,' allowing players to access new gear more swiftly.

The 'DRAGONISH Trans Disc' will be updated from the existing Trans Discs : Supreme to include on-use effects.

These effects will be available for Trans Discs from levels 4 to 6, while previous levels will receive a set minor increase in stats. Please look forward to collecting these from levels 1 to 3 in 'Dragon's Vanguard' and levels 4 to 6 in the upcoming 'Reign of the Dragon King.'

[h3][b]<2024 Summer Swimwear>[/b][/h3]
The 2024 summer swimwear costumes that many Agents have been eagerly waiting for are almost here!

We are giving you a sneak peek at Seha in this costume and hope you’re as excited as we are.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c82b8d4e46c8aff4d223a57ed2670040b2f41e15.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Seha 2024 Summer Swimwear Illustration (Normal)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/824de39a02299c13645cc0169857845e4f26fa66.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Seha 2024 Summer Swimwear Illustration (Special)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][September 11th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Summer Dungeon: Reign of the Dragon King>[/b][/h3]
Following the 'Dragon's Vanguard', the main story of 'Reign of the Dragon King' will be updated.

In this dungeon, you will encounter 'Astarte the Dragon Queen' and 'Hecatoncheir, the Dragon King', whom we introduced earlier. 

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b1f61a3ba37a938c77435bac21d14a79b1a7dca4.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Astarte the Dragon Queen[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
The main objective of this quest is to uncover the connections between the new epic monster Astarte and the characters Astarte and Astaroth, as well as the events involving them.

Particularly, figuratively speaking, the previous form of 'Hecatoncheir' can be considered an undead state.

For those curious about his strength if he were alive, this update will let you experience his might and majesty from the era of the Dimensional War, revisiting his memories from the past in Western Europe.

We hope you look forward to how the story of the Dragon King will unfold.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/049bfc6aee5ef34b79ebf2e85e286a4fabbd7814.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Cradle of Dragons Dungeon[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In the <Cradle of Dragons>, where Astarte appears, the battle will involve preventing the Dragon Legion from intervening to protect Astarte. The battle dynamics can change based on your choices, promising a variety of fun strategic approaches.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b2ec30e64eab2892e11997e18e7feb346325ee80.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Cradle of Dragons Dungeon and Astarte[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In <Paris under Dragon’s domination>, battles involve breaking the Dragon King Hecatoncheir's shields while removing debuffs. The combat is designed around the basic Closer's fight mechanics of dodging and attacking, with additional gimmick to keep the experience enjoyable and less burdensome.

In 'Reign of the Dragon King,' you will be able to farm Epic Core and Extra Core.

We previously mentioned that a craft recipe for untradable Extra Core will be introduced. This untradable Extra Core will be added to be craftable from Epic Core by ‘Upgrade’.

This will allow you to transfer settings from Epic Cores to the new untradable Extra Cores, improving the convenience of gear farming.

Tradable Extra Cores will still be obtainable through dungeon play as before.

[h3][b]<Bonus Reward System>[/b][/h3]
Starting with the Reign of the Dragon King dungeon, a new reward system called 'Bonus Rewards' will be implemented.

'Bonus Rewards' are additional rewards granted separately from regular drops and clear rewards. These are given immediately upon clearing the dungeon under specific conditions that qualify for ‘Bonus Rewards’. Once the limit for 'Bonus Rewards' is reached, no further rewards will be given until the reward count is reset.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/49e9a7b214d900e9496e88542c36db84eba65539.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Extra Rewards System[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
The 'Bonus Rewards' system automatically collects rewards after clearing a dungeon without needing to press the 'Receive Reward' button, making gameplay more convenient. This system will initially apply to the 'Reign of the Dragon King' dungeon and is planned to be expanded to most dungeons that Agents frequently play in the future.

Additionally, this system will also be applied to existing dungeons, with more details to be announced later.

This is expected to alleviate issues where players could miss out on rewards due to unexpected errors or using up all of their Resurrection Capsules before clearing the dungeon.
 
[h3][b]<Enhancement Renewal>[/b][/h3]
Many Agents have been curious about the renewal of the enhancement system, and I'd like to provide further information on it.

Here is a brief recap of the previously explained details:
[olist][*]The enhancement buff system will be removed.[/*][*]Enhancement chances provided by enhancement buffs will be incorporated into the base chances.[/*][*]Guaranteed enhancement points will be acquired upon failure or no change in enhancement status.[/*][*]Once guaranteed enhancement points reach a certain threshold, the next enhancement attempt will succeed with a 100% chance.[/*][/olist]
Additionally, I would like to pre-announce the following updates.
[olist][*]Absolute Gear Booster can be used up to the expanded enhancement range, (up to right before the maximum enhancement level of +30)[/*][*]Failure chance will be removed up to the +17 enhancement level (up to the attempt from +16 to +17)[/*][/olist]
We are diligently preparing to introduce an enhancement system that makes more sense.
 

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][September 25th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<3rd Memorial Quest>[/b][/h3]
As previously shared on the last Closers Channel ON, the story 'The Man's Stopped Time' featuring Tina and Trainer, is prepared as the third memorial quest.

We hope you look forward to discovering how this previously unknown chapter of their past unfolds.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60e81ce0d3a3351928ea9cb8a78ee88583972b53.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Trainer and Tina's Talkface (Modified)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We are also preparing special costumes related to the story of the memorial quest, so we hope you will enjoy it.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ba59b63be89d11a2d2f599165682ebda2faf3840.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Memorial Entry[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Additionally, a new entry exclusive to the Memorial Quest will be introduced with the update of the third Memorial Quest.

[h3][b]<Balance Patch>[/b][/h3]
We are also preparing a balance patch for approximately four characters.
[color=#c3a3ff]([i]Note: The number of characters affected may vary depending on the development progress[/i])[/color]

This balance patch will focus on adding 'utility' as the key point and aim to enhance the damage output for some characters.

We strive to ensure that the adjusted characters will show significant improvements in both convenience and damage.

[h3][b]<Yoon Ria Skill Polish>[/b][/h3]
The final update for Ria character, 'Skill Polish,' will be added.

While we cannot reveal which skills will be subjected to the Polish target just yet, we are committed to developing changes that will give you more enjoyable skill combinations to experience.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][October 8th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Teacher Young-Yi's Divine Battle>[/b][/h3]
Finally, Teacher Young-Yi returns with the Divine Battle!

Previously, the Divine Battles were hosted by the Dogra and Magra sisters, but this time, Teacher Young-Yi will take over their roles.

We'd like to give you a heads-up that we might also rename the Divine Battle to align with this update.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/50c624a6133a18f2cc7e5f9240d425caad97031d.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Teacher Young-Yi's Talkface[/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]
The concept for this Divine Battle event dungeons is 'endless waves of monsters and non-stop barrage of skills.'

We plan to present this fun combat against numerous dimensional monsters in a new style, ensuring the gameplay is optimized to avoid any frame drops. We look forward to your participation and hope you enjoy the new challenges.

[list][*]Some of the content above is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/*][/list]
[h3][b][The End][/b][/h3]
We've mainly shared major content updates today, but we are also working on various other improvements as well.

We will provide more information on the details that have not yet been finalized in future updates.

That concludes the information we've prepared for today.

We are committed to meeting your expectations and ensuring Closers remains a game you’re excited to engage with.

Thank you.
Sincerely, Hyun-Jun Kang

notes.title: Pre-notice: PNA EXP Acquisition Mitigation and Daily Craft Cycle Changes
notes.content:
Hello Agents,

We would like to give you advance notice regarding PNA EXP acquisition mitigation and some daily craft cycle changes scheduled for Jul 24th, 2024 maintenance. 

Please check the following information for more details.
 
[h3][b][color=#89CFF0]■ Pre-Notice on PNA EXP acquisition mitigation and some daily craft items' reset cycle change [/color][/b][/h3]
 
[b]1. Schedule:[/b] During maintenance on July 24th, 2024
[b]2. Details:[/b]
[list][*] PNA EXP that can be acquired from ‘Gremory's Class’ dungeon will be increased. 

[table]
[tr]
[th][color=#FFE135]Dungeons with Increased PNA EXP Acquisition[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Gremory Central Laboratory[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Advanced Central Laboratory[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Bear Land[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Gremory Science Facility[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Advanced Central Laboratory [V.HARD][/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Bear Land [V.HARD][/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Gremory Science Facility [V.HARD][/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Gremory Arcade[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Gremory Arcade [V.HARD][/td][/tr]
[/table]
[color=#89CFF0]※ Dungeon entrance count will not reset during the maintenance on July 24th, 2024. If you used your entrances before maintenance, you cannot enter again until it resets.[/color]

[*] Improvements will be made so that PNA EXP can be obtained in some dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0ed4ca4048e041919fd59a2d72f9381d7835cdfb.png[/img]
[color=#89CFF0]※ Dungeon entrance count will not reset during the maintenance on July 24th, 2024. If you used your entrances before maintenance, you cannot enter again until it resets.[/color]

[*] On the Craft machine NPC → [Ancient Dragon Historic Site] tab, the reset cycle of the number of some daily craftable items will be adjusted to weekly basis. 

[table]
[tr]
[th][color=#FFE135]Craft Item[/color][/th]
[th][color=#FFE135]Craftable Restriction [Before][/color][/th]
[th][color=#FFE135]Craftable Restriction [After][/color][/th]
[/tr]

[td]Agate Fragment x 3[/td]
[td]Twice a day per character[/td]
[td]14 times a week per character[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Golden Rose of the Beginning[/td]
[td]Once a day per character[/td]
[td]7 times a week per character[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]

[td]Once a day per character[/td]

Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

notes.title: July 10th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Skill Remake Additional Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Additional adjustments of skill remake for Yuri and J have been applied.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Yuri's skill improvement

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6b3d454932ed82dcc42fa08f1ccd6e6134f90804.png[/img]
[*]J's skill improvement

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/41d74f2a0e5ccd2bb0dc1bb2f695c57cc4be1804.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Character Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Skill balance of some characters have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character: Levia, Tina, Mirae[*]Skill Balance Adjustment Details

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60eb0c6f2cfd77a9ed1b8ba2c6f365330e0858b8.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Skill Point (SP) change[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Skill Point (PVE/PVP) that is acquired when achieving Character Level 95 has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Detail : When achieving Level 95, give SP 10 → give SP 50.[*]SP 40 has been sent to all characters who achieved Level 95 before the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. New Dungeon ‘The World Tower of Sealing’[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Dungeon ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning - The World Tower of Sealing’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ Dungeon is available by <Shop-Pheasant> NPC at ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ area, with a character level 95 or above who completed [Whispers of Fantasy] quest and accepting [The Whisper of a Girl] quest.[list][*] <Historic Site Entrance> from ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area
[*] <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston> from ‘Noah's Museum’, ‘Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>>’, ‘The end: The world in flames’ Area[/list][*] Tiamat Of The Beginning - ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeon and Practice Dungeon ‘The World Tower of Sealing [Guide]’ dungeon have been added to ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area. 
[*] ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ Dungeon Information

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3d8d694c17e396bb4dfa021d2a8dd1b10245477f.png[/img][/list]
[*] ‘The World Tower of Sealing [Guide]’ Dungeon is a training dungeon for practice of monster pattern and the method of destroying, and monster defeat drop and clear rank rewards are not available. 
[*]  Under the condition of less than Gear Level also can use ‘Find a Squad’ at ‘The World Tower of Sealing [Guide]’ dungeon.
[*] Tiamat Of The Beginning Dungeon related achievement has been added. 
[*] Tiamat Of The Beginning Title has been added.
[*] Channel Bonus applies when playing ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning - The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeon at ‘EX ZONE’ Channel.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ Dungeon Reward has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] You can acquire rewards by clearing ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeon depending on each probability.  
[*] Main Clear Reward: Golden Rose of the Beginning, Origin Chip ×1 Box, Malek Diamon.
[*] You can craft Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip, Tiamat Of The Beginning Title, Illust Armband, and more by ‘Golden Rose of the Beginning’ item.
[*] Main Drop Reward: Tiamat Of The Beginning Illust Armband, Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip Selectable Box (Tradable), Origin Chip ×1 Box and more.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Dungeon ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning - The World Tower of Sealing’ Dungeon Reward has been added.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. New Item ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip’[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip’ 7kinds have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] New Chip ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip’ 7kinds can be equipped only with Trinket and includes the option of 'Damage increase to DRAGONISH' in common. 
[*] ‘Tiamat of The Beginning Chip’ can be crafted at craft tab from chip inventory window.
[*] Main Craft Material: T3 Colored Chip, Golden Rose of the Beginning, Chromatic Phase Essence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/21dc002de169f9ead692f9ac702e2856edcf1514.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area Dungeon Play Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The monster appear condition of ‘Dragon's Execution Ground’ dungeon has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon: Dragon's Execution Ground, Dragon's Execution Ground [V.HARD], [Extreme] Dragon's Execution Ground[*]Change Detail:[list](Before) The next monster appears 30 seconds after the monster appears.
(After) Once the monster that appears is defeated, the next monster appears.[/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Monster's stamina from Mirage Repeated and Mirage Repeated [V.HARD] Dungeon have been lowering-adjusted.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The resurrection count of Mirage Repeated [V.HARD] dungeon has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Change: Can resurrect 4times → No restriction on resurrection[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Proceed to Next Ops’ button has been applied to some dungeons.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon: Mirage Repeated [V.HARD] ↔ The World Tower of Sealing[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Ancient Dragon Historic Site Dungeon Entry placement has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*] From ‘Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>>’, ‘The end: The world in flames’, and ‘Noah's Museum’ Town's NPC <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston>,   ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site1’ tab has been removed and ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site2’ tab has been changed to ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’.
[*] NPC <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston>'s some ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ tab dungeon items and placement order have been changed. 
[*] Added Dungeon: The World Tower of Sealing, The World Tower of Sealing [Guide]
[*] Removed Dungeon: [Nightmare] Ancient Dragon's Nightmare : Heart, [Nightmare] Ancient Dragon's Prison Castle
[*] The dungeon list order of Dungeon Entry NPC <Historic Site Entrance> at  ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site Area' has been changed.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area Dungeon and Reward acquire Renew [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/4181110370592246138][Go to Pre-Notice][/url][/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Monster drop/clear rank reward from Ancient Dragon Historic Site Area lower-level dungeons have been migrated to ‘Mirage Repeated’ and ‘Mirage   Repeated [V.HARD]’ Dungeon.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Among the monster drop rewards, visual items that can be obtained in the existing lower-level dungeon will be maintained.
[*]Reward removal and migration dungeon details

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bb4ebf3f2dae2950bc22f3ecbb06423543bc6739.png[/img][/list]
[*]Some of the reduced credit rewards from lower-level dungeons have been migrated to ‘Mirage Repeated’, ‘Mirage Repeated [V.HARD]’, and ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeons.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The number of entries to the ‘Dragon’s Execution Ground’ dungeon has been consolidated and changed to once per week per character.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon: Dragon's Execution Ground, Dragon's Execution Ground [V.HARD], [Extreme] Dragon's Execution Ground.
[*]When using [Sector Pass - Dragon's Execution Ground] item, the number of ‘[Extreme] Dragon's Execution Ground’ entries and ‘Dragon's Execution Ground [V.HARD]’ will also increase.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]8. Chip System Convenience Renew[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some chip craft methods has been changed : from Craft at NPC <Craft machine> to Craft at ‘Chip Inventory’ window. [/b][/color]
[list][*]Chip Box Item's all craft recipes have been removed.[list][*]Target Item: T1 Platinum Chip Random Box, T2 Colored Chip Random Box, T2 Colored Chip Selectable Box, T2 Platinum Chip Random Box, T2 Platinum Chip Selectable Box[/list][*]Chip craft receipt at [Chip Craft] tab from ‘Chip Inventory’ window has been added.[list][*]Target Item: T2 Colored Chip, T1 Platinum Chip, T2 Platinum Chip, Overclock Chip[/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Chip Inventory’ UI has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Each tab name from the top of Chip inventory UI has been changed to be intuitive.[*]Multiple chip recipes are displayed at once without left/right arrows moving.[*]Up to 3 chip craft recipes are displayed, and if there are more than 4, you can check them using the scroll bar on the right side of the list.[*]The credits, material items, and crafting restriction count required to craft chips are displayed together for one crafting recipe.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ With the reorganization of the chip system convenience, some chip-related images and descriptions in the in-game guide have been changed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Changed so that credits are not consumed when Chip Overclock.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]9. ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area Dungeon related other changes[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Ancient Dragon Historic Site Area Dungeon-related UNION Watch Mission has been changed partially.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Ancient Dragon Historic Site area dungeon related crew mission has been changed.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The number of craftable count for some items at NPC <Craft Machine> [Ancient Dragon Historic Site] tab has been reset, as Ancient Dragon Historic Site Dungeon and Chip Renew task proceeds.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Item reset list of the craftable count at the existing [Ancient Dragon Historic Site] tab

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]10. Inventory Material & Mission tab Consolidation [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/4181110370592246138][Go to Pre-notice][/url][/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ [Mission] tab has been removed from inventory and consolidated to [Material] tab.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]As the removal of [Mission] tab, ‘UNION Slot Expansion : Mission Ver_1.0~6.0’ Items have been changed to unusable.
[*]The attribute of the existing ‘Quest Item’ has been changed to ‘Material Item’.
[*]Some 'Quest Item' that has nowhere to use has been removed through the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024.
[*]In case of having 'Quest Item' subject to deletion packed by Gremory's Common/Greater/Special Dimensional Box before the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, it will not be deleted during the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024.

※ You can obtain the corresponding item as 'Material Item' by opening the box after the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, and need to remove it directly if you want the removal.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ [Character's Temporary Storage] has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can check [Character's Temporary Storage] by NPC Storage.
[*]Among the ‘Quest Items’ stored in the [Mission] tab prior to maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, those with usage source have been moved to [Character’s Temporary Storage].
[*][Character's Temporary Storage] will be maintained until the December maintenance, and will be deleted along with the stored items after the maintenance. (Detailed schedule will be announced later)
[*][Temporary Account Bank] has been added temporarily along with [Character's Temporary Storage].

※ Please note that [Temporary Account Bank] is a feature added for future use, and is currently unavailable as it is disabled.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]11. Inventory Slot Expansion[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Inventory Slot has been expanded.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The maximum slots in the inventory’s [Gear], [Consumables], [Materials], and [Costume] tabs have been expanded by 20 slots each.
[*](Before) 7x10 → (After) 9x10
[*]Inventory slot expansion is proportional to the opened slots.

※ Accordingly, there is no change in the maximum number of times that inventory slots can be expanded, and you can still use inventory slot expansion items that you own.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The currency consumed when expanding inventory slots have changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]For all inventory tabs and slot expansion stages, the currency consumed during slot expansion has been changed to Credit.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]12. Item Sort Lock function[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Item Sort Lock function has been added to inventory and storage.[/b][/color]
[list][*]When clicking Item Sort Lock button, the mouse cursor changes to -ing status.
[*]When you left-click an item with a mouse that is in the sort lock state, the item will be in the sort lock state.
[*]Items that are sort lock will have a white border displayed in the item slot.
[*]Items in the sort lock state are not sorted and remain in position when ‘item sorting’ is performed.  
[*]If all items in sort lock state are used and the location becomes an empty slot, the lock state will also disappear. 
[*]If an item in the sort lock state is moved by dragging it with the mouse or stacked with an item of the same type, the sort lock state will be maintained. 
[*]The in-game guide has been updated with the addition of the inventory sort lock function.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]13. Storage Item usage and Item Amount display[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ When using some contents in ingame, it has been changed that items at Storage and Account Storage are also can be used.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Contents that consume storage items: Crafting, tuning, upgrading, upgrade tree, NPC shop, costume upgrade/conversion/tuning/dyeing, costume fusion, chip slot change, chip craft, enhancement transfer, pet evolution, pet feeding, PNA Upgrades, mutant manifestations, cross material conversion, operation result report, events (capsule draw, Closer Marble, lucky card)

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Credits held by all characters in the account and credits stored in the storage have been consolidated.[/b][/color]

notes.title: Pre-notice: Enhancement System Improvement Plan
notes.content:
Hello Agents, I'm PD Hyun-jun Kang.

In addition to the content revealed in <CLOSERS CHANNEL ON. EP2>, there are additional matters I would like to introduce to all Agents, hence this message.

For a long time, we have been receiving feedback regarding Enhancement, and our development team has been carefully listening and constantly considering how to improve the Enhancement System to be more convenient.

Based on valuable feedback from Agents, we have identified several key factors that make the Enhancement System difficult:
[olist][*][b]The higher the Enhancement level, the greater the burden of attempting Enhancement, yet the feedback upon successful Enhancement is not sufficiently high.[/b][/*][*][b]There is significant variation in Enhancement efficiency among different equipment types, Trinkets in particular have a smaller advantage in Enhancement.[/b][/*][*][b]Enhancement buff has become a necessity for Enhancement attempts, therefore putting a significant burden on the attempts themselves.[/b][/*][/olist]
To address these concerns, we will be improving the Enhancement System on September 11, 2024. The Enhancement System is one of the most significant systems in character development, and we will approach its growth with caution.

Through these improvements, the following changes will be implemented:
[olist][*][b]Removal of the Enhancement Buff system and increased base success rates[/b][/*][*][b]Introduction of a new Enhancement Guarantee system[/b][/*][*][b]Increase in Trinket Enhancement efficiency[/b][/*][*][b]Addition of Enhancement Unleash Option[/b][/*][*][b]Maximum Enhancement stage extension and the probability adjustment for lower ranges[/b][/*][/olist]
I will provide detailed explanations for each of these topics.

[color=#5f95cc][b]1. Removal of the Enhancement Buff system and increased base success rates[/b][/color]
The current Enhancement Buff system provides probability boosts based on conditions, but since it involves paid items, it also adds to the burden of Enhancement attempts. Furthermore, its limitation is the inability to guarantee 100% Enhancement success.

Therefore, starting with the Enhancement System improvement update on September 11, 2024, the 1.2x probability boost provided by the existing Enhancement Buff will be reflected in the base Enhancement probability. The Enhancement Buff system will be removed, and a new Enhancement Guarantee system will be introduced.

As a preemptive measure, starting from the update on July 24, 2024, we plan to block enhancement buffs from being activated newly and remove existing acquisition paths altogether.

Additionally, any remaining Enhancement Buff Vouchers in possession can be exchanged for items of regular Gear Booster Fuel and Lucky Booster Fuel which are more valuable than its price.

[b][End of Enhancement Buff Voucher Sales, Unavailability, and Replacement Notice][/b]
[list][*][b]Schedule: [/b]During maintenance on July 24, 2024[list][*]End of Sales: Please refer to the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/pre-notice-enhancement-system-adjustment-GjO4RP1035]Pre-notice: Enhancement System Adjustment[/url][/*][/list][/*][*][b]End of Use (Unavailability)[/b][list][*]After the July 24, 2024 maintenance, you can’t activate Enhancement Buffs newly by using Enhancement Buff Vouchers.[/*][*]Enhancement Buffs already activated will remain until the remaining days.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Replacement:[/b][list][*]Enhancement Buff Voucher in possession before the maintenance on Jul 24th, 2024 will be changed to [Enhancement Fuel Selectable Box][*]The Enhancement Fuel Selectable Box contains the following items: x500 Gear Booster Fuel, x42 Lucky Gear Booster Fuel, and x17 Gear Booster Fortifier. You can choose one of these items.
※ Gear Booster Fuel and Gear Booster Fortifier will be distributed as tradeable items.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[color=#5f95cc][b]2. Introduction of a new Enhancement Guarantee system.[/b][/color]
Starting with the update on September 11, 2024, we will introduce a new Enhancement Guarantee system, which ensures a 100% success rate under certain conditions. This will become a fundamental feature of the Enhancement System, without the need to purchase additional items.

[b][New Enhancement Guarantee System][/b]
[list][*]If the Enhancement result is "No Change," the Fixed Enhancement Points will increase.[/*][*]If the Enhancement result is "Enhancement Success," the Fixed Enhancement Points will be reset. This also applies when transferring Enhancements or using Gear Booster.[/*][*]If the Enhancement result is "Enhancement Failure," the Fixed Enhancement Points that are currently owned will be maintained. If Fixed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum value of the previous Enhancement stage, the excess Fixed Enhancement Points will be removed.
(Example) If 100 Fixed Enhancement Points are accumulated in Enhancement Stage A, even if the stage drops to A-1 due to Enhancement failure, the Fixed Enhancement Points for that gear will still be 100. However, the maximum Fixed Enhancement Points for stage A-1 is 90, so only 90 Fixed Enhancement Points will be retained. Subsequent Enhancement attempts can guarantee 100% success.[/*][*]Fixed Enhancement Points will accumulate separately for each equipment item.[/*][*]Enhancement attempts with Fixed Enhancement Points at maximum value will guarantee 100% success.[/*][*]The maximum Fixed Enhancement Points required for fixed Enhancement of equipment will vary depending on the Enhancement stage.[/*][*]"Great Success" will not occur when attempting fixed Enhancement.[/*][/list]Through this approach, we aim to provide clearer feedback for Enhancement attempts.


[color=#5f95cc][b]3. Increase in Trinket Enhancement efficiency.[/b][/color]
As Trinkets have lower Enhancement benefits compared to other types of equipment, we will increase the Enhancement benefits of this type of gear, which has had lower Enhancement motivation issues due to their lower benefits.
[list][*]Increase in Physical/Psi attack increase for each Enhancement stage.[/*][*]Increase in Physical/Psi critical damage for each Enhancement stage.[/*][*]	The Trinket enhancement stat increase is applied to all gears, including the current gear.[/*][/list]By increasing the benefits of Trinket Enhancement, we aim to improve the lower motivation for Trinket Enhancement.


[color=#5f95cc][b]4. Addition of Enhancement Unleash Option.[/b][/color]
In areas where feedback has been felt to be lacking even if the enhancement stage has been increased, we plan to provide a clearer advantage of enhancement increase through the ‘Enhancement Unleash Option’.
[list][*]Unleash Option is a gear-unique option that is activated at a certain enhancement stage or higher.[/*][*]Unleash Option is activated in a fixed option, not in random.[/*][*]Each gear item will have different unleash options.[/*][*]Unleash Option will be introduced starting with <Core> gear that will be added after the September 11, 2024 update.[/*][*]No attributes (stats) will be deleted or lost due to the addition of the unleash option[/*][/list]Through these additions, we hope Agents will feel the feedback on the Enhancement stage increase. We will continue to update and actively contribute to character growth.


[color=#5f95cc][b]5. Maximum Enhancement Stage extension[/b][/color]
In addition to the improvements mentioned above, the Enhancement stage will also be extended to +30, providing long-term growth goals to become stronger characters.
[list][*]The maximum enhancement stages will be extended to +30.[/*][*]The success probability for Enhancements below +25 will be increased.[/*][list][*]In addition to the increased base probability due to the removal of the Enhancement Buff, probabilities for certain ranges will be further increased.[/*][*]The new Enhancement Guarantee system will also be applied to stages 26-30.[/*][*]The existing Enhancement Transfers can also be used in new Enhancement stages.[/*]
[/list][/list]Through these improvements, we will make every effort to prepare and provide reasonable and continuous gameplay goals for everyone.

This concludes the content of this Improvement Plan.

We kindly ask for your support as our development team diligently prepares for the Second Half of the Year Update.

Thank you very much.

tags.feature: - Removal of the Enhancement Buff system and increased base success rates
- Introduction of a new Enhancement Guarantee system
- Increase in Trinket Enhancement efficiency
- Addition of Enhancement Unleash Option
- Maximum Enhancement stage extension and the probability adjustment for lower ranges
The Enhancement Buff system will be removed, and a new Enhancement Guarantee system will be introduced.

As Trinkets have lower Enhancement benefits compared to other types of equipment, we will increase the Enhancement benefits of this type of gear, which has had lower Enhancement motivation issues due to their lower benefits.

In areas where feedback has been felt to be lacking even if the enhancement stage has been increased, we plan to provide a clearer advantage of enhancement increase through the ‘Enhancement Unleash Option’.
In addition to the improvements mentioned above, the Enhancement stage will also be extended to +30, providing long-term growth goals to become stronger characters.

When you log in after the maintenance and open the box, the packed quest items can be moved to the materials tab and can be deleted directly.
The total amount of Credit for all characters will be changed to be displayed in the inventory, and Credit will be shared between characters.
Total Price(Credit) and Item Amount that can be registered in the Black Market will be increased.
The amount of ‘Quality Assurance Seal’ consumed for repackaging unique costumes will be reduced for each piece.

notes.title: June 5th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Conquest Program Ver.2[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Conquest Program Ver.2> has been added. [/b][/color]
[list][*]<Conquest Program Ver.2> can be proceeded with a character starting from level 95 who has completed the [And Holy Lance] Quest.[/*][list][*] [And Holy Lance] Quest is available for characters with level 92 and above.[/list][*]<Conquest Program Ver.2> can be entered by <VR Combat Training Interlocking Device> NPC at ‘Noah's Museum’ town. [/*][*]<Conquest Program Ver.2> requires consuming ‘Program bio-verification key ver.2’ when entering the operation area, and ‘Program bio-verification key ver.2’ is obtainable as [Operation : Flame Wave] 4 players mission dungeon clear reward.[/*][list][*] Target Dungeon: ‘One-eyed Chaser: Kang Lim’, ‘Mirror Paradise: Bihyung’, ‘One-eyed Executioner: Kang Lim’, ‘Mirror Hell: Bihyung’.[/list][*]‘Program bio-verification key ver.2’ is consumed from the second stage (stage 2) of Conquest Program Ver.2.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Conquest Program Ver.2> operation area has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Conquest Program Ver.2 is a 1 player dungeon consisting of a total of 15 stages.[/*][*]Conquest Program Ver.2 can be cleared by defeating the boss monster within the time limit.[/*][*]In Conquest Program Ver.2, you can play dungeons that are opened in order by clearing each stage from stages 1 to 15.[/*][/list]
[b]Conquest Program Ver.2 information per stage[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fa579c527cc23beabfe63d962339b5d77c71fff8.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Conquest Program Ver.2> rewards have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can obtain clear rewards when you first clear each stage in the Conquest Program Ver.2 dungeon.[/*][*]The reward acquisition information of Conquest Program Ver.2 is saved per character.[/*][*]Main Rewards: Conquest Program Elite Pet Selectable Box ver.3, High Ranking Conquest Challenger Token, Name Tag Ticket: The medal of the honorable conqueror Ver.2, Retro Phase Wing from the city of Dusk, Shadow Footprint, Emote Ticket: Joyful Noah/Sad Noah/Flustered Noah.[/*][/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Conquest Program Ver.2> shop has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*][Conquest Token] tab has been added to <Shop - Pheasant> NPC > Normal Shop.[/*][*]You can exchange reward items with a ‘High Ranking Conquest Challenger Token’ acquired through Clear Reward above a certain level.[/*][*]Main items: Conquest Awakening Strain Selectable Box (30. LV), T4 Platinum Chip Selectable Box, Conquest Unique Accessory Selectable Box, etc.[/*][/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The clear rank and my best clear time for <Conquest Program Ver.2> have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Conquest Program's dungeon clear ranking and my best clear time are recorded for each stage.[/*][*]In the Clear Ranking UI, the records of the three players with the fastest clear times among all players are displayed.[/*][*]You can check your best clear time in the My Best Clear Time UI.[/*][*]The clear rank of the Conquest Program is all reset at 4 a.m. on the 1st of every month.[/*][*]Conquest Program clear information per stage is saved on a per-character basis.[/*][/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The guide for <Conquest Program Ver.2> has been added.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. TCP Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[list]※ Improvements have been made to the phenomenon where there is a large difference in TCP depending on the battle type when wearing equipment of a similar level, and the phenomenon where there is a large difference in monster attack damage depending on the battle type at a similar TCP level.[/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Hybrid Characters' skill coefficients have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character: Yuri, Violet, Bai, Cheolsu Kim, Lucy[/*][/list]

[b]Skill Coefficient Adjustment Details[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/81f81836e5056fd606fa8d4c16c75104a20ee245.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The TCP coefficients of some characters have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character: Seha, Sylvi, J, Misteltein, Nata, Levia, Harpy, Tina, Wolfgang, Luna, Soma, Seth, Mirae, Cheolsu Kim, Eunha, Lucy, Aeri[/*][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Lucky Cards Game[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 'Lucky Cards’ game has been added. (~Until MA on Jul 10th, 2024)[/b][/color]
[list][*]The ‘Lucky Cards’ game screen is displayed by clicking the [Lucky Cards] menu in the upper right corner during the event period.[/*][*]You can open Lucky Cards by consuming <Lucky Card> material items on the ‘Lucky Cards’ game screen.[/*][*]You can obtain one from the appearable reward item by opening Lucky Cards.[/*][*]Reward items obtained by opening Lucky Cards are marked as ‘Reward Complete’ from the appearable Reward item.[/*][*]If you obtain all appearable reward items, you can obtain ‘SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear’ as a completion reward.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Pre-Notice for Renewal of UNION Camp Reward & UMP Shop Products
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance of the changes to the UNION Camp Reward and UMP Shop products, which will be applied during the maintenance on June 5th, 2024.

Please check the following information for more details.

[color=#FFAC1C][b]■ Pre-Notice for Renewal of UNION Camp Reward & UMP Shop Products[/b][/color]

[b]Schedule[/b]: During maintenance on June 5th, 2024

[b]Details[/b]:
[list][*] Among the harvest rewards for ‘Rainbow Tree’ and ‘Rainbow Tree [Elite]’, which are Garden attendance rewards, ‘Malek Crystal’ will be changed to ‘Gear Booster Fuel I’.

[color=#FFAE42][b]1. Event Overview[/b][/color]

[table][tr][td]
[b]What are [Fireworks]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*][Fireworks] are event items that are only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period.[/*][*]Using [Fireworks] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are [Festival Points]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points have been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].[/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival] Server Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The[b] [/b]Server Buff[b] [/b]applies buff effects to all players and all characters.[/*][*]The Server Buff is stacked up to level 10 and will give better buff effects as the level goes up.[/*][*]All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival Gift] Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The Buff is acquired when using Cash Shop Firework (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, Wildhüter, and Rattus)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are some other benefits?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]Collect ‘Fireworks Event Souvenirs’ every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain the Hip-hot Street Crew outfit and other exclusive rewards![/*][*]The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards![/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What determines the ranks?[/b]
[/td][td][list]The ranking is determined by the accumulation of [Festival Points] attributed to each character, with rewards allocated to Ranks 1 through 5[/list][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Known Issue Notice – May 9th [Additional Update as of May 16th]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of a known issue following the May 9th maintenance.

It has come to our attention that there are incorrect text displays in some dialogues and to Sylvi's Noble Serenade costume name, along with Noble Serenade being missing from the Costume Book. We would like to inform that these issues will be addressed and corrected during the scheduled maintenance on May 22nd.

[table][tr]

[b]Additional Update as of May 16th[/b]

We have identified an issue where the "Name Tag Ticket - Signet of the One who Chained Up Gluttony" can be equipped on a character basis, which is not the intended functionality. This issue will be resolved during the May 22nd maintenance.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we address this matter.

[/tr][/table]
If you have any further concerns or questions, please send us an email to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/09e80334f73f4ab5dc983f95743d961b7394fa33.png[/img][/url]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Option Cube[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Option Cubes have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Skill Cube New Option ‘Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase Damage’ has been added.[/*][*]New high-level Option Cube (Lv.5, Lv.6) for 3kinds of skill cube option ‘Air Strike Damage’, ‘Back Attack Damage’, and ‘Chase Damage’ have been added.[/*][*]New Option Skill Cube is acquirable by using Option Cube Box Item or Conversion.[/*][*]You can also obtain it using the selectable/probability-type option cube box you have acquired before the maintenance on May 8th, 2024.[/*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7aa4bbed3221daff07745824b9baf7ee35128b59.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Legion Program Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Legion Program Dungeon's Weekly Entrance Count Restriction has been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon: Legion Program - 6 kinds: INSECTAN/DEEPSEA/MACHINERY/WILD/IRREGULAR/INFERNAL[/*][list][*] [b]Before[/b]: can enter 6 dungeons once a week for each dungeon, for a total of 6 times.
[*] [b]After[/b]: can choose from 6 dungeons and enter a total of twice a week.[/list][*]The rewards available for clearing the dungeon once have been increased, so the reward level available for clearing the weekly Legion Program dungeon is the same as before the update.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Crew Mission Achievement Count and Reward regarding Legion Program Dungeon Clear have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Achievement Count Change : Legion Program Dungeon Clear 7times → Once[/*][*]Acquire Reward Change : Unidentified Epic Option Random Cube *1 → *3[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Dungeon Usage Convenience Improvement [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Proceed to Next Ops’ Dungeon has been added or changed in some dungeons.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon & Dungeon where to move when 'proceed to Next Ops' Information.[/*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/37bbfb34ecdf214befeecb7b41dcde2276f953da.png[/img]
[*]If there is no entry count restriction for the dungeon you are moving to, clicking ‘Proceed to Next Ops’ will not move the dungeon.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. 5th Promotion Period Shortening[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Target number of ‘Solomon's Trial’ dungeon clear during Promotion Quest proceeding has been decreased.[/b][/color]
[list][*]([b]Before[/b]) Once - 5times - Once while Quest Proceeding  →   ([b]After[/b]) Once - Twice - Once[/*][*]In accordance with the Promotion Period shortening adjustment, the use of ‘Sector Pass - Solomon’s Trial’ has been changed to not be available. Also, the recipe for ‘Sector Pass Selectable Box ver.2.1’, which uses the ‘Sector Pass - Solomon’s Trial’ item as a material, has been added.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Gate Keeper Gear Item Farming Alleviation[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some of the material item amount and consumed credits required for craft and upgrade of Gate Keeper Module and Trinket Gear Item have been decreased.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Material Item: Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residue[/*][*]For the crafting of Gate Keeper modules and Trinket Gear and upgrades at all stages, the consumption of target material items has been reduced by 90% and credit consumption by 50% compared to before.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Character Passive Skill Change[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Character Defense Stat-related passive skill detail and figures have been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Skill:  Comprehensive Defense Training, Defense Training : Black Hands, Phase Armor, Barrier[/*][*]([b]Before[/b]) Additional Physical/Psi Defense Rate → ([b]After[/b]) Physical/Psi Defense[/*][*]Changes[/*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/2228f2669d98dacaef26891272bcf6b26fa0f9d1.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ An error that skill is being canceled when entering the arrow key while using J Character's [Far-Infrared Heat] skill has been fixed. [/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ An error that skill voice is not played when party member uses [Empowered State/Phase Force Hyperflow] skill has been fixed. [/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ An error that the attack judgment maintains and gives damage to the character when Night Maze [Dark night rabbit] Monsters' flee motion is being played has been fixed. [/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ An error that Ranking > Total Combat Power > Monthly Ranking was displayed abnormally has been fixed. [/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶  An issue where the location of the party pop-up changes when a dungeon retry is canceled due to a party member not being able to enter the dungeon has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The resolution issue that occurs in some resolution settings has been fixed. [/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ An issue where the In Wonderland login screen was cut off has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Sales of the Prime Agent/Fatal Crew/Shadow Agent free pass package has been ended.[/b][/color]

tags.feature: ▶ New Option Cubes have been added.
Skill Cube New Option ‘Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase Damage’ has been added.
New high-level Option Cube (Lv.5, Lv.6) for 3kinds of skill cube option ‘Air Strike Damage’, ‘Back Attack Damage’, and ‘Chase Damage’ have been added.
New Option Skill Cube is acquirable by using Option Cube Box Item or Conversion.
You can also obtain it using the selectable/probability-type option cube box you have acquired before the maintenance on May 8th, 2024.

tags.balance_change: ▶ Legion Program Dungeon's Weekly Entrance Count Restriction has been adjusted.
Target Dungeon: Legion Program - 6 kinds: INSECTAN/DEEPSEA/MACHINERY/WILD/IRREGULAR/INFERNAL
[b] Before[/b]: can enter 6 dungeons once a week for each dungeon, for a total of 6 times.
[b] After[/b]: can choose from 6 dungeons and enter a total of twice a week.
The rewards available for clearing the dungeon once have been increased, so the reward level available for clearing the weekly Legion Program dungeon is the same as before the update.
▶ Crew Mission Achievement Count and Reward regarding Legion Program Dungeon Clear have been adjusted.
Achievement Count Change : Legion Program Dungeon Clear 7times → Once
Acquire Reward Change : Unidentified Epic Option Random Cube *1 → *3

tags.feature: ▶ ‘Proceed to Next Ops’ Dungeon has been added or changed in some dungeons.

tags.balance_change: ▶ Target number of ‘Solomon's Trial’ dungeon clear during Promotion Quest proceeding has been decreased.
([b]Before[/b]) Once - 5times - Once while Quest Proceeding  →   ([b]After[/b]) Once - Twice - Once

In accordance with the Promotion Period shortening adjustment, the use of ‘Sector Pass - Solomon’s Trial’ has been changed to not be available. Also, the recipe for ‘Sector Pass Selectable Box ver.2.1’, which uses the ‘Sector Pass - Solomon’s Trial’ item as a material, has been added.
▶ Some of the material item amount and consumed credits required for craft and upgrade of Gate Keeper Module and Trinket Gear Item have been decreased.
For the crafting of Gate Keeper modules and Trinket Gear and upgrades at all stages, the consumption of target material items has been reduced by 90% and credit consumption by 50% compared to before.
▶ Character Defense Stat-related passive skill detail and figures have been changed.
([b]Before[/b]) Additional Physical/Psi Defense Rate → ([b]After[/b]) Physical/Psi Defense

tags.feature: ▶ Count D's Program for New and Returning Players: Enhanced Level Achievement Rewards
After the May 8th, 2024 maintenance, eligible new or returning players can now receive Next-Gen gears upon reaching level 92 for their character.
If a player hasn't logged in for at least 30 days and then logs back in, they're considered a returning player.
Upon opening the 'New/Returned Closer’s Level-up Box Lv.92' item, you can get more gear from the ‘UNION Next-Gen Gear Full Set Box’.
The 'Union Next-Gen Gear Full Set Box' will be sent to your account through in-game mail during the maintenance on May 8th, 2024.
Each UNION Next-Gen Box item obtained from the 'UNION Next-Gen Gear Full Set Box' will be automatically removed 30 days after acquisition.
Please note that any unused 'UNION Next-Gen Gear Full Set Box' items will be removed on June 5th, 2024, at 7:00 AM UTC. Please make sure to acquire the gears before this date.
▶ Empowered State/Phase Force Hyperflow Skill Tooltip's decription has been improved.

tags.balance_change: ▶ The Attack Power of some Boss Monsters has been adjusted downward.
Sylvi Character [Space Elasticity] Skill Tooltip has been modified to match the skill function.
Added: Increase damage by adding [Special skill: Phase Ductility] level, to the skill level
Sylvi Character [Support: Psychic Satellite] Skill Tooltip has been modified to match the skill function.
Added: 'Guarantee Condition : Air Strike'

notes.content:
[h2][b]Count D's Program for New & Returning Agents has been Updated![/b][/h2]
[i]Exciting news, Agents! Count D's Program for New & Returning Agents has undergone an update.[/i]
[i]A new level-up box awaits, packed with Next-Gen gears![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9958d24825258e36cf4f6522f2a4c3a27f828970.jpg[/img]

[table][tr][td][h3][b]Main Improvements[/b][/h3][/td][/tr][tr][td]

Count D welcomes new and returning Agents with exciting perks!
Earn rewards when completing exclusive missions and receive benefits as you level up.

[color=#FFE135][b]▶ Count D's Program for New and Returning Players: Enhanced Level Achievement Rewards[/b][/color]
[list][*]After the May 8th, 2024 maintenance, eligible new or returning players can now receive Next-Gen gears upon reaching level 92 for their character.[list][*]If a player hasn't logged in for at least 30 days and then logs back in, they're considered a returning player.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Upon opening the 'New/Returned Closer’s Level-up Box Lv.92' item, you can get more gear from the ‘UNION Next-Gen Gear Full Set Box’.[/*][/list]
[table][tr][td][color=#FFAC1C][b]UNION Next-Gen Gear Full Set Box[/b][/color]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
+16 UNION Next-Gen Core Box
+15 UNION Next-Gen Module Box
+15 UNION Next-Gen Amplifier Box
+15 UNION Next-Gen Trinket Box
UNION Next-Gen Trigger Box
[i]*All UNION Next-Gen Gear Boxes are untradable and cannot be moved to the Account Bank.[/i][/td][/tr]
