notes.title: [Developer Letter] Contents, Improvements, Special News!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Developer Letter[/b][/h1]

Hello Agents. It's been a while since I greeted you.

This is Hyun-jun Kang, the PD of Closers. I hope everyone is doing well.

I have been meaning to reach out more often, but I wanted to make sure we had everything in order before sharing updates with our Closers community. We appreciate your patience. The development team and I are doing our best to make Closers even better. This developer letter is our way of giving you a preview of the content that will be introduced from June onwards, as well as the new content planned for the second half of the year. First, let me introduce the updates for June.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bba760869a3374e31d28a8356fe7500352171509.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]1. Conquest Program Ver.2[/b][/h3]
The Conquest program, which received much love from our Closers community, will be returning in June with Version 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9b57287940cbc576b437948b037a12b7bd14e4f7.png[/img]
As you've been waiting patiently, Version 2 of the Conquest program is returning in June. In Version 2, we aim to provide a more intense and combat-focused experience that highlights the abilities of your trained characters. Now, let me briefly explain the changes in Ver.2.

Firstly, we've changed the battle format from 2:1 to 1:1. This adjustment aims to remove elements that hindered control in the previous Conquest program. It minimizes interruptions to the flow of character skills caused by monsters dodging skills or two monsters using skills simultaneously or individually. In Version 2, you'll be able to fully enjoy the combat environment where you can showcase the specs and control advantages of your nurtured characters.

Additionally, we've added conditions within dungeons where resurrection is not possible, and buff items like the "Piece of Cake" cannot be used. This decision was made to address the imbalance caused by differences in resurrection times between characters and costume motions, as well as to ensure that dungeon clearances are not determined by resurrection or the possession of certain consumables, which goes against the direction of the content.

Overall, in comparison to Version 1, we've designed Version 2 to accentuate the specs and control elements of characters more prominently. Furthermore, to give it significance as challenge content, we've included emoticon tickets and prepared rewards that can only be obtained through the Conquest program. We kindly ask for your active participation, Agents.

 
[h3][b]2. Character Skill Remake: Yuri and J[/b][/h3]
The "Skill Remake" that we first introduced during 'CLOSERS CHANNEL ON EP.1' is set to make its debut in June. Separate from balance patches, our goal is to provide meaningful changes and new experiences for each character, aiming to alter the structure and forms of their skills to offer a better gameplay experience.

The first characters to be showcased are Yuri and J from the Black Lambs team. Today, we'd like to give you a sneak peek at the revamped skills and some skill combo footage.

[table][tr][td]
[b]Yuri's Skill Combo Footages[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b79403e1a010a4ed12ce6ea4a2979066059370a3.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/671c46ed61ca2df673e7dec5dc538e2fb2dd02ba.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]
[b]J's Skill Combo Footages[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1c791bfd7d34ce8bdfdb45aaf584c7b02b36bfec.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/602a35af92b9a30faab3ac4d53e27428f4589e28.gif[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]

The goal of skill remake is to upgrade the quality of old skills' effects and enhance the usability of various skills, providing a new level of excitement in battles. In addition to Yuri and J, skill remakes for other characters will be continuously carried out, following the order of the teams. While we aim to update as many characters as possible in a timely manner, please understand that it requires careful development processes to present them in a highly polished state. We appreciate your patience and support as we strive to showcase each character's impressive actions after the diligent efforts put into the development process.
 
[h3][b]3. Ancient Dragon Historic Site New Dungeon: Tiamat of the Beginning[/b][/h3]
Following the introduction of "Mirage Repeated," the new dungeon "Tiamat of the Beginning" in the Ancient Dragon Historic Site will be unveiled for the first time since then, with an update scheduled for June.

[table][tr][td][b]Tiamat of The Beginning Dungeon Background Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/2dc940b924320bd35af763b6748dae2c09b42bb8.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Tiamat of the Beginning Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a070513064d8f7797331928f6db26add75fdc3f3.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td][b]Tiamat of the Beginning Talk-Face[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fe633ebead5a03e7e4f4aa932f5d1720b21535be.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

In the upcoming new dungeon, we have planned for a different dungeon experience from what you've seen before, and we are currently preparing to present a high-quality appearance. Additionally, the transformed Tiamat awaits you in a new form. The intriguing story behind why Tiamat has become so small and cute, as well as its purpose, awaits you. We appreciate your anticipation for this exciting narrative.

With the addition of the new dungeon, there have been some changes. Whenever a new dungeon is added, it can be challenging to practice the gimmicks and patterns of the new monsters due to the dungeon entry limit. To address this, we have tentatively introduced a [Practice Dungeon] where you can research patterns and strategies without being limited by entry counts. We believe this will greatly reduce the initial burden of the challenge by allowing players to confirm monster gimmicks and patterns without the pressure of limited attempts. We appreciate your interest and participation in this addition.

Alongside the new dungeon, a new chip, the 'Tiamat of the Beginning Chip,' will be introduced. We aim to provide sufficient motivation for playing the new dungeon.

Next, I would like to introduce some of the improvements currently being prepared for a more enjoyable gameplay experience for all Agents.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/336cf15bf160b04d45877aab2bcf7b85f414fb7d.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]1. Ancient Dragon Historic Site Play Improvement[/b][/h3]
With the update to the new Ancient Dragon Historic Site dungeon, there will also be a revamp of the existing Ancient Dragon Historic Site dungeons.

Rewards from the old dungeons will be partially transferred to the latest dungeons, and some dungeons will be consolidated to reduce exhaustion. Additionally, the number of entries required for gameplay will be reduced, and rewards will be increased accordingly.

Please wait a bit longer, and we will introduce a more streamlined Ancient Dragon Historic Site gameplay for you to enjoy.
 
[h3][b]2. Chip System Convenience Improvement and Chip Overclock Balancing[/b][/h3]
Some conveniences in the chip system will be improved. Changes will be made to the chip crafting UI to allow users to see the crafting list at a glance, and some tab names will be updated to be more intuitive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/66d99ab70b49ddc9162ae58f72400deac85883ce.png[/img]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]

Additionally, we plan to add more crafting recipes to allow for the creation of more overclock chips. These recipes will be obtainable using resources acquired from the Tiamat Of The Beginning dungeon, enabling faster chip overclocking. The improvements to the chip system convenience and the addition of crafting recipes will be carried out simultaneously with the Ancient Dragon Historic Site update, so please look forward to it.

[h3][b]3. Inventory Improvement[/b][/h3]
You've been waiting for this for a long time, and I remember it being one of the most requested features. It's none other than inventory improvement.

It can be broadly divided into two parts: quantitative improvement and convenience improvement.

[b][u]1) Quantitative Improvement[/u][/b]
Currently, Closers utilizes a total of 5 tabs and 350 inventory slots. We have explored ways to increase this number, but we've concluded that it would inevitably impact the stability of the live servers with an unacceptable level of load. Given the complexity of the game system, a careful approach was necessary as any fundamental structural changes would be quite intricate.

Therefore, we've focused on practical improvements that can alleviate usability issues. One such improvement is the 'slot rearrangement' between tabs. Currently, the 'Mission' inventory tab is the least used, so by removing unnecessary items from here and adjusting the absolute usage, we can ultimately remove the 'Mission' inventory, thus adding 20 slots to other inventories. This results in a total of 360 slots utilized across 4 tabs, an increase of 10 slots from the previous setup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0847983d21c9a7cc05ff0ed876560d3bb0737d7d.png[/img]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]

To achieve this, items that were stored in the existing quest inventory and deemed useless, being only used in simple quests, will be removed. Items with utility, such as farming materials, will be moved to the 'Materials' tab. However, due to the possibility of the 'Materials' inventory becoming temporarily full during the update, some items will be relocated to the [Virtual Bank].

The [Virtual Bank] is a system created alongside inventory improvement. It's a new Bank format where items can only be stored but not used. Unfortunately, due to server overload concerns, this system cannot be permanently applied. After a certain period, we will announce the scheduled deletion date.

Additionally, credit account integration, an increase in account credit holdings, an increase in stackable item maximum quantities, and the addition of an inventory item locking feature will be implemented.

We're committed to enhancing your convenience and, above all, ensuring stability.


[b][u]2) Convenience Improvement[/u][/b]
Next, we're focusing on convenience improvements. You may have experienced inconvenience when crafting specific items or using consumables and materials, often needing to retrieve items from your account storage or logging in with another character to transfer items through the bank.

To eliminate this inconvenience, we're developing a system where Bank-stored materials can be used when crafting or performing similar actions. Most systems are considered to be enhanced to allow the use of items from both the inventory and warehouse, as well as the account storage, reducing many inconveniences.

Convenience improvements will be implemented after the quantitative improvements are updated and are also scheduled for the second half of the year.

 
[h3][b]4. Character Creation Window Enhancement[/b][/h3]
We plan to renovate the character creation window. After the update long ago, certain aspects may feel a bit outdated, so we're improving them to better convey the character's charm and information. With an increase in the size of skill video clips and the ability to view all characters' promotion illustrations, you'll have a clearer picture. This enhancement is slated for release in the latter half of the year.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/af0d3d79a64b2a165138ebdd8559bfbaf566aa7f.png[/img]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]
<< If you feel like the number of characters varies by team, you're not mistaken. >>
 
[h3][b]5. [Training Ground] Adding Defense Training Dummy[/b][/h3]
A "Defense Training Dummy" will be added to the training grounds.

The Defense Training Dummy is a dummy that replicates most of the attacks used by monsters, such as regular attacks, super armor crashes, and attacks that ignore invincibility, within a certain time frame. Skilled Closers can summon the Defense Training Dummy, while new Closers can observe the effects of monster attack patterns based on their visual cues.

The Defense Training Dummy is also scheduled for release in the latter half of the year.

Next, although it's a bit early, I'll introduce some new content planned for the latter half of the year along with ongoing optimization efforts.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3058a0b318711b7e9a5fbe6d2e4a1737f74d99f9.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. Optimization[/b][/h3]
The development team has been consistently working on optimizing the client. While you may not yet fully feel the effects, some optimizations have already been implemented, and work is underway to make optimizations that can be felt during gameplay. Specifically, we are addressing issues such as frame drops that occur in various situations, such as when staying in certain towns, when multiple monster respawns occur, or when using specific skills. These optimizations are scheduled to be completed by the latter half of the year. Once the updates are finalized, we will provide detailed information again. Please bear with us a little longer as we strive to make Closers gameplay more enjoyable by making sufficient improvements.

[h3][b]2. New Dungeon: Dragon King Hecatoncheir, Astarte[/b][/h3]
In the upcoming second half of the year, we are excited to introduce two new bosses in the latest dungeon. They are none other than 'Dragon King Hecatoncheir' and 'Astarte.'

[table][tr][td]
[b]Dragon King Hecatoncheir Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c180105a7067a9f959ff02e0013cc6083ec3d28c.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Dragon King Hecatoncheir Illustration[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b2ec52955197d58838e601950b7081de8f6a9970.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

Many Agents will surely recall the name 'Hecatoncheir.' Since the first season of the Black Lambs team, Legion Commander Hecatoncheir has been a figure of awe and respect. Now, in the upcoming second half of the year, he will finally reveal his true colors. How he returns from a state where he should have perished in the storyline, and why he appears in a slightly different form from what we knew, will all be unveiled in the update planned for the second half of this year.

[table][tr][td]
[b]Astarte Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e70097a9cef9fc40b6970cab7f8fc0c7756d4915.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Astarte Illustration[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a68a033d17f25d660515dac6a875f4742f07548d.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

Alongside the Dragon King Hecatoncheir, a new boss named 'Astarte' will also make her appearance. With her beautiful yet icy demeanor, one may wonder about her true identity. And what relationship does she have with Hecatoncheir? We kindly ask for the continued interest and support of all our beloved Agents.

This upcoming new boss dungeon is designed for a recommended party size of four. It will offer a gameplay experience different from the previous investigation teams or advance parties, aiming to minimize the shortcomings of the previous systems.

More details will be provided in the second half of the year.
 
[h3][b]3. 6th character of the Black Lambs Team: Ria Yoon[/b][/h3]
[table][tr][td][i]*The character name has been decided as "Yoon Ria" during the development process.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]
In the last "World Peace Plaza: Epilogue - Audio Movie," the silhouette of a new character mentioned by Hildagarde was revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4f6e7acaa2b6163c91fce61a1dc861503d011b47.png[/img]

This silhouette, as many Closers may have anticipated, belongs to the new character to be updated in the latter half of the year, 'Ria Yoon.'

'Ria Yoon' is the 6th member of the Black Lambs team. As a former idol with a unique phase force of 'Soundwave,' she is a rookie Closer who uses a microphone to defeat dimensional monsters. While we can't reveal too much yet, I'll share some glimpses of her appearance and skills, which I'm sure many Closers are eager to see.

[table][tr][td]
[b]Ria Yoon Illustration[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f62f85c06f155a2b4dfa38887b2ae584c47a8284.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Ria Yoon's Skill Combo Footage[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/42a014a3157e333dd2c9ad422328d88743f2d95f.gif[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]

As a new member of the Black Lambs, we kindly ask for your attention to see what contributions she will make. More detailed information will be provided in our next communication.

[table][tr][td][b]Ria Yoon Story Dungeon Background Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e90a8d584902f423d7242d1647bf6a0b02f7a95d.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

That's all for today's prepared content.

Thanks to the support of all Agents, Closers is moving forward toward the future. We ask for your continued support and encouragement to bring joy to all our Agents.

We'll be back with richer content next time. Thank you always.

Best Regards,
Kang PD.

tags.feature: The Conquest program, which received much love from our Closers community, will be returning in June with Version 2.
In Version 2, we aim to provide a more intense and combat-focused experience that highlights the abilities of your trained characters.

tags.balance_change: Firstly, we've changed the battle format from 2:1 to 1:1.
This adjustment aims to remove elements that hindered control in the previous Conquest program.
It minimizes interruptions to the flow of character skills caused by monsters dodging skills or two monsters using skills simultaneously or individually.

tags.feature: Additionally, we've added conditions within dungeons where resurrection is not possible, and buff items like the "Piece of Cake" cannot be used.

tags.balance_change: This decision was made to address the imbalance caused by differences in resurrection times between characters and costume motions, as well as to ensure that dungeon clearances are not determined by resurrection or the possession of certain consumables, which goes against the direction of the content.
Overall, in comparison to Version 1, we've designed Version 2 to accentuate the specs and control elements of characters more prominently.

tags.feature: Furthermore, to give it significance as challenge content, we've included emoticon tickets and prepared rewards that can only be obtained through the Conquest program.
The "Skill Remake" that we first introduced during 'CLOSERS CHANNEL ON EP.1' is set to make its debut in June.

Separate from balance patches, our goal is to provide meaningful changes and new experiences for each character, aiming to alter the structure and forms of their skills to offer a better gameplay experience.
The first characters to be showcased are Yuri and J from the Black Lamb team.
The goal of skill remake is to upgrade the quality of old skills' effects and enhance the usability of various skills, providing a new level of excitement in battles.
In addition to Yuri and J, skill remakes for other characters will be continuously carried out, following the order of the teams.

Following the introduction of "Mirage Repeated," the new dungeon "Tiamat of the Beginning" in the Ancient Dragon Historic Site will be unveiled for the first time since then, with an update scheduled for June.
In the upcoming new dungeon, we have planned for a different dungeon experience from what you've seen before, and we are currently preparing to present a high-quality appearance.
Additionally, the transformed Tiamat awaits you in a new form.
The intriguing story behind why Tiamat has become so small and cute, as well as its purpose, awaits you.
With the addition of the new dungeon, there have been some changes.
Whenever a new dungeon is added, it can be challenging to practice the gimmicks and patterns of the new monsters due to the dungeon entry limit.
To address this, we have tentatively introduced a [Practice Dungeon] where you can research patterns and strategies without being limited by entry counts.
We believe this will greatly reduce the initial burden of the challenge by allowing players to confirm monster gimmicks and patterns without the pressure of limited attempts.
Alongside the new dungeon, a new chip, the 'Tiamat of the Beginning Chip,' will be introduced.
We aim to provide sufficient motivation for playing the new dungeon.
With the update to the new Ancient Dragon Historic Site dungeon, there will also be a revamp of the existing Ancient Dragon Historic Site dungeons.

tags.balance_change: Rewards from the old dungeons will be partially transferred to the latest dungeons, and some dungeons will be consolidated to reduce exhaustion.
Additionally, the number of entries required for gameplay will be reduced, and rewards will be increased accordingly.

tags.feature: Please wait a bit longer, and we will introduce a more streamlined Ancient Dragon Historic Site gameplay for you to enjoy.
Some conveniences in the chip system will be improved.
Changes will be made to the chip crafting UI to allow users to see the crafting list at a glance, and some tab names will be updated to be more intuitive.
Additionally, we plan to add more crafting recipes to allow for the creation of more overclock chips.
These recipes will be obtainable using resources acquired from the Tiamat Of The Beginning dungeon, enabling faster chip overclocking.
The improvements to the chip system convenience and the addition of crafting recipes will be carried out simultaneously with the Ancient Dragon Historic Site update, so please look forward to it.
You've been waiting for this for a long time, and I remember it being one of the most requested features.
It's none other than inventory improvement.
It can be broadly divided into two parts: quantitative improvement and convenience improvement.
Currently, Closers utilizes a total of 5 tabs and 350 inventory slots.

tags.balance_change: We have explored ways to increase this number, but we've concluded that it would inevitably impact the stability of the live servers with an unacceptable level of load.
Given the complexity of the game system, a careful approach was necessary as any fundamental structural changes would be quite intricate.

tags.feature: Therefore, we've focused on practical improvements that can alleviate usability issues.
One such improvement is the 'slot rearrangement' between tabs.

tags.balance_change: Currently, the 'Mission' inventory tab is the least used, so by removing unnecessary items from here and adjusting the absolute usage, we can ultimately remove the 'Mission' inventory, thus adding 20 slots to other inventories.
This results in a total of 360 slots utilized across 4 tabs, an increase of 10 slots from the previous setup.

tags.feature: To achieve this, items that were stored in the existing quest inventory and deemed useless, being only used in simple quests, will be removed.
Items with utility, such as farming materials, will be moved to the 'Materials' tab.
However, due to the possibility of the 'Materials' inventory becoming temporarily full during the update, some items will be relocated to the [Virtual Bank].
The [Virtual Bank] is a system created alongside inventory improvement.
It's a new Bank format where items can only be stored but not used.

tags.balance_change: Unfortunately, due to server overload concerns, this system cannot be permanently applied.

tags.feature: After a certain period, we will announce the scheduled deletion date.

Additionally, credit account integration, an increase in account credit holdings, an increase in stackable item maximum quantities, and the addition of an inventory item locking feature will be implemented.
We're committed to enhancing your convenience and, above all, ensuring stability.
Next, we're focusing on convenience improvements.

You may have experienced inconvenience when crafting specific items or using consumables and materials, often needing to retrieve items from your account storage or logging in with another character to transfer items through the bank.
To eliminate this inconvenience, we're developing a system where Bank-stored materials can be used when crafting or performing similar actions.
Most systems are considered to be enhanced to allow the use of items from both the inventory and warehouse, as well as the account storage, reducing many inconveniences.
Convenience improvements will be implemented after the quantitative improvements are updated and are also scheduled for the second half of the year.
We plan to renovate the character creation window.
After the update long ago, certain aspects may feel a bit outdated, so we're improving them to better convey the character's charm and information.
With an increase in the size of skill video clips and the ability to view all characters' promotion illustrations, you'll have a clearer picture.
This enhancement is slated for release in the latter half of the year.
A "Defense Training Dummy" will be added to the training grounds.

The Defense Training Dummy is a dummy that replicates most of the attacks used by monsters, such as regular attacks, super armor crashes, and attacks that ignore invincibility, within a certain time frame.
Skilled Closers can summon the Defense Training Dummy, while new Closers can observe the effects of monster attack patterns based on their visual cues.
The Defense Training Dummy is also scheduled for release in the latter half of the year.
The development team has been consistently working on optimizing the client.

tags.balance_change: While you may not yet fully feel the effects, some optimizations have already been implemented, and work is underway to make optimizations that can be felt during gameplay.

Specifically, we are addressing issues such as frame drops that occur in various situations, such as when staying in certain towns, when multiple monster respawns occur, or when using specific skills.
These optimizations are scheduled to be completed by the latter half of the year.

tags.feature: Once the updates are finalized, we will provide detailed information again.
Please bear with us a little longer as we strive to make Closers gameplay more enjoyable by making sufficient improvements.
In the upcoming second half of the year, we are excited to introduce two new bosses in the latest dungeon.
They are none other than 'Dragon King Hecatoncheir' and 'Astarte.'
Many Agents will surely recall the name 'Hecatoncheir.'
Since the first season of the Black Lambs team, Legion Commander Hecatoncheir has been a figure of awe and respect.
Now, in the upcoming second half of the year, he will finally reveal his true colors.

How he returns from a state where he should have perished in the storyline, and why he appears in a slightly different form from what we knew, will all be unveiled in the update planned for the second half of this year.
Alongside the Dragon King Hecatoncheir, a new boss named 'Astarte' will also make her appearance.
With her beautiful yet icy demeanor, one may wonder about her true identity.
And what relationship does she have with Hecatoncheir?
We kindly ask for the continued interest and support of all our beloved Agents.
This upcoming new boss dungeon is designed for a recommended party size of four.
It will offer a gameplay experience different from the previous investigation teams or advance parties, aiming to minimize the shortcomings of the previous systems.
More details will be provided in the second half of the year.
In the last "World Peace Plaza: Epilogue - Audio Movie," the silhouette of a new character mentioned by Hildagarde was revealed.
This silhouette, as many Closers may have anticipated, belongs to the new character to be updated in the latter half of the year, 'Ria Yoon.'
'Ria Yoon' is the 6th member of the Black Lambs team.
As a former idol with a unique phase force of 'Soundwave,' she is a rookie Closer who uses a microphone to defeat dimensional monsters.
While we can't reveal too much yet, I'll share some glimpses of her appearance and skills, which I'm sure many Closers are eager to see.
As a new member of the Black Lambs, we kindly ask for your attention to see what contributions she will make.
More detailed information will be provided in our next communication.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Break Challenge[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Contents ‘Break Challenge’ has been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Break Challenge’ Dungeon can be entered by the new NPC <Break Challenge Entry - Queen> at ‘Noah's Museum’ Town.
[*]Entry NPC <Break Challenge Entry - Queen> is displayed to the character of 95lv or higher who has cleared the ‘And Holy Lance’ Quest.
[*]‘Break Challenge’ contents have been added to the Game Farming Guide, UNION Watch - Dungeon Mission, and Achievement. 
[list][*]‘Break Challenge’ Achievement Main Reward: ‘Name Tag Ticket: Signet of the One who Chained Up Gluttony’, ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’[/list]
[/list][color=#ffae42][b]▶ 4 types of ‘Break Challenge: Fly King’ themed Dungeon have been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Break Challenge: Fly King’ themed 3 Elite Dungeons and 1 Challenge Dungeon have been added. 
[*]‘Infinite Gluttony ticket’, which is the entrance material for Challenge Dungeon, is acquirable from Elite Dungeon. 
[*] 3 types of Break Challenge Elite Dungeon can proceed consecutively when clearing the dungeon, by [Proceed to Next Ops]. 
[*] Elite Dungeon [Proceed to Next Ops] Order:  Campus of Singing Deception → Flesh-eating Streets → Island of the Strong
[/list]
[b][Dungeon Information][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/de34b636d4a45a5db80812d38471d28a7b0fa5ce.png[/img]
[i]*Basic Resurrection Restriction count is 3 times and Basic limit time is 5 minutes, without proceeding to ‘Chapter of Infinite Gluttony’ Challenge Dungeon's restriction adjustment. [/i]

[b][Clear Rank Reward by Dungeon][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a0c532ddbe520a9dd78c76491cc0b8a8b727d58f.png[/img]
[i]*[color=#5f95cc]Clear Rank Reward[/color] can be acquired at a set probability depending on the clear rank.[/i]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Restriction Adjustment System has been added to the ‘Break Challenge’ Dungeon. [/b][/color]
[list][*]Challenge Dungeon of ‘Break Challenge’ can adjust the dungeon difficulty by restriction adjustment, and the acquirable point is changed when clearing the dungeon depending on that. [/list]
[b][Restriction Adjustment Details][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/451ee168708a3e1e0c5b3b307f0c9254b28f0d17.png[/img]
[i]*Depending on the restriction adjustment, some abilities in the character information window > Details within the dungeon may appear as negative numbers or the character's damage may be applied as 0.[/i]

Please note that this is a result based on restriction adjustment and is not an error when using the game.
[list][*]The acquired challenge Point from Dungeon Clear is not accumulated but will be renewed as the Best Point within the period. 
[*]Acquired challenge Points can be checked at 'My Point', at the bottom left of the dungeon entrance screen.  
[*]Point Reward is acquirable according to the obtained challenge Point. 
[*]Main Point Reward Item: Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic),  Glutton King's Memory Crystal, Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residue
[*]Point Reward is acquirable per challenge point reward, once per character.
[*]Challenge Point and Reward acquire count is reset on every Saturday at AM 4:00.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. New Trigger[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 2 types of New Trigger have been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Gluttony Execution’, and ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ Trigger are acquirable by playing Break Challenge ‘Challenge Dungeon’ or crafting and opening ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’. 
[*]‘Gluttony Execution’, and ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ Triggers are acquired with an unappraised status when initially acquired, and Tuning Option and Fixed Granted Option are granted when proceeding with Identify Item.  
[/list]
[b][2 types of Trigger][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d380b5ee17ebc0457e598655837696994df43013.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Trigger Fixed Granted Option has been added. [/b][/color]

[list]
[*]Trigger Fixed Granted Option Item: ‘Gluttony Execution’, ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’
[*]Fixed Granted Option is at the top of the Tuning Option, and a total of 10 options are available with grades of 6 (Grade 1~6).  
[*]The probability of the appearance of all fixed granted options and grades is the same, and the same options can be obtained as duplicates.
[*]The fixed granted option cannot be checked on an item that is in an unappraised state and can be checked when appraising the item (identify item).
[/list]
[b][Fixed Granted Option Type and Grade][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/17eace38ad8ea936ec8accc609cc2e915e4abb3f.png[/img]

[b][Glutton King's Trigger Box Specification][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/438e68e019c7e78cf26c5c3b234738a4326f2379.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Trigger Tuning Transfer[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Trigger Tuning Transfer System has been added.[/b][/color]

[list]
[*]‘Trigger Tuning Transfer’ is a system that allows you to transfer the tuning option of a trigger to another trigger.
[*]Available items for Trigger Tuning Transfer: ‘Gluttony Execution’, ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’
[*]It can be proceeded by right-clicking the New Consumables Item ‘Trigger Tuning Extractor’ for Trigger Tuning transfer, or NPC <Crafting/Salvaging/Tuning Transfer - Allan>.
[*]Tuning information of ‘Extract Target Gear’ can be transferred to ‘Transfer Target Gear’ at the Tuning Transfer System window. 
[*]When Tuning transfer, Credits and ‘Trigger Tuning Extractor’ Item is consumed.  
[*]When Tuning transfer, ‘Extract Target Gear’ is destroyed, and the tuning count of ‘Transfer Target Gear’ remains the same as before tuning.
[*]While using the tuning transfer system, Item Remove, Sort, Appraisal, Costume Locker Open, and Search functions cannot be used.
[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Trigger Fuel System Removal[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Trigger Fuel System has been removed. [/b][/color]

[list]
[*]The effect activated through Trigger fuel activation has been transferred to the Basic Option.
[*]The Original Trigger ON/OFF button has been changed to a preset button.
[*]The supply source where trigger combustion can be obtained has been removed from existing content.
[list][*]Craft machine - Trigger Combustion Recipe, NPC Shop, Monster drop, Reward and more[/list]
[*]‘Trigger Combustion’ and ‘Trigger Combustion - Boost’ Items have been changed to be available for sale at the shop. 
[*]The ‘Trigger Combustion - Epic’ Item has been changed to be unavailable to trade on the Black Market.
[list][*]Items registered in the black market before the maintenance on 4/11 (Thursday) will be rejected after the maintenance. You must receive the rejected 'Trigger Combustion - Epic’ item to re-register the items in bulk.[/list]
[*]The New Craft recipe has been added for the 'Break Challenge Trigger Material Selectable Box' that uses the ‘Trigger Combustion - Epic’ Item as a material.
[*]The ‘Gluttony King’s Memory Crystal’ item has been sent by mail according to the trigger fuel figure activated before the maintenance on 4/11 (Thursday).

[/list][h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Item Appraising System Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Item Appraising System (Identify items) has been improved.  [/b][/color]

[*]Item appraising effect pops up when right-clicking the unappraised item has been removed.

[*]Appraisal of items in inventory has been changed to be completed immediately once pressing the OK button in the appraised price combined cost information window.

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]Other Updates[/b][/color][/h3]

[/b][list][*]Target Quest: Noah's Museum - Treasury for Memories of Mankind, Museum of the Dawn - Truth in the Light[/*][/list][b]▶ Some patterns from 2 types of <Operation : Flame Wave> 4-player mission dungeons; ‘One-eyed Chaser: Kang Lim’ and ‘Mirror Paradise: Bihyung’ have been alleviated.

▶ The dialogue of NPC <Pheasant> in <Operation: Flame Wave> has been added.

▶ The gauge figure required to use dungeon skills in the ‘Flame King Advance party’ dungeon has been alleviated.

Authentication to your registered email is required during this process for security purposes.[/*][*]The button for setting up the second password is located on the lower right part of the start screen.
[/*][*]The same authentication process is required for changing/removing a registered second password after setting up.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Bug Fix[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[b]▶ An issue where, after registering a pet in Your Room and proceeding with exploration, the game would end if the pet used for exploration was re-equipped, has been fixed.    

▶ An issue where checking the data file didn't work properly by Game launch window -  clicking the magnifying glass icon has been fixed.  

▶ An issue where the game would end when using all of the pet's skills in a dungeon after equipping a pet with only basic combat skills has been fixed.[/b][list][*]Target Pets: Mini Scavenger, Mini Snatcher,  Mini Kryzaloid, Andras' Anchor, Long Cat Winter Edition, Lucky Chick[/*][/list][b]▶ An issue where UI windows, images, and texts were abnormally exposed in some resolutions has been improved.  

▶ An issue where keyboard input did not work properly in the character selection screen has been fixed. 

▶ Some missing story character dialogue scripts and voices have been fixed.   

▶ An issue where character Seha's skill [Fire Grinder] isn't activated when using 6 stacks of Burst has been fixed. 

▶ The tooltip notation for the Cheolsu Kim character’s [Special Skill: Tactical Stance] will be modified.

▶ An issue of being banned when using a pet's automatic skill in a dungeon after equipping a pet that does not have a pet manual skill has been fixed.

▶ An issue where damage was output abnormally when using the Lucy character's Peaceful Ninisina skill in the air has been fixed. 

▶ An issue where the Z-axis movement speed does not increase when using the Eunha character's Fallen Starlight skill has been fixed.

▶ An issue that the resulting item was incorrect when salvaging the Mini Flame's Daughter pet has been fixed.

▶ An issue where salvage materials were obtained abnormally when salvaging certain gear in VVIP status has been fixed.[list][*][Updated] Compensations have been sent to respective accounts as of March 28th.[/*][/list]
▶ Yuri's 'Special Skill: Shift' has been adjusted to resolve the disconnection issues.

▶ Fused Phase Wings Description for Level 14 has been updated: "Damage increase/PF Charge Speed +100% when in Empowered State".[/b]

notes.title: Pre-Notice for Changes in Flame Wave Reward Claim Count
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that after the maintenance on March 27th, 2024, some changes related to Flame Wave reward acquisition are planned. Please check the following information below.

[h3][b]■ Changes related to obtaining Flame Wave rewards:[/b][/h3]
[olist][*] Flame Wave's 4-person mission rewards can now be obtained twice instead of just once.
[*] The number of times Flame Wave’s 4-person mission rewards can be obtained is shared with the Normal dungeon. 
[list][*] (For example, if you obtain a reward twice in a Normal dungeon on the same day, you cannot obtain a reward from Hard mode)[/list][*] Flame Wave’s map dungeon location is refreshed once.
[list][*] (The type and location of the map displayed before maintenance may change.)[/list][*] If you receive the 4-person mission reward before the regular maintenance, you can only receive the 4-person mission reward once after the reset at 4:00 AM UTC on the day of the maintenance.[/olist]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events to all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

If you have any further concerns or questions, please send us an email to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

notes.title: Pre-Notice: End of Conquest Program Season 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that after the maintenance on March 27th, 2024, related items, quests, and NPCs will be changed or removed as part of the conclusion of Conquest Program Season 1. Please find the details below:

[b]■ Pre-Notice regarding the end of Conquest Program[/b]
[list][*] [b]Schedule[/b]: During maintenance on March 27th, 2024
[*] [b]Details[/b][list][*] Conquest Program contents will be removed.
[*] The source of obtaining the 'Program bio-verification key' required to enter the Conquest program will be removed, and the item specifications will be changed.  
[*] [Changes of ‘Program bio-verification key’]
[list]
[*] Changes will be made to disable ‘Black Market’ transactions.
[*] The 'Program bio-verification key' registered in the Black Market, Private Sale Black Market, and Purchase Reservation Black Market will be invalidated (Failed Bid) after the maintenance on March 27th, 2024.
[*] A Failed Bid 'Program bio-verification key' cannot be re-registered, and The Batch re-registration function can be used only after receiving the item.
[*] Can be sold at the NPC shop for 100,000 credits.
[*] Item tooltips will be changed.[/list][*] Quests related to the Conquest program, ‘Large scale hacking incident’ and ‘Conquest Program’, will be deleted.
[*] ‘VR machine: Combat Training device’ from Command and Control Room, New Seoul Branch will be changed to ‘VR machine under repair’.
[*] ‘VR Combat Training Interlocking Device’ at Noah's Museum will be removed.[/list][/list]
[quote][b]Note[/b]: Conquest program reward items previously acquired and owned will remain the same.[/quote]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events to all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

If you have any further concerns or questions, please send us an email to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

notes.title: Known Issue Notice - March 14th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of the known issues after the March 13th maintenance.

[color=#FFAE42][b]Yuri's 'Special Skill: Shift' is Causing Disconnection[/b][/color]
[list][*] It has come to our attention that Yuri's 'Special Skill: Shift' is causing disconnections from the game, particularly when the skill's keys are pressed too quickly in a short period of time. Please be informed that this skill will be adjusted during the scheduled maintenance on March 27th. In the meantime, we suggest using Yuri's 'Special Skill: Shift' as a secondary skill, which will apply a cooldown between uses, reducing the occurrence of the disconnection issue.[/list]
[color=#FFAE42][b]Fused Phase Wings Description for Level 14[/b][/color]
[list][*] The current description of the level 14 Fused Phase Wings, "Damage increased by +120% on using Empowered State/PF Charge Speed +100%", will be corrected during the March 27th scheduled maintenance to reflect the intended feature, "Damage increase/PF Charge Speed +100% when in Empowered State".[/list]We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and we appreciate your patience in this matter.

If you have any further concerns or questions, please send us an email to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

notes.title: March 13th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. ‘Fused Phase Wings’ Upgrade Level Expansion[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The upgrade level of ‘Fused Phase Wings’ has been expanded up to level 20. [/b][/color]
[list][*]You can upgrade ‘Fused Phase Wings’ through ‘Costume Fusion’ with material items and credits.[/*][*]When upgrading, the required material items and credits are different for each level, and a 100% guaranteed probability is applied for costume fusion.[/*][*]Material Item: ‘Costume Fusion Fiber’, ‘Splendid Phase Fiber’, ‘Phase Wings Essence’[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Additions and changes to options for each upgrade level of ‘Fused Phase Wings’.[/b][/color]
[list][*]If options from the same series are applied additionally, the numbers are added together and displayed.[/*][*]Some of the existing ‘Fused Phase Wings’ options for level 1 to 10 have been improved. (Excluding level 2)[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/72edc8320104c7ac4c22d73cca336cd3e83ee598.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Additions and changes to the buffs at each upgrade level of ‘Fused Phase Wings’.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The name of the Empowered State skill [Release Phase Force], which changes when level 5 or higher ‘Fused Phase Wings’ is worn, has been changed to [Release Phase Force I].   [/*][*]When wearing ‘Fused Phase Wings’ of level 15 or higher, the Empowered State skill is changed to [Release Phase Force II] skill. [/*][*]Some of [Release Phase Force I] Buff have been improved.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8c3a425eca33fa8f957ab3433c8e6db6731f36ff.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Fused Phase Wings’ effect custom ‘Change the World’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The effect custom ‘Change the World’ is activated when you equip ‘Fused Phase Wings’ upgraded to level 20 or higher or store it in inventory.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Other changed rlated to ‘Fused Phase Wings’[/b][/color]
[list][*]When the upgrade is successful, the conditions for the message output to all servers have been changed. (Success at level 7 → Success at level 10)[/*][*]Some contents of the guide related to ‘Fused Phase Wings’ have been modified.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Fiber Shop Addition[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ [Fiber Shop] has been added to NPC Shop.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character of above level 80 can use ‘Fiber Shop’ from <Shop - Pheasant> NPC > Normal Shop.[/*][*]You can exchange ‘Common Phase Fiber’, ‘Splendid Phase Fiber’ Item into ‘Phase Wings Essence’, ‘Costume Fusion Fiber’, ‘Special Agent/Special Crew/Hireling Costume Full Set’, ‘3-star Accessory Item Full Set’ and more.[/*][*]All items acquired from the Fiber Shop’ cannot be traded on the black market, and some items cannot be moved to the account storage.[/*][*]Some costumes and accessory items obtained from the ‘Fiber Shop’ are acquired in a state that cannot be repackaged.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Addition of PNA system Awakended Gene[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A total of 14 types of Awakened Gene A, B, and C of the PNA system Awakening strain have been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The number of awakening material capsules that can be obtained in one play in Gremory Dungeon has been increased.[/b][/color][list][*]Target Dungeon: Advanced Central Laboratory, Bear Land, Gremory Science Facility (Each includes [V.HARD])[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Dungeon Reward acquire improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ To improve dungeon play and reward acquisition, some dungeon rewards have been removed or added.[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f5783d1319a584246a4fb598ea1ebbf16e8a492e.png[/img]
[list][*]If there was a party clear reward in the ‘Reward Removal Dungeon’, the party clear reward has been changed to a reward for obtaining a drop from defeating a boss monster.[/*][*]Main Reward Item: Gear Booster Fuel I, Fast Dual Recovery Capsule, Malek Crystal, Common Phase Fiber, Pet Food etc.[/*][*]The amount of ‘Malek Diamond’, the main reward item in the Flame Wave 4-person mission dungeon, has been increased.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some changes have been made to Gremory Dungeon reward items and acquisition methods.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Drop reward items in some Gremory Dungeons have been changed to improve convenience in using inventory space.[/*][*]Target Dungeon: Advanced Central Laboratory, Bear Land, Gremory Science Facility (Each includes [V.HARD])[/*][*]Major changes: Credit → Gold Malek Statue /  PNA Evolution Additives → Unified as Doctor's Secret Box / Various Evolution & Mutation Material Capsule → Unified as Standard Evolution/Mutation Material Capsule.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Addition and Improvement of Pet System Features[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ An Exclusive Pet registration function for each Dungeon Armor Type has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can register the exclusive pet for each dungeon armor type in Pet Information > Container.[/*][*]When you click the ‘Exclusive Pet Registration Button’ displayed at the top left of the pet you wish to register in the pet container, you can register the pet as a dedicated pet that matches the dungeon armor type.[/*][*]When you left-click a registered exclusive pet in the reaction type dedicated pet window, detailed information about the pet is displayed, and when you right-click, the dedicated pet is deactivated.[/*][*]Only one dedicated pet can be registered for one reaction type.[/*][*]The same pet can be registered as a dedicated pet in multiple reaction types.[/*][*]If you hover your mouse over the ‘Quick Change’ button in the armor type dungeon entry guide UI, you can check the registered pets dedicated to the reaction type of the corresponding dungeon.[/*][list][*] By clicking the ‘Quick Change' button, you can quickly replace the pet with a registered reaction type exclusive pet.[/list][*]The ‘Quick Change’ button can only be used in armor type dungeons. (Not displayed in normal/special operations area/matrix dive/party pop-up.)[/*][*]Reaction Type Exclusive Pet List is saved and shared on an account basis.[/*][*]If it is registered as a dedicated pet, Pet Salvage, Evolution, or Enhancement of the pet is not available.[/*][*]When Pet Enhancement, a pet registered as a dedicated pet is not exposed to Enhancement Material.[/*][*]Information regarding Exclusive Pet registration has been added to the Guide.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Pet Skill automatic change function has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]If a pet active skill is equipped in the skill slot, the pet's active skill is automatically changed when the pet changes.[/*][*]After equipping a pet active skill in a skill slot, if you equip a pet without an active skill or do not equip a pet, the skill slot will be displayed as an empty icon.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Other Pet System usage conveniences have been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*]‘Pet Nametage/Automatic Item Effect Hide’ function's name has been changed to ‘Turn off pet UI Effects’.[/*][*]When ‘Turn off Pet UI Effects’, Pet Stamina Cooldown guage bar and phrase to guide Pet Evolution including Pet Nametag/Automatic Item effect hide will not be displayed.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Character Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ All Characters' some skill balance have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Some skills' options and tooltips have been changed.[/*][*] The coefficients of some skills have been adjusted.[/*][/list]

[/b][/color][list][*] An issue that PVP images, UNION Pass pop-up window, tutorial text, crew buff tooltips, etc. are displayed at some resolutions as broken or showing in abnormal positions has been improved.[/list][color=#ffae42][b]▶ For the PNA ‘Fire’ Awakened Gene effect, an additional description has been added regarding the part that is applied while receiving Burn Debuff.[/b][/color]

notes.title: [Update] March 4th Temporary Server Maintenance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that we will have a temporary server maintenance to resolve the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/4141693732361507282][b]Known Issue Notice - February 29th (Awakening Capsule Daily Charge Amount Error)[/b][/url].

Please refer to the schedule by time zone:
[list]
[b]Schedule by time zone[/b]
[list]
[*] March 4, 2023 at 5:00 AM - 7:00 AM UTC
[*] March 3, 2023 at 9:00 PM - 11:00 PM PST
[*] March 4, 2023 at 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM GMT+7[/list][/list][table][tr][td][b]Update[/b]
[list][*]The issue with upgrading the Bright Moon Blue Dragon weapon will be fixed during the temporary maintenance.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
We appreciate your patience and apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

Additionally, we will offer a compensation package for this temporary maintenance during the next scheduled server maintenance.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[b]support@closersonline.com[/b]

notes.title: February 28th Update Patch Notes [Updated]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Town <World Peace Plaza> & <Origin Wheel>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Town ‘World Peace Plaza’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ is the next story area after 'Command and control room, New Seoul branch'.[/*][*]You can accept ‘Gathering Flames’ quest from <Miniwheel> at Command and Control room, New Seoul branch Town and play it after completing ‘Concluded’ Quest with the character of 92Level or above.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Town ‘Origin Wheel’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can enter ‘Origin Wheel’ Town by accepting ‘Behind the Broadcast’ Quest from <Simon Park> NPC after completing ‘Unexpected Uninvited Guest’ quest at World Peace Plaza Town with the character of 92 level or above.[/*][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ and ‘Origin Wheel’ can be transferred to each other through ‘Origin Wheel Transfer Beam’ in Town by accepting the Behind the Broadcast Quest.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area Dungeons have been added.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3fac88276e6f7287055fc3ecec02964981ae3a66.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Season 4 Update and New Town ‘World Peace Plaza’ related other updates.[/b][/color]
[list][*]World Peace Plaza Area Progress Reward has been added.[/*][*]Season 4 Channel has been added.[/*][list][*] You can acquire additional exp by playing dungeons in ‘World Peace Plaza’, ‘Origin Wheel’ Area from Season 4 Channel.[/list][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ has been added to Crew Reputation.[/*][*]Dungeon clear mission in ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area has been added to Crew Weekly/Daily mission.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. New Operation Area <Operation: Flame Wave>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Operation Area <Operation: Flame Wave> has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can enter ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ by <Origin Wheel situation monitor> NPC at ‘Origin Wheel’ Town, after completing ‘And Holy Lance’ Quest from <Soohyun> NPC.[/*][*]Characters of level 95 can participate ‘Operation: Flame Wave’.[/*][*]‘Operation: Flame Wave’ is divided into ‘1-player (single) Mission’ and ‘4-players Mission’, which can be opened by entrance UI from <Origin Wheel Situation Monitor> where you can check dungeon type, clear reward, and entrance restriction count.[/*][*]You can change the mission and reward by [Refresh] at ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon.[/*][*][Refresh] is available once a day for free and will require credit consumed after that.[/*][*][Refresh] will not renew ‘4-players Mission’.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0c709704fc0e70dd3a2dfaf58ec8300ddf2c0528.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘1-player (Single) Mission’ Dungeon is consisted of 12 types.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/38df98f52d4945a31bb0dd32bc9bc1c8f938d7ad.png[/img][list][*]The ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon is available according to each rate, and when you clear it and receive the reward, another ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon becomes available on the map depending on the rate.[/*][*]If there are acquirable clear rewards at the ‘1-player(single) Mission’ Dungeon, player cannot enter another ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon.[/*][*]‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon can no longer be entered once the available number of rewards received reaches 0.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘4 players Mission’ Dungeon consists of 3 types.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3cf42bf5dfdb1c6356996f887354c172c466ec0d.png[/img]
[list][*]In ‘4-players Mission’ Dungeon, each fixed dungeon appears for each day of the week.[/*][*]The <New Seoul Boss Box>, which can be obtained when clearing the ‘4-person mission’ dungeon, allows you to obtain the following items depending on the probability when opened.
: Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residue, Normal D Component: Gear, Splendid D Component: Gear, Normal D Component: Costume, Splendid D Component: Costume, Gear Booster Fortifier, Perfect PNA Evolution Kit, Overclock Chip[/*][*]When entering ‘Mirror Hell: Crossroads’ Dungeon, you will be entered into ‘One-eyed Chaser: Kang Lim’ or ‘Mirror Paradise: Bihyung’ Dungeon according to the set rate.[/*][*]‘4-players Mission’ Dungeon is recommended to proceed with 4 players, and there is no restriction on the number of entrances. However, after receiving a reward, Entrance and Retry are available, but receiving additional rewards is not available.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Operation: Flame Wave> Rewards have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The number of times you can obtain the ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ Reward applies to each character.[/*][*]The number of times you can obtain ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ rewards is reset every day at 4:00 AM UTC.[/*][*]The number of times ‘4-players Mission’ reward can be obtained is once per day and is charged a maximum of once.[/*][*]‘1 player (single) Mission’ Reward acquirable count’ is charged 3 times daily when logging in, and accumulatively charged up to a maximum of 6 times.[/*][/list]※ Some reward items do not match the trade specification information listed in the tooltip.
You can check the actual Trade Specification by hovering your mouse over the ⓘ icon next to ‘Receive Reward’ in the Clear Reward area in the Flame Wave Entrance UI.


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Scavenger Reward has been added to <Operation: Flame Wave> Dungeon.[/b][/color]
[list][*]5 types of Scavengers are available depending on the probability when entering ‘Operation: Flame Wave' Dungeon, and you can acquire rewards by defeating it.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8692c0c633b6a8ec2d075500c7d61b4013f3fbeb.png[/img]


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Gate Wave Dungeon Specification has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]<Operation: Gate Wave> [Party] Dungeon has been changed to ‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon.[/*][*]One of the monsters among ‘Mirror Grabber Nitocris’, ‘Lightning Kiten’, and ‘Yod's Domain’ appears at ‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon, and Golden Scavenger doesn't appear.[/*][*]‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon can be entered by <New Seoul Branch Situation Monitor> NPC at ‘Command and Control Room, New Seoul Branch’, or <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston> NPC at ‘Noah's Museum’ Area.[/*][*]‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon Specification[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b9007b6a75fa2e31f4356a71b406a54443c7cfff.png[/img][list][*]Dungeon Main Rewards[/*][list][*] Guaranteed drop Reward when defeating boss: Induced sleep ticket, UNION tactics analysis file, UNION battle analysis report.[/*][*] Gear Craft/Upgrade Material Drop has been doubled up compared to before.[/*][*] Dungeon Clear Rate Reward: Program bio-verification key.[/*][*] The existing <Operation: Gate Wave> 1-player dungeon and [Party] dungeon missions will end, and mission rewards can be obtained through <Operation: Flame Wave>.[/*][/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The contents below have been modified in accordance with the addition of <Operation: Flame Wave> and changes to the dungeon specifications of <Operation: Gate Wave>.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Content related to <Operation: Gate Wave> has been deleted from the in-game guide, and content related to <Operation: Mission> has been added.[/*][*]NPC <New Seoul Branch Remote Monitor - Edgar EX> has been deleted from ‘Noah’s Museum’ and ‘The end: The world in flames’ towns.[/*][*]NPC <Origin Wheel Remote Monitor - Edgar EX> has been added to ‘Noah's Museum’ and ‘The end: The world in flames’ Town.
You can play the ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ dungeon through this entry.[/*][*]UNION Watch Dungeon Mission has been added. (Order: Flame Wave)[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. New Gear Additional[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area's New Gear Item and Material Item have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]1 type of Module and 9 types of Trinkets (3 sets of 3 types) for each attack type have been added.[/*][*]Major craft and upgrade material items ‘New Seoul Damage Analysis Report’ and ‘New Seoul Disaster Analysis File’ can be obtained through the <Operation: Flame Wave> mission.[/*][*]When basic-crafting new Module Gear, Phase Gear Level is 230, and when upgrading to ‘Super’ level, Phase Gear Level is 240.[/*][*]When basic-crafting new Trinket Gear, Phase Gear Level is 220, and when upgrading to ‘Super’ level, Phase Gear Level is 230.[/*][*]New Gear Enhancement Transfer/Salvage Group has been added.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 1 type of New Module <Fury Fire>[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/32a62c442c1ebbd1dd90e4b5ba42129863620cf6.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 3 types of New Trinket <Mirror Dimension>[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3e97ae356462d9c42e227d1baeab505f1d401d22.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 3 types of New Trinket <One-eyed Jack>[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e4cfc518620982d82d3aad1c842ae7788c8e45fe.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 3 types of New Trinket <Fury Fire>[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3d5c64ec1f109b2cbbd04dca0f8bda703ab506da.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Shop NPC Change[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Shop NPC's name and modeling have been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Shop NPC name at every town and dungeon has been changed.[/*][*]Change: <Shop - Vending Machine> → <Shop - Pheasant>[/*][*]Shop NPC's appearance and dialogue at every town and dungeon have been changed.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Rapid Growth System[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Rapid Growth system has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Rapid Growth allows your character over a certain level to grow until the specific specification by using the item.[/*][*]‘One-shot Growth Lv. 92’ item to use Rapid Growth system has been added.[/*][*]Rapid Growth specification that uses ‘One-shot Growth Lv. 92’.[/*][*]Visit the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/jumping-event-guide-rapid-growth-system--OiuLKF895][b]Jumping Event Guide[/b][/url] for more details on creating a character during the Jump Event![/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4e779a62a861c6283bb9c178e27ff609f26842da.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Max. Level Expansion[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The maximum level of all characters has been expanded. (Lv. 92 → Lv.95)[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A new item has been added as the character maximum level expansion.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Item: Omega Equalizer (Lv. 93~100)[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ As the maximum character level has been expanded, the wearable levels of some quest and material items have changed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The character level accomplishment achievement has been added by expanding the character's maximum level.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. NPC Modeling Renew[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Ingame modeling of some NPCs has been revamped.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Character: Bitna, Carol, Susan, Yujung Kim, Jungmi Woo, Bona Choi[/*][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Other Updates[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[b]▶ Some specifications of Prelude quest dungeon have been changed.[/b][list][*] Normal and boss monster HP has been lowered.[*] The boss monster mutation type display in The Dungeon entry has been deleted.[*] Dungeon phase gear level restrictions have been removed.[/list]
[b]▶ The difficulty of three Tragedy of a flame: Encore dungeons have been eased.[/b][list][*] The damage and defense stats of Lovecraft, Annabelle, and Tindalos have been lowered by about 20%.[*] The ‘Dimension Distortion Field’ stamina of 3 types of monsters has been reduced, and the character has been adjusted to inflict more damage without using ‘Phase Awakening’.[*] The cooldown of Lovecraft's press attack that is activated during ‘I’m outside of the factory! There’s no stop button!’, and ‘Dance! Faster, faster!’ has been adjusted.[*] The cooldown of Annabelle’s random laser attack during ‘Nano cannon, full burst!’ and the random shield attack during ‘I will borrow the power of alliance.’ have been adjusted.[*] The cooldown of Tindalos’ random flame attack during ‘The flame of the clan, let be the same as baptism.’ and the random energy sphere attack during ‘Flame, protect your servant.’ has been adjusted.[/list]
[b]▶ Farming Guide has been improved.[/b][list][*] Information on costumes that can be obtained as drops for each farming dungeon has been added.[/list]
[b]▶ Some phrases in the game related to mutation have been modified.[/b][list][*] Modified detail: ‘Mutant Type’ → ‘Reaction Type’, ‘Mutant Level Total’ → ‘Mutant Level’[/list]
[b]▶ Some item names and item descriptions have been modified as the maximum character level has been expanded.[/b]

[b]▶ Emotion Ticket/Skill Ticket items have been changed to be available for shop sale and repurchase.[/b]

[b]▶ NPC Noah's name at Noah's Museum has been modified.[/b][list][*] Modified detail: <Area Transfer / Create Crew - Noah> → <Area Transfer / Create Crew / Brazier Buff - Noah>[/list]
[b]▶ Sector Pass - Gate Wave: Subjugation Item has been added to Sector Pass Selectable Box ver.2.1.[/b]

[b]▶ Additional improvements for J and Harpy Characters' modeling have been proceeded.[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Town <Noah's Museum>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Town ‘Noah's Museum’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]‘Noah's Museum’ Town is available regardless of level and quest proceeding status.[/*][*]All NPCs are available at ‘Noah's Museum’ Town including Heat Buff, Crew creating, NPC Shop, Craft/Salvage, Dungeon integrated Entry, and more.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Museum Memory> NPC has been added to ‘Noah's Museum’ Town, who let you be able to see story videos by season.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The story video for each season will be played when talking to NPC <Museum Memory>, and it will end once entering the [ESC] key.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Episode has been added to ‘Noah's Museum’ Town.[/b][/color]
[list][*]‘Noah's Museum’ Episode can be proceeded by accepting the ‘Treasury for Memories of Mankind’ Quest from NPC <Noah>.[/*][*]From level 89 or higher, after proceeding with the [Gate to the Future] Quest, you can proceed with the ‘Museum of the Dawn’ Episode by accepting the ‘Truth in the Light’ Quest from NPC <Noah>, but Aeri can proceed ‘Museum of the Dawn’ Episode by accepting ‘Truth in the Light’ Quest from NPC <Noah> once clearing [Another Lucifer - Battle Program Join] quest for level 90 or higher.[/*][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Season 4 Prelude[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Season 4 Prelude Quest and 4 types of Dungeon have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Season 4 Prelude Quest can be proceeded by talking to NPC <Carol>, once completing Quest ‘Maze in the dream’ at the ‘Command and control room, New Seoul branch’ Area.[/*][*]Episode/Quest Name: [Prelude] Closer's Daily Life/A Sudden Break[/*][/list]

[list][*]‘UNION Next-Gen Gear’ is jumping character exclusive gear that will be provided by ‘6th Anniv. Jumping’ Event.[/*][*]4 types of Core, 9 types of Module, 18 types of Trinket, 3 types of Amplifier, and 3 types of Trigger for UNION Next-Gen have been added.[/*][*]The ‘UNION Next-Gen Gear’ can't equip chips, transfer the enhancement, use the Gremory dimensional Box, Salvage, Trade, and move to Account Storage.[/*][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Farming Guide Additional[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Farming Guide at ingame has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The Farming Guide window will be displayed by clicking the ‘Farming Guide icon’ at the right upper from the game screen.[/*][*]You can check Gear Item Craft and Upgrade Tree and Dungeon information for Farming through the Farming Guide.[/*][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Pet System Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Transparent Dimensional Pet has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Transparent Dimensional Pet's appearance is transparent, and its appearance will not be shown when equipped as skin.[/*][*]250 pet cores are acquirable when salvaging Transparent Dimensional Pet.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Pet Nametag/Hide Automatic Item Effect function has been added.[/b][/color]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]Bug Fix[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue where the Solomon skill effect was applied abnormally when Violet uses it in UNION Arena has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue where a Chase judgment occurs when using Tina's 'EX Thunderbolt' skill in the air has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue where teeth were not visible when using the Harpy emote has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue in which some of Mantic's attacks and attack rendering did not match in the dungeons 'The Cave That Usurps the Throne' and 'The Cave That Defies Providence' has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Etc.[/b][/color][/h3]

notes.title: January 10th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Polish skill 1 type added[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 'Polish' skills for each character have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Passive skill 'Polish' can be opened and acquired when promoted to Prime Agent/Fatal Crew/Shadow Agent.[/*][*]To apply the polish effect, you must acquire the applicable (target) active skill to the highest level. [/*][*]When attacking using an active skill with Polish applied, Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase guaranteed judgment is applied to the additional attack by Polish.[/*][*]Additional attacks resulting from polish are not affected by Skill Level.[/*][/list]
[b]New Polish Skill[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b6e46c7eed6fd56a10a4e89eef4d786359ef96d2.png[/img]
 
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Character Skill Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some characters' skills have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target characters: Seha, Sylvi, J, Misteltein, Harpy, Tina, Soma, Cheolsu Kim, Aeri[/*][*]Some of the Skill Tooltips have been amended according to the skill adjustment. [/*][/list]
[b]Skill Adjustment Details[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1dd104cbdebcf083d90df91efa960a3ea763e6ce.png[/img]
 
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Sound stereo effect function added[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The volume decreases depending on the distance from which the sound occurs, and sound is output in left and right directions depending on the location of the sound.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can set the function by checkbox from [Settings] > [Sound] > [Remove distance/direction sound effects].[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Night Maze Dungeon improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The popup message display time has been reduced when moving to the Night Maze Dungeon stage.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Improvements have been made so that up to 2 recovery potions can be used in Night Maze Dungeon.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The amount of acquirable clues has increased in some stages of Night Maze Dungeon.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Difficulty of Night Maze Hidden Boss ‘Camilla’ has been adjusted downward.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. J/Harpy Character modeling improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ J and Harpy's Characters' modeling has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*]J and Harpy's Characters' face modeling has been improved. [/*][*]The costume worn around the character's face has been changed to match the improved modeling. [/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6.  PNA Awakening strain Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Awakening strain's ‘Enforced Breakthrough’ synergy effect has been changed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some of Awakened Genes' detailed effects in the Awakening strain have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some Awakened Gene effects have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Awakended Gene: ‘Attack: Strong blow’, ‘All-round: Strong blow’, ‘Special skill: Strong blow’[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. Landing Maneuver Changed[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ All characters have been changed to be able to use the Landing Maneuver.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Super Armor (1 Level) Status is changed to apply during Landing Maneuver activation.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Landing Maneuver's movement distance has been changed to increase in proportion to the character's Movement Speed ability.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The damage reduction option applied to some characters has been removed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character: Soma, Bai, Seth, Cheolsu Kim, Mirae, Eunha, Lucy, Aeri[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The cancellation method for Landing Maneuver Status has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]When the Arrow Key is pressed while the Landing Maneuver is in effect, the Landing Maneuver Status is not canceled and has been changed to move in the input direction.[/*][*]While Landing Maneuver is in effect, Landing Maneuver Status has been changed to be canceled by pressing the ‘dash + jump key’.  [/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some characters' Landing Maneuver method and motion have been changed.[/b][/color]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that we will have a temporary server maintenance to resolve issues after the scheduled maintenance.
 
Please refer to the schedule by time zone:

Schedule by time zone
[list][*] December 13, 2023 at 11:30 AM - 01:00 PM UTC
[*] December 13, 2023 at 03:30 AM - 05:00 AM PST
[*] December 13, 2023 at 06:30 PM – 08:00 PM GMT+7[/list]
We appreciate your patience and apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

Additionally, we will offer a Compensation Package for this temporary maintenance during the next scheduled server maintenance.

[b]Update [/b]
[list]
[*] The incorrect average prices for some items at the Black Market have been fixed during the temporary maintenance.
[list][*] With this, items on sale at the Black Market when the maintenance started have been treated as Failed Bid (expired).We apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.[/list][/list]
If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[b][url=www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url][/b]

Or send us an email to:
[b]support@closersonline.com[/b]

[list][*]When you defeat the boss in the ‘Flame’s Finale’ dungeon, you can definitely obtain the ‘Burning Throbbing Heart' item and the ‘Flame King’s OOPArts Box’, and you can obtain Flame’s Finale accessory of 3 kinds as a drop according to each probability.[/*][*]Vulturous Burning Bearer Amplifier and accessory, Illust armband, Phase wings, Footprint, Burning Throbbing Heart item and more can be obtained from ‘Flame King's OOPArts Box’ according to each probability. [/*][/list][list][*]The following are how to acquire ‘Invitation to the Finale’ item: [list][*]Obtainable by drop with a chance when clearing <Tragedy of a flame: Encore> 3 types of dungeons, and can be obtained as a weekly reward in the 'Castle of Darkness' dungeon.    [/*][*]Obtainable by weekly reward when clearing <Farce of a Flame> advance party.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Flame’s Finale’ accessory of 3kinds and Figure emotion have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Flame’s Finale accessory of 3 kinds: ‘Presence of Revered God’, ‘Liver Pecking Spear of Bird’, ‘Chains Tied to Rocky Mountain’[/*][*]Three types of Flame’s Finale accessories can be crafted in the craft machine with additional items and credits, including the ‘Burning Throbbing Heart’ item.[/*][*]You can create a ‘Flame King’s Collection Box’ with ‘Burning Throbbing Heart’, and when you open the ‘Flame King’s Collection Box’, you can obtain either the ‘Burning Throbbing Heart’ item (min 1 ~ max 500) or ‘Frozen Throbbing Heart’ item depending on each probability. [/*][*]You can craft a ‘Flame’s Finale Emotion Ticket’ with the ‘Frozen Throbbing Heart’ item.[/*][*][Figure standing: Flame’s Finale] emote can be acquired using ‘Flame’s Finale Emotion Ticket’.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Flame’s Finale achievement and rewards have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Achievement to clear Flame’s Finale has been added. [/*][*]Depending on the number of achievements you achieve, you can receive various rewards such as ‘Visual Frame Ticket: Flames of Liberated Inferno’, ‘Name Tag Ticket: Blooming Ember of Greed’, and more. [/*][/list]
