tags.feature: Yuri/Lucy New Promotion ‘Prime Agent/Shadow Agent’ Promotion can be done through the following episode in ‘Centum City’.
You can acquire 1-star Costume Set and ‘Battle’ Signature Ticket during Prime Agent/Shadow Agent Promotion
Dungeons have been added at Hunter’s Night Area.

tags.bug: For Prime Agent/Shadow Agent’s Ultimate Move Skill, ‘Action Camera’ still be on even though turning it off.
Illust change will not be applied for Prime Agent/Shadow Agent’s Ultimate Move Skill.

tags.feature: Yuri/Lucy New Promotion related achievements are added.
Yuri/Lucy Ultimate Move related tuning is added.
New Dungeon ‘[Extreme] Dragon’s Execution Ground’ has been added.
New Dungeon ‘[Extreme] Dragon’s Execution Ground’ has been added at ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area.
Character who is and more 90Level can enter ‘[Extreme] Dragon’s Execution Ground’ Dungeon.
You can acquire ‘Nightmare Orb’, ‘Traitor’s Shackles’, ‘Traitor’s Handcuffs’ Item by defeating monsters that appeared at ‘[Extreme] Dragon’s Execution Ground’ Dungeon.
‘Nightmare Orb’, ‘Traitor’s Shackles’, ‘Traitor’s Handcuffs’ Item that acquired by Dungeon play can be used ‘Dragon’s Execution Ground Amplifier’ Gear Transcendence Material.
Material Items that will be consumed when ‘Dragon’s Execution Ground Amplifier’ Transcendence is as followings.
‘Dragon’s Execution Ground Amplifier’ Upgrade level has been added.
‘Dragon’s Execution Ground Amplifier’ can be upgraded in 2 levels. (LV.1 : Super, LV.2 : Extreme)
The followings are Final Upgrade Gear’s stat information.
New PNA mutant ‘WILD’ has been Added.
WILD mutant Gene has additionally opened.
WILD mutant’s Variant has additionally opened.
You will be able to enter Investigation Group, as Investigation Group’s Entrance Day has been removed.
Investigation Group Reward Collect Condition is changed into Daily/Weekly count-based Restriction.

tags.balance_change: The available number of collecting [Legion Commander Confrontation : Machine King Belphegor] Investigation Group’s Weekly Reward has been changed. (Original: Weekly 4times → Change: Weekly 3times)
[Legion Commander Confrontation : Machine King Belphegor] Rank Reward has been adjusted to be higher.
Some of Enhancement Success Rate has been increased.

tags.feature: Enhancement Buff System has been renewed.
Some of Item Tooltip’s description has been modified due to Enhancement System Renewal.
Enhancement Success Announcement System Message has been changed to be displayed which are +16 and above.
Item Upgrade System has been renewed.
Original Gear Transcendence System has been renewed as Item Upgrade System.
Each name of Area NPC has been unified as Purification Ops Center.
You can get Item Upgrade by registering the Target Gear Item to be upgraded at Item Upgrade GUI, then selecting required material and supplement depending on the upgrade recipe.
‘Enhancement/Tuning/Slot Preservative’ Item can be usend along with ‘Shape Memory Device’ Item when registering supplement.
‘Transcendence Accelerant’ Item and ‘Transcendental Elixir’ Item can be used together when registering supplement.
Transcendental Elixir’ Item and ‘Transcendence Accelerant’-type Item can’t be selectable as supplement at Upgrade(100%) tab.
Effect-applied Item will be displayed in Green(Activation Status) when selecting and applying the supplement.
You can check the Farming Gear Item’s Upgrade steps, Material information and Gear stat information by pressing [Upgrade tree] button at Item Upgrade GUI window.
Some of Craft Machine List has been changed due to Item Upgrade System Renewal.
Item Upgrade-related Achievement, Quest string, and some Items’ description have been changed.
Item Upgrade System-related help has been added.
Babel Program Initial Reward has been renewed.
The initial rewards for Babel Program Dungeon 1st ~ 40th floor have been changed.
The clear Reward you acquired before the renewal has been reset so that you can acquire the renewed reward when clear.
There has been improvement for not losing EXP when transferring chip.
Elite Pet’s Basic battle skill icon which is displayed in the dungeon has been improved to be displayed the same as the icon of Pet Skill information window.
Item Specification in ‘Purification Ops: Gear’ tab from Planar Gate : Deep Layer Craft machine List has been changed. (Original: Fixis → Change: Infinite)
UNION Pass Reward lock icon has been improved.
Announcement has been changed to be displayed after +16 in the News in crew.
Betraying Dragon’s Rack Amplifier Super/Extreme level has been improved.

tags.balance_change: The amount of the Credit possession has been increased. (Original: 2 billion → Change: 5 billion)

tags.feature: Transcendence Accelerant Lv.1 ~ Lv.5 Item Tooltip has been modified.
Some Pet functions have been changed.
The quest icon display has been improved to be noticeable and the related quest has been improved to be checkable at Dungeon Difficulty Select.
UNION Pass UI has been improved to be called when clicking [OK] button at UNION Pass notification window.
Item acquire method has been improved when using selectable box item.
Myroom Exploration tutorial has been improved to be completed immediately.
Enhancement effect for +16~+22 has been changed.

tags.bug: Forced termination intermittently while setting key binding has been fixed.
Planar Gate : Deep Layer Area’s Contamination Hell Monster sound play issue has been fixed.
Forced termination intermittently when re-adding the failed in bidding items at Black Market has been fixed.
Error that shows new reward notification even after claiming all UNION watch ‘Returning : Intensive’ Rewards has been fixed.
Error that overclock Chip List which is not the stage being used was displayed has been fixed.
Problem where the skin pack could not be unlocked when the duration of the periodic costume expired has been fixed.
Problem that the previously logged-in character’s quest was displayed when creating a new character has been fixed.
Problem that abnormally displayed skill list when clicking Ultimate Move Skill Guide has been fixed.
Problem that the transparent costume doesn’t apply when some charaters(Eunha, Lucy) who don’t have Draconian Costume released yet but equips it has been fixed.

notes.title: Accumulative Playtime Issue & Compensation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

It has come to our attention that the Christmas and New Year Accumulative Playtime event resets daily, which was not intended.

Since these were content-related oversights, we’re granting the following during the scheduled maintenance on [b]January 11, 2022 UTC[/b]:
[list][*] To all players who logged in during the [b]Christmas Accumulative Playtime[/b] event period but have not received their reward after the past 8 hours:
[list][*] We will send a [u]White Bear Pajamas Box[/u] to all users who have not received it yet.[/list][/list]
[list][*] To all players who logged in during the [b]New Year Accumulative Playtime[/b] event period but have not received their reward after the past 8 hours:
[list][*] We will send an [u]S Guaranteed D Component: Gear[/u] to all users who have not received it yet.[/list][/list]
[list][*] To all players:
[list][*] Due to the inconvenience, [u]Compensation Items[/u] will be distributed to all users.[/list][/list]
[i][b]Compensation Items[/b][/i]
[list][*] x2 Sector Pass Selectable Box ver.2.0
[*] x10 Fast Dual Recovery Capsule
[*] x1 Maid Celine Voucher (3-Day)
[*] x1 Gardening Voucher (3-Day)[/list]
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]

notes.title: Pre-Patch Notice for January 11 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We are pleased to inform everyone that after the January 11, 2023 update, there will be renewals in the game.

Please keep the following information in mind:
[list][*][b]Advance Notice: Inability to craft and use Transcendence Stone Item after the Transcendence System Renewal[/b]

[list][*]The Gear Transcendence System will be renamed ‘[b]Upgrade System[/b]‘ following the January 11, 2023 update.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Original Transcendence Stone Item will be unavailable to craft or use after the Upgrade System update.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]All Transcendence Stone and Condensed Transcendence Stone Items from the Craft Machine NPC Craft List would be removed.[/b][/*][/list]
[list][*][b]Unused Transcendence Stone can be converted into an Extract Box from the craft machine using the existing method or directly into Craft Material Item by right-clicking on the Transcendence Stone Status.[/b][/*][/list]
[list][*][b]Including the [ Condensed Transcendence Stone Extract Box ] item, which will be added as a new craft recipe on January 11, 2023, all Transcendence Stone Extract Boxes will maintain the craft recipe for one year, starting on January 11, 2023. And then, all Transcendence Stone extract Box Craft recipes’ including [ Condensed Transcendence Stone Extract Box ] item will be removed, during the first game update in January 2024.[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[table][tr][td]
[b]     Notes[/b]
[list][*]When a "Condensed Transcendence Stone" is refunded, "Transcendence Stone" will be provided as the quantity will be based on the "Condensed Transcendence Stone Craft Required".[/*][*]The required amount of materials for Transcendence Stone Craft will be refunded by right-clicking ‘Transcendence Stone’.[/*][*]If you used ‘Transcendental Elixir’ to create Condensed Transcendence Stone, you can get a restoration by contacting [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]Naddic Customer Support[/b][/url] within 7 days of the craft day.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
Further details will be discussed in a separate notice which will be announced along with the update.
[list][*][b]Babel Program First Reward Reset and Reward Renewal[/b]
[list][*]After the maintenance on January 11, 2023 UTC, the receipt status of ‘the first reward’ that can be claimed when first clearing a floor will be reset, and reward items will be renewed.[/*][*]As the Reward receipt status will be reset and rewards will be changed after the January 11, 2023 maintenance, please make sure to check for any unclaimed rewards and receive them all.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Investigation Group Weekly Reward Claim Count and Reward Improvement[/b]
[list][*]After the January 11, 2023 maintenance, the Investigation Group Entrance Day will be removed, allowing players to enter every day.[/*][*][Legion Commander Confrontation : Machine King Belphegor] Investigation Group’s Weekly Reward claim count is 3, and rank rewards will be improved a lot.[/*][*]Please ensure that investigation group rewards are obtained prior to the January 11, 2023 maintenance.[/*][/list][/*][/list]Thank you for your understanding.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[b][url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url][/b]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3f0d8d6f8c523489f6f9b15fc14167af35584f3c.png[/img]

[h1][b]November 23rd Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[u][h2][b]Contents[/b][/h2][/u]
[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/2022123-fortress-of-white-night/]► New Area <Fortress of White Night/Polar Night>[/url][/b][/h3][list][*]New Area ‘Fortress of White Night/Polar Night’ has been added[/*][/list][list][*]Fortress of White Night/Polar Night Area is the next story area after ‘Centum City’, which can be entered with Lv.89 or above characters.[/*][*]
Fortress of White Night/Polar Night Area’s main story progresses by moving through two regions, and when the story is in progress in one area, you cannot move to the other.
    Ex) When story goes on in Fortress of White Night Area, you cannot enter Fortress of Polar Night area.
[/*][*]You can go to each area freely after clearing both Fortress of White Night/Polar Night Area’s main story.[/*][/list]
[h3]► [b]Fortress of White Night/Polar Night Area Dungeons have been added[/b][/h3]

[table][tr][td][b]Dungeon Name[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Antarctic Base: Day[/td][/tr][tr][td]Antarctic Base: Night[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ice Plain: Day[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ice Plain: Night[/td][/tr][tr][td]Forbidden White Fang[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sublime Mountain Range[/td][/tr][tr][td]Guardian’s Altar[/td][/tr][tr][td]Room of Black Inherit[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Fortress of White Night
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c8d3acd924e0c3a73758bfdb1ea3824d68029689.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Fortress of White Night[/b][/h1]
[i]Step into the snow, and find out the unexpected answers that await you![/i]

[table][tr][td]

[h2][b]Fortress of White Night Letter[/b][/h2]

Greetings Agents,

We are the game developers of Closers.

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for your patience and support throughout Season 3 of Closers, which has officially come to an end with this update.

From <Season 1: Humans vs Dimensional Monsters>,
to <Season 2: Humans vs Humans>,
and to <Season 3: Closers vs Closers>.

Your love and support made it possible for all these stories to begin and reach the conclusion. 
Agents, we sincerely appreciate it.

This concludes the story of how the young people who formerly defended the small city of <New Seoul> became the courageous Closers who protects the world.
We hope that the story will leave all of the agents with pleasant recollections.

We would like to inform you that all of these stories were only <Closers – Part 1>. 
We promise to learn from our successes and mistakes to give more meaningful and genuine stories to everyone. 
The countless Closers stories are something we hope you look forward to.

But before we proceed, we have a favor to ask of you. 
Many secrets will be revealed in the third season’s new and last area, <Fortress of White Night>.

Therefore, for the time being, we kindly ask that you avoid from exposing any <Fortress of White Night> spoilers.

For the Closers who have finished Season 3, we have prepared a special reward called
the [b]<Memorial Box of White Night>[/b] to show our appreciation and support.

Here is the list of the rewards:

[table][tr][td]
[b]x1 New Accessory[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][list][*]You can obtain the reward for each character by completing the story.[/*][*]Image can be equipped.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]x1 Effect Costume (Phase Wings) [/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][list][*]Available for a limited period only till February 22, 2023 maintenance
[list][*] Can not be obtained after February 22nd, 2023 maintenance[/list][/*][*]You can claim the reward for each character after completing the story to get this item.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
We’ve thought a lot about how we can offer this reward, and we’ve concluded that it needs to be [obtained by completing the story] because it is closely tied to the storyline.

We hope that you enjoy the final story of Season 3 that we’ve poured our hearts into, as well as receive the special rewards!

Season 3 is over, but Closers’ story is just getting started.
There are still a lot of Closers-related stories to be told.
We’d like to introduce the forthcoming features that we are working on before we start <Closers – Part 2>.

[b][New System][/b]
We’re getting ready to update a system that will utilize the content from <Fortress of White Night> so stay tuned for that.
 
[b][Closers – Part 2][/b]
[b]<Back to Everyday Life>[/b]
The theme for Season 4 is <Back to Everyday Life>.
We’d like to tell you the story of Closers who had no alternative but to disregard their daily lives due to confrontations with formidable foes.
 
However, they still fight evil in their daily lives.
Season 4 will include a furious conflict between the Closers who want to safeguard their ordinary lives and the enemies who want to destroy them.
 
Additionally, we intend to improve Closers by utilizing more unique and diversified ideas in terms of tale structure and presentation.
We sincerely hope you will anticipate it.
 
We made it this far because of the support from all agents.
As the developer who completed <Closers– Part 1> this year, my heart is brimming with happiness.
 
We’ve been able to get this far thanks to your love and interest for Closers, as well as your encouragement and support.
We want to express our sincere gratitude to you once more.
 
We will always be grateful for your love and encouragement, and we will work hard to keep getting better.
We hope you’ll keep anticipating Closers’ never-ending adventures.
Thank you very much.
 
Sincerely,
The developers of Closers

[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered
notes.content:
[i]We would want to extend our gratitude to all of the Agents who contributed their questions, feedback, and suggestions.[/i]

You will find the topic, together with a summary of your questions and our Developers’ responses, at the bottom of this page on this website.

We truly appreciate everyone who participated in this season’s Dev Q and A session!


[h3][b]► Costume Related Concerns[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Just as the Fatigue System was removed for the Closers World Server, “Seasonal Trend” for costumes should also be removed.
[/*][*]
Release the “Paradise” Swimsuit Washing Machine as soon as you can without waiting for the “Season (Every Summer, June of the year)”
[/*][*]
As of now, the only way to purchase old costume pieces is via the Union Store, and they’re all in packages. In Closers KR, you can buy each item individually instead of the packages that Closers World doesn’t have. Could you sell costume pieces separately while also selling the package version? Also, could we get more older costumes? 
Example: Sailor, Ninja, Shaman, All-Star, Pirate, Noble costume sets (packages and pieces) to Union Store.
[/*][*]
Since the game moved to Naddic, the synchro fiber failed merge pool for 2* costumes has stayed the same. This is especially true for Rattus characters, who have only had their release costumes and cozy winter costumes. Is there a plan to rotate the costumes?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We will do all in our power to ensure that the newest costumes and content are made available as quickly as possible on the World server, which will unquestionably give the server a better sense of freshness when it comes to these kinds of updates.

We support the idea of getting rid of the “Seasonal Trend”, and as part of our commitment to this idea, the “Paradise” Swimsuit costume that was released on the Closers Korea server this year will also be released more quickly on the World server than it normally would be. However, we would like to ask for your patience on this matter because we also have structural challenges to address before we can bring forward any costume updates.

In addition to that, we assure you that we will return even more of our older costumes to the Union store. We will prioritize your suggestions, such as Sailor, Ninja, All-Star, Pirate, and Noble. Meanwhile, the Shaman costume was recently on sale during the past patch update.

Please know that we always welcome any additional recommendations. You can send it to Customer Support, where we often collect feedback and ideas.

More topics regarding Costume Conversion Failure costumes need to be covered. As soon as we have news to share with you, we’ll let you know.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► In-game Updates Related[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
I discovered that Silvy’s Prime Agent skill is based on the Global version’s outdated version. There were numerous complaints about it, thus it has now been upgraded to the current one.

Another aspect is the latest roadmap announcement of the “Signature costume conversion 100% success” feature update. This feature was only introduced on September 7th in the Korean server, but Global has already made it available.

It’s either that some updates are coming out much faster while all older content is coming out much slower or that some should have been updated to the latest version but continue to use the old version despite numerous complaints. Could you please clarify more about it?
[/*][*]
The only thing that distinguishes this server is Thanksgiving, which was brought over from the Korean server, and Black Friday, which is now just a big sales event. For a server that caters to multi-region playerbases, shouldn’t there be more incorporated celebrations or efforts to make Thanksgiving events stand out? For example, Japan has Golden Week and Korea has Chuseok events.
[/*][*]
Closers Korea server will soon get a QOL update for raids that allows players to depart after defeating the main boss without having to “alt+f4”. Would it be possible to implement this update on World server ahead of schedule?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

To begin, we would like to point out that not all systems and not every piece of Closers content follows the same structure. Some of them can be put into place in each region at the same time, while others can’t.

Based on this difference, we will do our best to roll out some updates as quickly as possible in order to give all agents a better gaming experience, regardless of the system’s structure or the frequent content gaps.

Your feedback on the update timing has been heard, and we are doing everything in our control to find ways to make the updates available more swiftly. Even though it will take some time, we guarantee that the updates will be made far more efficiently from now on.

As this is a global service, we are currently putting greater emphasis on universality with regard to the world-exclusive event and content. On this point, we agree with you that there needs to be more diversity. Outside of the typical game content, we are going to come up with some new ideas for interesting themes to incorporate into the overall experience.

The QoL improvement related to the ability to leave the raid after defeating the boss is not an update that can be deployed immediately or simultaneously. With regard to this matter, we would ask for your utmost patience till this is ready to be applied on the World server.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Characters Related Concern[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Hybrid characters suffer large stat losses because hybrid equipment and damage are weaker than single-type ones. I’m curious as to why there are different types of damage, especially since they affect the game’s balance.

I want to know if there are plans to make hybrid characters more balanced and/or merge damage types, fix hybrid gear, and recalculate the combat power of hybrid characters.
[/*][*]
I’m wondering if having many characters to farm consumables, materials, and credits is the game’s intended approach. Running all dungeons with my best-equipped character is often less beneficial for rewards than running another character through a specific set of dungeons. Which makes playing a few characters less rewarding than having a number of dungeon-farming characters.
[/*][*]
Could the final member of the Rattus team arrive, perhaps early next year?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

The character’s power cannot be accurately gauged solely by looking at the numbers associated with their skill damage. In order to create a balance between the character skills, factors like cooldown, casting time, and any special circumstances that may arise after performing a skill are being considered. Aside from the method of balancing, we fully recognize that the existing Hybrid characters are not powerful enough when their TCP is taken into consideration.

We are unable to disclose the specific blueprint for the Hybrid characters at this time. However, we will conduct a thorough review on this topic and reveal how we want to improve the Hybrid characters when the information is ready.

For the next question, we think that the amount of time spent on the different parts of the game could lead to gaining better rewards, and this is especially true when using more than one character.

Please think of each character as one of the many different pieces of content that are included in Closers, and consider that playing a number of them is one of the more enjoyable and gratifying ways to enjoy Closers.

As for the last Rattus member, when we have any information regarding the newest member of the Rattus team, we will be sure to share it with you on our official webpage. Therefore, we ask that you keep an eye out for any additional announcements.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Closers Player Council[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
What do the Closers’ Player Council members do?
[/*][*]
What kind of rules should they still follow that only the admins are allowed to do, and what kind of authority do they have to maintain the server itself?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

Members of the Closers Player Council often assist the Naddic team in managing the Closers Discord server, reporting bugs, and moderating the Closers community. Any specific details were shared with those who are currently serving on the council. They are expected to treat one another with respect and to provide frequent feedback and suggestions.

The same rules that apply to the players also apply to them, but because they have additional privileges in the official Closers Discord, including the ability to ban or kick users, they must adhere to additional procedures before taking such action. We want to emphasize that they do not possess any unique abilities associated with their accounts within the game. They’re players like you, and we ask that you treat them with the respect that should be extended to other gamers in the community.

Moreover, we would like to use this opportunity to clarify that CPCs are not responsible for determining which updates to apply or when they will be delivered, that obligation remains with Naddic team.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► In-game Item Related Concerns[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is it possible for old achievement accessories or rare cosmetic accessory drops from old story dungeons to be easier to obtain, either via vending machines or as event items?
[/*][*]
Can PVP players trade gold medals for something? My suggestion is to exchange gold medals for something that helps get late-game gear.
[/*][*]
Can we get more use out of PvP medals or awards from playing PvP?
[/*][*]
Please add the option of producing necessary consumables with the sea breeze.
[/*][*]
Can we get more benefit from the Gold Hero Plate?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We are grateful for all of your comments and suggestions regarding the use of the various material items. We assure you that we will expand the use of PVP medals, Gold Hero Plates, and Essence of Sea Breeze in the near future.

When it comes to the old accessories and costumes, we will look for the most popular options while keeping the examples that were given in mind and making them available through different events.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Past Dev QnA Concerns[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
According to the previous Q&A, there would be considerations for more powerful state effects and cosmetics surrounding legion commanders for players to earn. Has there been any further discussion?
[/*][*]
Why is communication between a player and a developer useful if another server provides more insight into the future?
[/*][*]
Instead of being condescending and saying that your input is appreciated but nothing will change, please provide a list of topics or game content that you intend to improve.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

There are a lot of topics for which we can’t say for sure when they will be available or when they will be updated.

However, we are confident in telling you that the decisions regarding the next updates and improvements have been made based on the input of Agents from all over the world, not just from the Korea server.

Your suggestions and feedback regarding ways to improve the gameplay are very helpful to the developers as we plan out the updates and take steps to correct any issues. As a result, we would appreciate it very much if you could continue to share your opinions on Closers.

We are going to have a further discussion about how we can make it more clear to you that your input is being taken into account and incorporated into the game.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Squad Related Concern[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is there any other way to encourage squad play? Currently, being in a squad offers a small bonus item found increase.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

At this time, we are thinking about different approaches to relieve the pressure that is caused by the squad play, both on the system end and the content end.

Please keep an eye out for this in future updates.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Dungeons/Item Drops/Rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is there any help provided to newer players to help them proceed through dungeons as their gears are prerequisites to the latest raids and dungeons?
[/*][*]
How will future dungeon drops/rewards be balanced? Why does balancing drops/rewards often lead to the removal of their sources, which is unpleasant?
[/*][*]
Can you remove the Contamination capsule purifier as the key to enter the purif sectors?
[/*][*]
Is it feasible to craft or boost the drop rate of epic gears like Athena Warrior, Valhalla, Advancing Gluttony, etc. for newer players?
[/*][*]
Can you balance the reward for IF – Asmodeus? At least make it slightly better than IF – Beelzebub or just make it same as IF – Beelzebub.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

In the Purification Sectors, we are going to take away the item that serves as the entrance key. Thank you for your insightful comments. Please keep in mind that the actual update to the World server will take a while to finish.

We are quite grateful for the thoughtful concerns regarding the new players’ gear farming. In the near future, there are plans to implement an update that will make it possible to receive a full set of gear that is equivalent to those earned by completing legion commander quests. We have the hope that new players will have an easier time overcoming the hurdles.

This reversed situation occurs with regard to the rewards from the Asmodeus IF dungeon, and it is caused by the low value of the Essence of See Breeze item. We are going to expand this item’s range of uses, which will lead to an increase in its overall value.

We have a general understanding of your feedback on the balancing of dungeon rewards and gear. We will be taking a more cautious approach to the item balancing after taking into consideration the insightful comments you have provided.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Divine Battle[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Dream Theater seems to be a meaningless hub that you should only visit to complete your task force/black hands mission and collect your trigger. When you can’t even get the scissors in the first place, nobody will bother crafting Dogra or Magra effects, especially beginner players. Additionally, there are no new themes or any efforts to guarantee that DB will be released on time.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We believe that the current Divine Battle is loose to some extent and does not follow the original intention of a point competition between two camps.

We are looking into how we may improve the delivery of the intrinsic fun that comes with this content. After giving it enough time to plan, we would then show the changed part of the content. 

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Enhancement[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Trinkets and amplifiers don’t offer viable stat improvements at each enhancement level, although the probability of enhancement is the same as the core or module. What is the significance of this if no one wants to use these two components to their maximum potential?
[/*][*]
Beyond +15, enhanced stat gains diminish, there is no ilvl growth, and the buff voucher need 250 consecutive misses to enter fever time. Should this requirement not be reworked downwards to reflect the scaled down stat gains?
[/*][*]
Is it possible that the gear booster fortifier can be crafted in some way?
[/*][*]
Please consider lowering the cost of the Uncommon device or make it a completely free and accessible system.
[/*][*]
Will enhancement rates be updated so that there is the possibility of +14 -> +16?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We are aware that there are a range of opinions regarding the usefulness of Trinket and Amplifier enhancements, as well as the difficulty of gaining access to the Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Device.

Please bear with us while we have in-depth discussions about this. Rest assured that it will be for the better, and we will reveal the results soon in one of our game updates.

At this time, there are no plans for us to reduce the requirement for Enhancement buff fever, add +2 success to +14 gear enhancement, or provide crafting for Gear Booster Fortifier item.

Having said that, we do understand that you want improvements that are easier to use in general.

We would like to have an approach to this topic in the aspect of default enhancement rate and stats.

We will continue to investigate and develop new ways to make the enhancement more user-friendly while maintaining the value of high enhancement level gears. 

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Events[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is there a method to obtain existing characters the gear that jumping characters get? I’ve seen events give out gears before.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We also wanted to provide support for the characters who were already in the game, which is why the Autumn Jumping Support Box is now being made available to every character. 

We will make an effort to provide Jumping events that are both convenient and effective continuously.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Washing Machine[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Can we stop discouraging people to cash due to bad costume/accessory draw rate and unsightly tier reward?
[/*][*]
When are My Room washing machines’ costumes rotated?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

With the update that was released on October 12, a system that can supply a “My Character piece selected box” has been updated.

We are going to make the accumulative bonuses for washing machines more flexible by adding more ‘Selectable’ options for you to choose from.

The costume for the My Room Washing Machine has been changed to Training Wolf as of the update that went live on October 12. After a certain interval, we shall carry out the following rotation.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Game Features[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Are there plans to expand the in-game command feature such as the ‘/inspect’, and what direction does Naddic plan to take player privacy? For example, will there be a ‘/find’ command to let us know where players are? Will there be a way to keep a profile and/or TCP in-raids private?
[/*][*]
Are there plans to make it possible to block players based on the mail they send?
[/*][*]
Have there been any thoughts about extending the Black Market sales duration from 24 hours to something greater (possibly unlimited time)?
[/*][*]
Will the Black Market have a sort-by-recent-sale option?
[/*][*]
Has Naddic given any thought into the sale of NCoin vouchers that can be sold on the black market and redeemed directly for NCoin, potentially with some sort of additional repackaging cost for NCoin voucher resale?
[/*][*]
Are there plans to have a Couple/Marriage system and features?
[/*][*]
If possible, it would be highly appealing to players if you updated housing/garden boosts to work like platinum status and persist once you activate the elite version until it fully expires instead of deactivating below 30d.
[/*][*]
Please make sector entry consumed only when we cleared it.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]
[list][*]The following features are going to receive a favorable evaluation from us.
[list][*]Extension on Black Market sales duration[/*][*]Mail Block (Connect to Messenger Block)[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]We do not presently have any plans to introduce the following features since they might have a negative effect on the game’s economy and community or they might not be compatible with the overall concept of the game. We genuinely hope that everyone will understand.
[list][*]Find player location command[/*][*]N-Coin Voucher item[/*][*]Couple/Marriage System[/*][*]My Room/Farm buff VVIP period adjustment[/*][*]Sector entry check change[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Gear[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Please describe the thought process going into the creation of a new gear tier grade.
In summary, please justify why these gears couldn’t be Epic Grade droppable gear instead like Hell Modules.
[/*][*]
Lv.80-90 has represented about 5+ years worth of Naddic content averaging 4 iterations of gears yet the level gaps between these iterations are barely 2-3 levels apart. This may not be significant for the long-term player, but for new players the EXP per level gap between them can be addressed within a matter of days.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

Extra Gears are designed to have a longer lifetime than Legendary Gears.

Their distribution on the server is intentionally limited, but taking into account the size of the player base on the World server, we have adjusted the drop rate accordingly.

The process of obtaining Extra gears will be dualized in an upcoming Legion Commander update in February 2023, making them slightly more accessible to players.

In the future update, completing the relevant quests will reward players with a full set of most of the old gear.

We would like to narrow the content gap that exists between old and new players while simultaneously increasing the number of new players retained, which will ultimately result in a more dynamic server.

Please use the appropriate support channel to communicate any feedback you may have on the gear farming system and new player assistance systems. It would be very much appreciated.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Will Naddic improve skill descriptions in October’s Character Skill Rebalance patch? In-Game Examples are Sylvi: EX Supercluster, Yuri: Rank 4 Special Move: Invincible Yuri, and Lucy: Special Move: Aratta’s Ruler.
[/*][*]
Please provide a possibility to adjust flares for skill effects other than requiring a full set.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We’ve updated Yuri’s skill description, and the adjustment will be applied in the next patch update.

We will take care of the imprecise translations, inaccuracies, and insufficient skill descriptions. Please let us know through Support Inquiry if you have any current issues about a particular skill description, and we’ll look into it more.

At this time, we are having a hard time making changes to the effects of skills. We are sorry that we are unable to provide you with a satisfactory response.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Others[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Since the roadmap announced about the main website renewal, will the Discord server also get a similar upgrade treatment?
[/*][*]
Regarding the Player Conference that happened last 2021. There are many implemented contents, however some aren’t. Even a year after the conference, some unavailable content has no clear schedule.
[/*][*]
How interested is Naddic in the concept of player retention?
[/*][*]
I understand that Naddic does not plan to bring back AOS, but do the assets still form a part of the client files? If so, are there any issues in removing it entirely?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We will explore the possibilities of enhancing the functionality of Discord in any way that is available to us. If you have any suggestions that you would want to pass along, you can send them to our Customer Support team or discuss them with any of our Closers Player Council members, who will then share your thoughts with the rest of the team.

Even if many of the promises made regarding the KR player conference have been fulfilled, there are still a few topics that require further time to evaluate. Regarding the subject at hand, we would humbly request your kind patience.

We are concerned about player retention and a pleasant gaming experience. That is mostly all we care about. There may be instances where your expectations are not satisfied, but please keep in mind that we plan out updates, events, and sales in order to offer you with the best game experience possible.

Although there are no plans to relaunch AOS, the client files cannot simply be removed because they are relevant to the other contents as well. We will work hard to optimize the game client, as we have always done.

[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Known Issue Notice – OCT 27th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of a known issue that was found after the most recent patch, and that we will be conducting temporary maintenance according to the following time zone schedule:

Schedule by time zone
[list][*] October 27 at 6:00 AM to 7:00 AM UTC
[*] October 26 at 11:00 PM to October 27 at 12:00 AM PDT
[*] October 27 at 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM GMT+7[/list]
During this maintenance, a known bug discovered in the most recent patch release will be resolved.

[h3][b]Sign of Growth Talisman Box[/b][/h3]
[list][*] We found that the Sign of Growth Talisman Box was unintentionally set to account basis per class. We will make this a "once per character" fix, so each of your characters can get one Talisman, even if they have the same class type.

For example, if you already had a Eunha character and got a Talisman from it, and then later made another Eunha character, that new one should also have its own Talisman.

[*] After this temporary maintenance, the player’s current event and talisman items will be removed, and a new talisman with the corrected functionality will be provided.[/list]
[b]Additional Known Issue[/b]
[list][*] [b]Missing NPC Monster/Unable to proceed completing dungeon due to missing NPC Monster[/b]
[list][*] There are certain players who deal an excessive amount of damage to the dungeon monsters, which prevents them from completing the dungeon objective. This is a known bug, but it only happens very infrequently when players swiftly kill monsters. In order to avoid this problem, it is generally advised that you restrain from dealing the monster too much damage all at once when it is very close to being defeated.[/list][/list]
Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d93f1306915ddff559e2787fc09ee9729db126ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/37a37abb6c579cb3523653ed556275ff12d192b4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Divine Battle - Snow Play[/h1]

[h3][b]► Sylvi’s ‘Neutron Buster’ Skill has been Improved[/b][/h3][list][*]Superelectron Sphere 4 hit has been changed to Superelectron Sphere (Explosion) 1 hit[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ea6d3df2e05be0055e1a501556186a6b740244a4.png[/img]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 2. Item Craft Renew                                                                     [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Item Crafting List in each Hub has been Renewed.[/b][/h3][list][*]Area crafting now can be accessed regardless of the character’s current location.[/*][*]Crafting feature of some NPCs has been integrated.[/*][*]If the crafting item consists of several crafting methods, they will be shown on the right side of the UI[/*][*]Title, Pet, Black Market favorites list has been reset due to the crafting renewal.[/*][/list]
[h3]► [b]New Functions have been Added to the Crafting System.[/b][/h3][list][*]Level search: Search crafting items in Minimum ~ Maximum Level scope.[/*][*]Item search: Search crafting methods for a certain crafting item.[/*][*]Now favorites for crafting can be set per character.[/*][*]Craft Link: If there’s craft method link, arrow mark will be shown.[list][*]Craft method can be checked by double clicking the Material Item[/*][*]A button returning to the previous crafting method will be activated on the right-top by clicking craft Link.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Category Changes[/b][/h3][list][*]Crafting items that can be crafted after completing missions now will be shown in ‘Quest’ Category always. (Except for Module no.666)[/*][*]‘Task Force’ Category at Fantasy World: Dream Theater area has been integrated to the ‘Quest’ Category.[/*][*]‘Awakening Bead’ Item in ‘Housing’ category has been moved to ‘Consumables’ Category.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Some Crafting Item has been Removed.[/b][/h3][list][*]‘Purification Trinket 6 Set Box’ in ‘Planar Gate: Deep Layer’ tab has been removed.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Crafting UI has been Improved.[/b][/h3]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 3. Chip Farming Eased                                                                                    [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Origin Chip Farming has been Eased[/b][/h3][list][*]Weekly crafting count for Origin Chip per Material has been increased.[/*][*]Amount of materials for crafting Origin Chip has been decreased.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0e6dad17a9d1b3c63f5c4a5b18ab412551088e8b.png[/img]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 4. Chatting System Improved                                                                                   [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3]► [b]Chatting System has been Improved.[/b][/h3][list][*]Adding/Modifying/Removing chatting tab function has been added.[/*][*]Maximum 6 chatting tabs can be added, and name of each tab can enter from 2 to 4 characters.[/*][*]All/squad/Crew/whisper/System tabs are default, and they can be modified or removed.[/*][*] Adding/Modifying/Removing chatting tab and adjusting size/location can be done in hub, housing and crew hangout.[/*][*] Minimize feature has been added to chatting tab and clicking the button will activate/deactivate the tab.[/*][*]Chatting Window size adjustment function has been added. Left-click the right-top corner of the chatting window and drag to change the window size.[/*][*] A button adjusting the location of the chatting window has been added.[/*][*]Chatting command Guide button has been moved to the right-bottom corner.[/*][*]New command /cr has been added. Entering the command will reset the size and location changes of the chatting window.[/*][*]New commands for the crew chatting and whisper chatting have been added.[/*][*]Whisper function has been improved.[list][*]Enter /whisper + [Character Name] and Space Bar to enter whisper chat.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Entering ESC button while writing chat will deactivate chatting window only.[/*][*]Chat history will preserve even after changing the channel.[list][*]However, returning to Character Lobby will reset the history.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[table][tr][td][h3][b] 5. Guide System Renewal                                                                                    [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Guide System has been Renewed.[/b][/h3][list][*]Guide UI now consists of [Main Category / Sub Category / Page].[/*][*]Search function has been added.[/*][*]When searching with a certain keyword, all subcategories containing the keyword will be shown on the search result page.[/*][/list][h3][b]► Guide now Provides the Latest Content.[/b][/h3]

[h1][b]Autumn Jumping[/b][/h1]
[i]Jump to your heart’s content this Autumn season! Cheers to another Character Level Jump Event![/i]

[u][h2][b]Autumn Jumping Event[/b][/h2][/u][i]Create a character and level them up to Level 90 to get amazing benefits![/i]

Event Period
[b]October 12, 2022 – November 23, 2022 UTC[/b]

[table][tr][td][h3][b]Steps to Create a Jump Character[/b][/h3]

[b]Step 1[/b]
[list][*]Go to the Character Lobby and Recruit a Member over a vacant slot.
[list][*]Make sure that the chosen Closers character have the “Jumping Character” icon under the Contract button before you proceed.[/list][/list]
[b]Step 2[/b]
[list][*] Once you have selected a Jump character, you can skip or proceed with the Tutorial.
[*] Claim all your support items in your inventory![list]
[*]The items in your inventory will contain gear/costumes/consumable support boxes.[/list][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td]
[h3][b]Jumping Character Overview[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Available to all Characters (Can create 1 character for jumping during the event period)
[*] Character Starting Level 90
[*] PNA Level: 80
[*] TCP: Around 8M	
[*] Task Force/Black Hands
[*] Story starts at Centum City Area[/list][/td][/tr][/table]
[u][h2][b]All Character Jumping Item Support[/b][/h2][/u][i]Grab yourself an [b]Autumn Jumping Support Box[/b] to boost your character just by logging in![/i]

[table][tr][td][h3]Using the [i][b]Autumn Jumping Support Box[/b][/i] is not limited to any Jump characters, but it can be used for any of your characters, whether they were created recently or long ago.[/h3][/td][/tr][/table]
Event Period
[b]October 12, 2022 7:00 AM – November 23, 2022 7:00 AM UTC[/b]

notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance – October 12th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will have our server maintenance for Closers World server on the following schedule by time zone:
[list][*] UTC: October 12, 2022 at 5:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTC
[*] PDT: October 11, 2022 at 10:00 PM – October 12, 2022 at 3:00 AM PDT
[*] GMT+7: October 12, 2022 at 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM GMT +7[/list]
[table][tr][h3][b]Important Announcement:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] After the October 12 update, your "Favorite" list in the crafting system will be reset, including Title, Pet, and Black Market items.
[*] The Misery Chain Discount will end on October 26th, not October 12th. Incorrect text description will be corrected in the October 12 update.
[*] The 'Sloth Infinite Trinket Direct Transcendence Event' will end on October 12.[/list][/tr][/table]
Kindly log-off from the game before the maintenance starts.

During this time, you won’t be able to enter the game and the website may not work smoothly.

Please keep an eye on our website or social media sites for news and further updates.
[b][list][*][url=https://www.facebook.com/ClosersGame/]Official Closers Facebook Fanpage[/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Twitter Page[/url]

[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSKUaz4gOXhj8160Xjbeb-g]Official Closers YouTube Channel[/url][/list][/b]We are thankful for your support and understanding!

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]

notes.title: September 7 Temporary Server Maintenance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We will be having temporary maintenance on September 7, 2022, following this schedule:

Schedule by time zone
[list][*] September 7 at 10:00 AM – 11:00 AM UTC
[*] September 7 at 3:00 AM – 4:00 AM PDT
[*] September 7 at 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM GMT+7[/list]
[h2][b]Issues that will be Fixed:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Awakening Skill Cube Description[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The description for Awakening Skill cube for each character are missing and it shows “Not Found” error message. During the temporary maintenance the description should show properly to the character.[/list][h3][b]Mirae’s Ultimate Move Tune[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Mirae’s ultimate move tune is missing from core.
[*] While the fix is not yet applied, please do not tune your gears to avoid further issues.[/list]
Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

We will be providing a Compensation Package for this temporary maintenance that will be provided during the next scheduled server maintenance.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]

notes.title: Jumping Character EX Skill
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

Thank you for taking notice of the new [b]Jumping Character EX Skill[/b]. We would clarify a few points on what should be noted when proceeding with a Jumping Character:
[list][*]Due to the last June 29th update, Ex skills can now be earned from their previous normal skills of level 1 instead of level 10.[/*][*]With this change, more SPs are spent on normal skills for jumping characters unintentionally because their normal skills were set to level 10.[/*][*]You can downgrade the current EX skills all the way back to level 1 of their normal skills and upgrade them at level 1.[/*][/list]
We apologize for this inconvenience and the normal skill setting will be corrected starting from the next jumping character event.

Thank you!

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: June 30th Temporary Server Maintenance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We will be having temporary maintenance on following these schedule by timezone:
[list][*] [b]June 30, 2022 at 6:30 AM – 7:30 AM UTC
[*] June 29, 2022 at 11:30 PM – June 30, 2022 at 12:30 AM PDT
[*] June 30, 2022 at 1:30 PM – 2:30 PM GMT+7[/b][/list]
[b]Selectable Enhancement Effect[/b]
[list][*] The Selectable Enhancement Effect appears to be missing after the patch update. This issue will be resolved after the temporary maintenance.[/list]
[b]Free Sale Count in Private Black Market[/b]
[list][*] The daily free Private Black Market sale count is not available. This issue will be resolved after the temporary maintenance.[/list]
Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

We will be providing a Compensation Package for the temporary maintenance that recently occurred after the server update. These item compensations will be provided during the next scheduled server maintenance.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/
[/b][/url]
Or send us an email to:
[url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]

notes.title: June 29th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3f0d8d6f8c523489f6f9b15fc14167af35584f3c.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]Contents[/u][/b][/h1]

[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220629-mock-battle-renewal-update-omega-knight-transmitter/] ▶ Mock Battle Renewal[/url][/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Added 2 new boss type[/b]
[list][*]DEEPSEA Boss, [b]‘Vasuki’[/b][/*][*]INSECTAN Boss, ‘[b]Master of Poison[/b]‘[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]The battle runs on weekly basis from now on.[/b][/*][/list]
 ▶ [b]Squad Matching Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Squad Matching System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]You can join a squad from almost anywhere, regardless of channel or town.[/*][*]Clicking Squad Menu(F3) opens a list of created squads, except secret squads.[/*][*]Squads that are full do not appear on the list, but can be searched.[/*][*]Squad name can be from 2 ~ 30 letters.[/*][*]Characters appear in squad info in the order of creation.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Squad Menu(F3) UI is changed.[/b]
[list][*]A function of searching squad name and squad leader is added.[/*][*]Searching a squad has 5 seconds of cooldown.[/*][*]When clicking Squad Menu(F3), squads appear in the order of creation and the searched list is renewed by reopening it in 5 seconds.[/*][*]When opening Squad Menu(F3), the initial list of squads don’t renew automatically before reopening UI after 5 seconds or searching again.[/*][*]Squad Menu(F3) doesn’t open together with the following UI:
UNION CAMP/Selfie Mode/UNION Arena/Investigation Group UI/Chip Inventory/Key Bindings/Character Selection/Channel Change[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Squad Invite System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]‘List of Received Invitations’ in Squad Menu(F3) shows a list of received invitations.[/*][*]‘List of Received Invitations’ is available only when you are not in a squad, and if ‘Block All Squad Invitations’ is activated, you won’t get invitations anymore.[/*][*]There is a cooldown of 15 seconds for a leader to invite a same character.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Investigation Group System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Regardless of channels and towns, all players can join a created investigation Group.[/*][*]When opening the Investigation Group menu, the list shows Investigation Groups in the order of creation, and there is a cooldown of 5 seconds when successful joining through auto matching.[/*][*]Investigation Group UI that pops up after clearing Investigation Group does show the group leader anymore.[/*][*]Investigation Group UI that pops up after clearing Investigation Group the group leader’s function to move members among squads is removed.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
  ▶ [b]Item Farming Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Some recipes are added to Crafting Maching in Busan – Nampo-dong.[/b]
[list][*]Muscular/Devotion Bug Lump can now be crafted with ‘Busan Protection Certificate’.[/*][*]‘Locust Hell’ gears can be exchanged with ‘Transcendent Locust Hell’ gears.[/*][*] Materials for ‘Go, Scarlet Scorpions!’ title are changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Farming in [Meet with Legion Commander : Lust King Asmodeus] is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Materials for ‘Ocean King Trigger’ are changed to be easier.[/*][*]Materials for ‘Condensed [Trigger] Ocean King’s Transcendence Stone’ are changed to be easier.[/*][*]Materials for ‘Roughly First-sewn Ocean Clothes’ are changed to be easier.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]The crafting limit for Traitor’s Yoke is removed.[/b][list][*]Recipes for Traitor’s Yoke are trimed down to one as the above change.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
  ▶ [b]Skill Tooltip Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Tooltips for several skills are improved.[/b]
[list][*]Some skills of characters become easier to understand.[/*][*]Descriptions for some active skills are changed only while those of Ex, Mastery, Passive, Combat Dodge, and Cancel skills remain the same.[/*][*]But tooltips for Ex, Mastery, Passive skills will be changed later.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Hair Costume Dyeing System[/b]
[list][*][b]Hair Dyeing system is added.[/b]
[list][*]A system to change your hair costume color is added.[/*][*]Hairs that are available for dyeing show the information in their tooltip.[/*][*]Hairs that are not available for dyeing don’t have the info.[/*][*]An icon of dyed hair shows its changed color.[/*][*]Some hairs cannot be dyed and the list is as follows:[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td][b][u]Costumes[/u][/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yuri’s Icon Hair (Ver.HW)[/b]
[b]J’s High Tide Helmet[/b]
[b]Davy Jone White Hair[/b]
[b]Yuri’s Icon Hair[/b]
[b]Asmodeus Black & White Hair[/b]
[b]Transparent Dimensional Hat[/b]
[b]Time-Limited Hair[/b][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][b]Hair Costume Bleach system is added.[/b]
[list][*]‘Bleach’ recovers an original color of an hair costume.[/*][*]Bleach costs credit.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]How to Dye/Bleach hair costume[/b]
[list][*]Please follow the instructions below:
1. Use ‘Hair Dyeing Ampoule’ or ‘Selectable Hair Dyeing Ampolue’ in inventory[/*][/list][list]2. Through Costume NPCs (Dr. Jung, Ara, Suji Jeo, Count D, etc)[/*][/list][/list][list][*]Hair Costume Dyeing is separated into ‘Random Color’ and ‘Selectable Color’.[/*][*]‘Random Color Dyeing’ costs ‘Hair Color Ampoule’, and it chooses a random color under a same rate (Each color has an identical rate) [/*][*]‘Selectable Color Dyeing’ costs ‘Selectable Hair Dyeing Ampoule’, and it chooses a color of your choice.[/*][*]You can bleach an already dyed hair costume through ‘Bleach’ button in Dyeing UI.
[b]   ※ Be careful when dyeing/bleaching hair costume because the process is irreversible.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Cautions for dyeing/bleaching hair costume:[/b]
[list][*]Packaged hair costumes are unpacked during the process.[/*][*]Successful upgrading/converting a dyed hair costume will remove the color.[/*][*]Repacking, Trading in Black Market, Failing to upgrade/Convert don’t remove the color.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]PNA Mutant EXP Targeting[/b]
[list][*]PNA Mutant EXP Targeting system is added.
[list][*]‘PNA Mutant EXP Targeting’ system enables focusing PNA EXP to a certain Mutant Type.[/*][*]Mutant type that is ‘EXP Targeted’ can earn EXP with priority than other ‘activated’ types.[/*][*]‘PNA Mutant EXP Targeting’ only applies a single Mutant type at a time.[/*][*]It cannot be applied to an already maxed out type, and the setting will automatically be OFF when the selected Mutant type reaches its max level.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Levia Skill Improvement[/b]
[list][*]Levia’s skills are improved.[/*][/list][table][tr][td][u][b]Skill[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Change Info[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Flash of Pain[/b][/td][td][b]The attack range is increased.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Serpent’s Waltz[/b][/td][td][b][Dragon’s Will]’s attack range is increased.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]EX Dimensional Singularity[/b][/td][td][b]Back Attack / Chase become guaranteed.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]EX Fang Stab[/b][/td][td][b]The skill continues to be casted even without clicking the button.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Empowered State[/b][/td][td][b][Dragon’s Will] isn’t casted from time to time – Fixed[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Hell’s Trap – Sphere of Terror[/b][/td][td][b]The casting time is slightly improved.[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Investigation Group Voting to Expel[/b]
[list][*][b]A system to vote for expelling a member is added to Investigation Group.[/b]
[list][*]Investigation Group Expelling Vote system is designed to maintain a stable dungeon run by expelling unwanted members.[/*][*]There are Voting Host and a target member to expel and the rest will be voters.[/*][*]The vote runs except the target member for 3 minutes and the expelling requires unanimity.[/*][*] There is a cooldown of 10 minutes for the expelling vote in Investigation Group.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Mock Battle Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Mock Battle system is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Mock Battle Bosses can be defeated. (doable for those of 15 million TCP)[/*][*]Mock Battle score is calculated based on a time that it takes to defeat a boss. (The time limits are same as before)[/*][*]Mock Battle now runs ‘Weekly’ not by season, and the highest score will determine the weekly rank and agent rank.[/*][*] Mock Battle Rank is reset at 04:00 on Saturdays UTC.[/*][*] Mock Battle Entrance per character changes : 1 -> 3 times.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Mock Battle reward is changed.[/b]
[list][*]The reward for both Mock Battle Rank and Clear are obtainable only for the character that defeated a boss, and if it fails to defeat a boss, there will be no rank or rewards.[/*][/list][list]· Rank Reward : varies depending a weekly rank(%) before every reset at 04:00 on Saturdays UTC[/list][list]· Clear Reward : can be earned once a week by defeating a boss(1 time per week and per account)[/list][list][*] ‘Training Token’ is added to Mock Battle rewards, which can be used in Crafting Machine to craft various items.[/*][*]‘Training Wolf [D Type]’ is added to UMP Shop.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

tags.feature: - Added 2 new boss type
DEEPSEA Boss, ‘Vasuki’
INSECTAN Boss, ‘Master of Poison‘
- Squad Matching System is improved.
You can join a squad from almost anywhere, regardless of channel or town.
Clicking Squad Menu(F3) opens a list of created squads, except secret squads.
Squads that are full do not appear on the list, but can be searched.
Squad name can be from 2 ~ 30 letters.
Characters appear in squad info in the order of creation.
- Squad Menu(F3) UI is changed.
A function of searching squad name and squad leader is added.
Searching a squad has 5 seconds of cooldown.
When clicking Squad Menu(F3), squads appear in the order of creation and the searched list is renewed by reopening it in 5 seconds.
When opening Squad Menu(F3), the initial list of squads don’t renew automatically before reopening UI after 5 seconds or searching again.
Squad Menu(F3) doesn’t open together with the following UI: UNION CAMP/Selfie Mode/UNION Arena/Investigation Group UI/Chip Inventory/Key Bindings/Character Selection/Channel Change
- Squad Invite System is improved.
‘List of Received Invitations’ in Squad Menu(F3) shows a list of received invitations.
‘List of Received Invitations’ is available only when you are not in a squad, and if ‘Block All Squad Invitations’ is activated, you won’t get invitations anymore.
There is a cooldown of 15 seconds for a leader to invite a same character.
- Investigation Group System is improved.
Regardless of channels and towns, all players can join a created investigation Group.
When opening the Investigation Group menu, the list shows Investigation Groups in the order of creation, and there is a cooldown of 5 seconds when successful joining through auto matching.
Investigation Group UI that pops up after clearing Investigation Group does show the group leader anymore.
Investigation Group UI that pops up after clearing Investigation Group the group leader’s function to move members among squads is removed.
- Some recipes are added to Crafting Maching in Busan – Nampo-dong.
Muscular/Devotion Bug Lump can now be crafted with ‘Busan Protection Certificate’.
‘Locust Hell’ gears can be exchanged with ‘Transcendent Locust Hell’ gears.
Materials for ‘Go, Scarlet Scorpions!’ title are changed.
- Farming in [Meet with Legion Commander : Lust King Asmodeus] is improved.
Materials for ‘Ocean King Trigger’ are changed to be easier.
Materials for ‘Condensed [Trigger] Ocean King’s Transcendence Stone’ are changed to be easier.
Materials for ‘Roughly First-sewn Ocean Clothes’ are changed to be easier.
- The crafting limit for Traitor’s Yoke is removed.
Recipes for Traitor’s Yoke are trimed down to one as the above change.
- Tooltips for several skills are improved.
Some skills of characters become easier to understand.
Descriptions for some active skills are changed only while those of Ex, Mastery, Passive, Combat Dodge, and Cancel skills remain the same.
But tooltips for Ex, Mastery, Passive skills will be changed later.
- Hair Dyeing system is added.
A system to change your hair costume color is added.
Hairs that are available for dyeing show the information in their tooltip.
Hairs that are not available for dyeing don’t have the info.
An icon of dyed hair shows its changed color.
Some hairs cannot be dyed and the list is as follows:
- Hair Costume Bleach system is added.
‘Bleach’ recovers an original color of an hair costume.
Bleach costs credit.
- How to Dye/Bleach hair costume
1. Use ‘Hair Dyeing Ampoule’ or ‘Selectable Hair Dyeing Ampolue’ in inventory
2. Through Costume NPCs (Dr. Jung, Ara, Suji Jeo, Count D, etc)
Hair Costume Dyeing is separated into ‘Random Color’ and ‘Selectable Color’.
‘Random Color Dyeing’ costs ‘Hair Color Ampoule’, and it chooses a random color under a same rate (Each color has an identical rate)
‘Selectable Color Dyeing’ costs ‘Selectable Hair Dyeing Ampoule’, and it chooses a color of your choice.
You can bleach an already dyed hair costume through ‘Bleach’ button in Dyeing UI.
- Cautions for dyeing/bleaching hair costume:
Packaged hair costumes are unpacked during the process.
Successful upgrading/converting a dyed hair costume will remove the color.
Repacking, Trading in Black Market, Failing to upgrade/Convert don’t remove the color.
- PNA Mutant EXP Targeting system is added.
‘PNA Mutant EXP Targeting’ system enables focusing PNA EXP to a certain Mutant Type.
Mutant type that is ‘EXP Targeted’ can earn EXP with priority than other ‘activated’ types.
‘PNA Mutant EXP Targeting’ only applies a single Mutant type at a time.
It cannot be applied to an already maxed out type, and the setting will automatically be OFF when the selected Mutant type reaches its max level.
- Levia Skill Improvement
Levia’s skills are improved.
Flash of Pain

tags.balance_change: The attack range is increased.
[Dragon’s Will]’s attack range is increased.
Back Attack / Chase become guaranteed.
The skill continues to be casted even without clicking the button.

tags.bug: The casting time is slightly improved.

tags.feature: - A system to vote for expelling a member is added to Investigation Group.
Investigation Group Expelling Vote system is designed to maintain a stable dungeon run by expelling unwanted members.
There are Voting Host and a target member to expel and the rest will be voters.
The vote runs except the target member for 3 minutes and the expelling requires unanimity.
There is a cooldown of 10 minutes for the expelling vote in Investigation Group.
- Mock Battle system is improved.
Mock Battle Bosses can be defeated. (doable for those of 15 million TCP)
Mock Battle score is calculated based on a time that it takes to defeat a boss. (The time limits are same as before)
Mock Battle now runs ‘Weekly’ not by season, and the highest score will determine the weekly rank and agent rank.
Mock Battle Rank is reset at 04:00 on Saturdays UTC.
Mock Battle Entrance per character changes : 1 -> 3 times.
- Mock Battle reward is changed.
The reward for both Mock Battle Rank and Clear are obtainable only for the character that defeated a boss, and if it fails to defeat a boss, there will be no rank or rewards.
Rank Reward : varies depending a weekly rank(%) before every reset at 04:00 on Saturdays UTC
Clear Reward : can be earned once a week by defeating a boss(1 time per week and per account)
‘Training Token’ is added to Mock Battle rewards, which can be used in Crafting Machine to craft various items.
‘Training Wolf [D Type]’ is added to UMP Shop.

notes.title: Training Wolf & Goodnight Kiss
notes.content:
[h1][b]Training Wolf & Goodnight Kiss[/b][/h1]
[i]Put on your [b]Training Wolf [/b]costume and get ready for action! Sing a song and put yourself to lullaby with the [b]Good Night Kiss [/b]costume![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/436046768379aad8b009372f01f9888bfa952ba5.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Training Wolf Story[/b][/h1]

[table][tr][td][table][tr][td]
The man always did his physical training alone around dawn.
He trains in an exclusive Closers-only gym located in the New Seoul branch.
Since he came back to UNION, the man commutes to the gym every morning.
The reason he is stuck training alone at dawn was because he does not want any Closers or his Agents to see him training.
He thinks he is a trainer who is supposed to be responsible for training others.
That is what is on his mind.


The woman always did her physical training alone in the middle of the night.
She also trains in an exclusive Closers-only gym located in the New Seoul branch.
Having decided to return to the mission, she went to the gym sneaking, out without her son noticing.
She is stuck to training alone at midnight is because she does not want any Closers or her Agents to see her training.
Since she was quite well known, she didn’t want to disturb other Closers in the gym by attracting their attention.
That is what is on her mind.

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/80ab83f4fdc322b00ff05883aefb2df645036929.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0ef8f2f26c272625553ff1e47a9468b9df60d531.png[/img]


Looking at all those tides in the reply, the man had a bitter smile.
‘Protect humanity together’ huh?
The man couldn’t believe that this one could spit out the big word so easily, which was too far away from himself now.
‘This person must be so strong or shameless to say it’
The man got curious about this agent. But he held it soon.
‘Since we still have this strong and shameless agent’, 
“we might still have a hope for the mankind.”


Doing Muscle exercise with a heavy-weight special alloy, the woman had a bitter smile from her hilariously stern tone in the memo.
‘If it were a battlefield and those equipment were your gears for battle, it would risk your life.’
The woman has met no one like him who was worried about her in that way. If she has to pick one, her teammates or her son, maybe?
Thinking back, there was a man in her memory who was worried about her by nagging all the time, knowing that she was the most powerful. It was her teammate and a trainer back in the days who always said that either you are the strongest or the weakest, regular training is one of the duties of an Agent.
What an annoying lecture. But seeing herself training every day following the advice,
“Maybe, he is still my trainer.”
 

Probably, the man and the woman won’t meet in the gym at the same time.
But if any miracle happens, and they meet each other, it will be nagging from one side and complaining from the other side. The past will happen again, but both will still follow the arrangement just like 20 years ago…
The time had passed.
Many things have changed, but there are things that will never change.
She’s the one who is our hope for humanity, and he is the trainer.
[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

[h1][b]Fireworks Festival[/b][/h1]

[list][*]
It's the server buff that applies buff effects to all characters. [Firework Buff] is stacked up to level 10, and  will give better buff as the level goes up. All the buffs are activated at the same time when reaching the required Festival points milestone.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]What are the other benefits?[/b]
[list][*]You could also receive a powerful personal buff from the [Team Firecrackers].[/*][*]Collect 'Fireworks Event Souvenirs' every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain [b]Training Wolf[/b] outfit or boosters![/*][*]The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards! [/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Known Issue as of May 18
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of a known issue that was found after the recent patch.
[list][*][b]Re-pack Count Deduction of Dark Command Accessories[/b]
[list][*]Once you have opened a “Dark Command Accessory Full Set Box” from the “Signature Accessory Full-Set Selectable Box”, all four accessory pieces will come out as unpacked along with a -1 repackaging count (98/99) which is not intended.[/*][*]The said “Signature Accessory Full-Set Selectable Box” came from Midnight Crusader Washing Machine which is obtained by chance, or from the Accumulative purchase bonus of 700.[/*][*]This issue will be addressed during the upcoming server maintenance on May 25th. We will provide Quality Assurance Seals to those who have chosen the “Dark Command Accessory Full Set Box” from the “Signature Accessory Full-Set Selectable Box”.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
We apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused, and we sincerely thank you for your understanding.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

[list][*]Changed major Unique/Signature Costume/Accessory Random Boxes into ‘Selectable’ so that you can choose what you want.[/*][*]High value items are added:[/*][/list][table][tr][td][table][tr][td][u][b]Major Changes on Spec-Up Items[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]
