A crafting recipe for Origin Chip is added to ‘Chip Inventory’.
2 recipes for Origin Chip Box x1 are removed from Crafting Machine in ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area.
Crafting Restriction of T1, T2 Color Chips are removed.
Specifications of some materials that are used in crafting Chip are changed.
The following material items can now be stored in Account Bank
When overclocking a chip that is equipped in Module/Trinket, the amount of stat increase slightly rises.
When changing chip or slot type of gear, the same color slot as that slot is not available.
You can adjust the cinematic system of mission dialogue through ‘Option’.
Sound settings in Option can mute a cinematic sound for a mission by clicking Master Sound or Effect sound.
Turning off Screen Shaking Effect can remove the effect in mission cinematic.
Enhancement Level is expanded for some gears.
As new Gears are added, some Enhancement Level is expanded up to +22 for some gears.
As the Gear Enhancement level is expanded, the maximum Chip Overclock is expanded to +22.
Several specifications of the ‘Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Device’ are changed.
‘Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Device’ has an expanded range of Gear Enhancement Level to cover.
Changes in Fly King/Glutton King Investigation Group
[Legion Commander Audience: Fly King Beelzebub] and [Legion Commander Meeting: Glutton King Beelzebub] Raid Dungeons are removed from the investigation list.
Through ‘Investigation Supporter – Leblanc’, you can play Fly King/Glutton King Raid Dungeons.
Fly King/Glutton King Raid Dungeons are changed to 4 member dungeons.
Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons can be entered through ‘Legion Commander Subjugation Supporter – Leblanc’ in ‘Dream Theater <Reverse>’ Area.
When playing Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons, same rewards are given as the Investigation Group gives.
When playing Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons, previous Investigation Group Achievement can be achieved.
‘Matrix Dive’ is added to the reward list of Fly King/Glutton King Dungeons.
‘Investigation Supporter – Leblanc’ has a different set of available missions.
As Fly King/Glutton King Investigation Groups are changed, ‘Investigation Supporter – Leblanc’ has different set of available missions.
When playing ‘Ocean King Audience: Pure Lust’ mission, ‘Investigation Supporter – Leblanc’ appears on ‘Dream Theater <Reverse>’ Area.
Crafting Specification of ‘Glutton King Page Selection Box’ is changed.
Crafting Machine in ‘Dream Theater <Reverse>’ Area requires different material for Glutton King Page Selection Box in ‘Beelzebub: Meeting’ tab.
No other materials are needed except Glutton King Page to acquire a page you want.
Fly King/Glutton King Investigation Group List is removed from the upper quick menu.
The required number of task to achieve ‘Beelzebub Core Investigation’ Achievement is reduced.
An option to give up Investigation Group reward is added.
After playing Investigation Group, an option to give up reward is added in order to avoid being forced to acquire rewards by accumulated Points.
When giving up rewards after clearing Investigation Group, acquired points are reset.
When giving up rewards after clearing Investigation Group, the count for claiming reward remains, you can gather points again by re-grouping Investigation Group.
‘Contaminated Troop Basher’ that spawns in ‘Yod’s Headwaters’ dungeon appears more early.
Entrance Time Limit is removed from ‘Contamination Hell: Overflowed [Reverse/Surface]’ dungeon.
Daily Entrance Limit is removed from ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site: Heart and Ancient Dragon’s Prison Castle’ dungeons, and the limit is changed to 2 time per week. (including Nightmare dungeon)
Daily Entrance Limit is removed from ‘Gremory Science Facility’ dungeon, it is changed to 3 times per week. (including Mild dungeon)
HP of monsters is changed in a mission dungeon, ‘[Nightmare] Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart.
‘Transcendence Dust’ is added to S rank clear reward of ‘Mutation: The Temple of the Ocean’ dungeon.
SSS Rank, SS Rank Rewards of [Legion Commander Meeting: Lust King Asmodeus] Investigation Group are changed.
‘Transcendence Dust’ is replaced with ‘Gear Booster Fuel I’ in SSS Rank, SS Rank Reward of Investigation Group.
Several patterns of [Nightmare] Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart dungeon are changed.
In a pattern of ‘To regain a lost name… and old glory…!’, the real body of Tiamat staggers after defeating its clone.
In a pattern of ‘To regain a lost name… and old glory…!’, Tiamat clone’s HP is adjusted.
Fly King/Glutton King Beelzebub Dungeon is changed: 4 member fixed -> 1 ~ 4 members.
As the above change in Fly King, Glutton King Beelzebub dungeon, monsters’ HP is changed.
In Asmodeus Audience/Meeting tab in Dream Theater <Reverse> Area Crafting Machine, a daily craft restriction is removed for Transcendence Stone.
The description for how to acquire is changed in Glutton King Page Item Tooltip.
The effect of [March of the Legion] active buff of Legion Commander Trinket is changed.
A description is on Misteltein’s ‘Magic Lance Fenrir’ Skill
A description is added: ‘When using Enhanced Magic Lance, Fenrir’s Fang x3 stack is acquired.’
When using ‘Magic Lance: Muspelheim’ skill, the number of Fang stack of Magic Lance Fenrir skill is changed to 3.
In a pattern of [Heh heh! What a wonderful test subject!] of Flying Gremory Monster, the damage taken outside of safe zone is reduced.
For Rattus, in Gangnam District Map – The War Mall dungeon, some unique monsters are removed.

notes.title: Pre-Notice: Private Black Market Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]April 6th Private Black Market Update[/b][/h1]
[i]One of the most requested updates is finally here! One-on-one trades will be at ease once the Private Black Market will be available in Closers World.[/i]

Mark your calendar, as the release for this update will be on May 11, 2022.

Here are some early sneak peeks about this update.

[h2][b]Private Black Market Conditions[/b][/h2]

We know everyone is looking forward to this update and wanted everyone to try this opportunity. Therefore, a Free Private Sale Ticket will be provided to your account once per day.

[strike]However, there will be limitations applied to prevent abuse of this new feature. But, if there is at least one character that meets the said conditions, the rest of the characters in the same account can get access to Private Black Market.[/strike]
Please refer to the latest change to this link: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/215830/announcements/detail/3228526127323653983][b]Private Black Market Conditions Update[/b][/url]

[list][*]Required Character Level: 90[/*][*]The character must be over 7 Days old (168 hours or longer)[/*][*]The number of dungeons cleared: 300 times[/*][/list]
[h1][b]Long Awaited Projects![/b][/h1]

[i]Anticipate another roadmap release and a new season for Dev Q&A! We are happy to share our plans for Closers World with you all soon![/i]

[h2][b]Roadmap Release[/b][/h2]

There will be an upcoming announcement of a new Closers World roadmap which is scheduled in the mid of April 2022!

[h2][b]Naddic Dev Q&A[/b][/h2]

Feedbacks and suggestions are truly important to us, and we love to see more of your ideas. Therefore, another Dev Q&A session will now start!

If you have questions, constructive feedback, or suggestions that you wanted to ask and say to the Closers World Developers, post it on the  [b]Official Closers Discord Server[/b] in the [b]#dev-q-and-a[/b] channel.

You may join to the Closers World Discord server by clicking on this image:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/w7hShma][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png[/img][/url]

The development team will answer the frequently asked questions and concerns from the Closers World community! Please remember to be specific in order to make it easier to determine what you truly want to share with us.

The Q&A list will be announced in the Closers Official Website soon by the end of April.

Please note that the #dev-q-and-a will be closed on this schedule by time zone:
[list][*]April 6 at 5:00 PM PDT[/*][*]April 7 at 12:00 AM UTC[/*][*]April 7 at 7:00 AM GMT+7[/*][/list]
However, if you miss the chance to share it in Discord, you may still send it via Support inquiry to [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url][/b] or send us an email to [b][url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url][/b].

Thank you and we look forward to your messages!

notes.title: Lucy Dark Command + Arcade Girls + Leisurely Morning
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/132a8ebebdd29deb333881a38986faf3c37d146b.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Lucy Dark Command, Arcade Girls, & Leisurely Morning Costume[/b][/h1]
[i]Get consumed by darkness. The [b]Lucy Dark Command [/b]is now here in Closers World![/i]

[i]Chill out with your comfy getup until it is time to dress up with a ravishing [b]Leisurely Morning[/b] attire or a rocking gamer look with the [b]Arcade Girls[/b] costume![/i]

[h2][b]Dark Command – Lucy[/b][/h2]
[i]Get ready to be buried in a coffin and get consumed by Darkness. [b]Lucy Dark Command[/b] will consume the remaining light.[/i]

Lucy can now use [b]Dark Synchro Fiber[/b] for converting costumes to Dark Command signature costume. You can get [b]Dark Command Accessory[/b] through Leisurely Morning Washing Machine.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to announce the issues that were fixed after a client patch and a known bug that was found.

[list][*]We removed a strange line on Sylvi’s neck when equipping Midsummer Melody Top, and it should now looks visually better.[/*][*]Fixed a text issue on the dungeon select window and it should now show “Trigger” as intended.[/*][/list]
[b]Known Issue[/b]
[list][*]We found some frames show Korean in Profile Image. This will be fixed during the next scheduled maintenance.[/*][/list]
Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: February 16th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3f0d8d6f8c523489f6f9b15fc14167af35584f3c.png[/img]

[h1][b]February 16th Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h1][b][u]Contents & System[/u][/b][/h1]

[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220216-marvelous-updates-renewals/]► Improvements On Game Level Design[/url][/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can now level up your characters of Black Lamb, Wolfdog and Wildhüter more conveniently.[/*][/list][list][b]Black Lambs/Wolfdog Team[/b]
[list][*]EXP from the main mission stream before Busan Nampo-dong area has greatly increased.[/list][/list][list][b]Wildhüter Team[/b][list][*]­Mission flow of the main stream missions of Season 1 and Season 2 has been improved.[/list][/list][list][*]Difficulties of some dungeons are lowered.
[list][*]­In Yod’s Sea, the amount of monster HP to be boosted by the number of squad member is decreased.[/*][*]The amount of monster HP in UNION Division HQ Ch. 2 and UNION Tower is decreased.[/*][*]For some monsters, ‘Damage proportional to HP’ is replaced with Direct Damage.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[table][tr][td][u][b]Affected Dungeon[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][table][tr][td]
[list]
[*] [b]Subjugation Program: Irina[/b]
[*] [b]Battle Program: Hoffman[/b]
[*] [b]Subjugation Program: David[/b]
[*] [b][Subjugation] Abyssal Throne[/b]
[*] [b]Battle Program: Wolfgang[/b][/list][/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]
[list][*]­For some dungeons, recommended Total Combat Power and recommended item levels are lowered along with the monsters’ stats.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a353cc8f191bd088ea33e90c46c7e029bc9f4854.png[/img]
[list][*]Specifications are changed for some dungeons.
[list][*]Daily Entry Limits are integrated throughout IF dungeons in ‘Dream Theater [Reverse] area.[/*][*]Resurrection Limits of dungeons in ‘Planar Gate – Deep Layer’ area is removed.[/*][*]The prerequisite mission for Battle Program: Misook <<Original>> Dungeon is removed, and the entrance condition is changed as follows:[list][*]Character Level 86 or higher[/*][*]‘Scarlet Scorpion team – Data utilization’ mission cleared[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Player number limit is set to ‘Single only’ for Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart, Ancient Dragon’s Prison Castle Dungeon.[/*][*]The prerequisite to enter Ancient Dragon Historic Site [Nightmare] is changed.
[/list][list][*]When clearing the mission, ‘Another Nightmare – Proof of Theory’, you can access to [Nightmare] dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Mission rewards are changed for some dungeons.
[list][*]When opening The SSS reward, ‘Fly King’s Treasure Box (He)’, you can now select 1 trigger out of the box.[/*][*]Gears that you select from early mission rewards were changed for Black Lamb/Wolf dog/ Wildhüter.[/*][*]Some mission rewards now give you full set gears:
[list][*]Target gear: Verita Brigadier/Innocent, Hunter’s Night Epic gear, Demons’ Night Cosmic Trinket, Elite Trigger, Contamination Hell Trinket Set[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Craft list in Crafting Machine is changed/added/removed. [list][*]‘Hunter’s Night’ area’s crafting machine now requires more materials to craft ‘Scavenger’s Gold Treasure Chest’. [/*][*]When crafting ‘Pet Food’ through ‘Hunter’s Night’ area’s crafting machine, the available # to craft is now 3 -> 2.[/*][*]‘Traitor’s Yoke’ is added to ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’s crafting machine. [/*][*]Crafting machine in Divine Battle will no longer craft costume box. [/*][*]Seabreeze Tree Seed is added to Housing’s crafting list. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]The requirement of accepting the entering mission to go to Dream Theater – Reverse area is lowered.[list][*]The prerequisite mission for ‘Over the Curtains’ where you can enter Dream Theater <<Reverse>> is removed. [/*][*]At level 85, all characters can accept ‘Over the Curtains’ mission. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]The Dungeon for [Nightmare] Tiamat mission is changed to mission only dungeon.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]►[b]Changes on Missions[/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Ordinary Missions of Black Lamb/Wolf dog that are removed due to the questline improvement are now recovered as ‘Sub Mission’. [list][*]Agents who already cleared those missions before they are deleted cannot clear them again. But you can access to the story in the operational journal. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Summarized story page is added to Operational Journal. [list][*]Whenever each main story is cleared for each area, it appears in the summary page. [/*][*]For Supplementary area story, it appears in the summary page when entering the area. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]►[b][b]New Costume Slot – Footprint[/b][/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]New Costume slot, ‘Footprint’ is added. [list][*]When equipping Footprint effect, the character’s walk, run, and jump leave its effect on feet. [/*][*]Footprint effect vanishes after some time, and disappears when the character is not moving. [/*][*]Footprint effect has no tuning option and it is obtained as 3-star only. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► [b][b]PNA Mutant – 3 Types Unlocked[/b][/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]HUMAN / MACHINERY / ANGELIC[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► [b][b]Improvements on Loading Interface[/b][/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Loading screen when entering a dungeon is changed. [list][*]The loading tooltip info remain the same. But the space and size of Character Portrait Image is changed. [/*][*]As character Image size is changed, designs of all visual frames are changed. [/*][*][Character Customization]-[Frame] UI is changed. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► [b][b]Black Market Improvements[/b][/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Black Market has some improvements in its functions.
[list][*]When closing Black Market UI, the search history is reset.[/*][*]The searching cool down for Black Market is now 5 -> 1 second.[/*][*]When registering items on Black Market, items under evaluation shows ‘Evaluating’ in remaining time.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Favorites function is included in Black Market.
[list][*]If you click a star on the upper right side in Black Market UI, Favorites pop up window opens. [/*][*]You can search items by [SEARCH] tab to add to Favorites, and the search shows every result that include the search word. [/*][*]When you click items searched by [SEARCH] tab, it shows all registered items for sale, and you can add them to Favorites by using Star icon. [/*][*]In (List) tab, you can check all added items in Favorites, and up to 10 can be registered. [/*][*]When clicking an item in (LIST) tab, it shows all registered items on sale currently[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Black Market Guide is added.[list][*]Tips for Favorites is added to the existing Black Market guide.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]►[b]Selfie Mode[/b][/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can now take a picture of your character ingame through Selfie Mode. [list][*]Click ‘Selfie’ button on the right side in character UI. [/*][*]While using ‘Look at the camera’ function in Selfie Mode, character motions are restricted and it switches to default waiting motion. [/*][*]There another function in Selfie Mode UI that helps you take the shot without being bothered by other characters or NPCs. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Functions in Selfie Mode are as follows. [/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6a36c34f1927edc45264cb1045ec24da4f342d90.png[/img]
[h3][b]► Seha/Sylvi character face model improvement[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Seha/Sylvi character face model is improved. [list][*]Seha/Sylvi character face [/*][*]Locations of accessories that are equipped on face are changed. [/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Convenience Improvement[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Game Play of some dungeons is improved. [list][*]The pop up that appears when clicking ‘Retry dungeon’(F2) in Yod’s Headwaters/Yod’s Sea dungeons asking if you want to go to hub is removed. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Convenience Improvement on Direct Tuning [list][*]When doing Direct Tuning and getting SS Tuning option, the re-try button is deactivated. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Convenience Improvement on consecutive box item opening [list][*]You can now input the number of box items for consecutive opening. [/*][*]‘Skip (Enter)’ is removed from consecutive box opening. [/*][*]The consecutive box opening is faster now. [/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Personal/Account bank now have more default slots: 25 -> 35 [/*][/list][list][*]All dungeon entries have their button to end conversation not applied, and an extra button to close is added. [/*][*]A function is added to turn ON/OFF the warning message when your Contribution point is max. ‘You cannot earn any more Contribution Bonus’ in the settings. [/*][*]In case you cannot earn Contribution Bonus anymore, Contribution Bonus mark in Dungeon UI will be changed. [/*][/list]
[h1][b][u]EVENTS[/u][/b][/h1]

notes.title: Dec 20th Emergency Server Maintenance (Completed)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We will be having Emergency maintenance today at 9:40 AM - 10:30 AM UTC. This is to update the Gear Boosters to pouched versions in the Christmas Golden Transmitter.

We will also be providing compensation to those who obtained this from the transmitter. Please keep an eye on this post announcement for further details.

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list][*]We will be sending the pouch version of the Gear Booster +13 – +15 to those who still have non-pouch versions in their account.[/*][*]The compensation item/s will be sent to your highest level and oldest created character in the account.[/*][*]As of 10:40 AM UTC, the Closers server is now up! Thank you for patiently waiting. A maintenance compensation box will be provided during the next scheduled maintenance.[/*][/list]
If you have any questions or concerns regarding Closers, please do not hesitate to contact us at [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url].

Have fun playing Closers!

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

tags.feature: The new area ‘Centum City’ has been updated.
Lv.86 or higher characters can enter the area
All characters’ max level has been expanded to 89.
Centum City dungeons have been added.
Battle Program: Jina Grace has been added.
A new material ‘Promptitude Bug Lump’ for crafting Speedster modules can be obtained from this dungeon.
New module gears have been added.
A new area accessory set has been added.
New gear items that can be obtained in the Centum City area have been added.
Enhancement transfer/salvage group has been updated for those gears.
Centum City area quests have been added.
Centum City Achievement & Titles have been added.
Season 3 channel bonus now applies to the Centum City area.
Crew reputation for Centum City area has been added.
2nd unique costume ‘Solomon Outfit’ has been updated for all characters.
Solomon Outfit Achievement & Titles have been added.
‘Solomon Outfit’ buff for ‘Cancel’ skill has been updated.
By applying the ‘Solomon Outfit’ skill effect, ‘Cancel’ skill can provide special buffs.
A Dress Room system for storing Unique & Signature costumes has been added.
Visit costume NPC in each area in order to use the Dress Room system. (In Dream Theater area, visit Storage NPC)
Dress Room can contain [1 Unique Set & 2 Signature Sets] or [3 Signature sets].
Bonus stats can be obtained according to the type of stored costumes.
Even though the costumes are stored in Dress Room, the Skin pack features of those costumes can still be used.
Click the Change Set button in the Dress Room menu and select the costume set that you want to store.
Costumes can be stored by right click on the costume icon.
Stores costumes can be pulled out by right-click or Cancel Storage button.
Costumes can be pulled out anytime and which costume to be stored can be changed anytime.
Item Destroy is not available while using Dress Room.
Repackaged costumes cannot be stored in Dress Room.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We appreciate the reports for the current [b]Stray Cat Washing Machine being not available for “Bai”[/b]. We will be deploying a hotfix maintenance on [strike]December 8, 2021[/strike] [b]December 6, 2021[/b], to address the issue at no specific time. We will announce the compensation to be given to Agents who purchased along with the hotfix notice.

We highly recommend for [b]“Bai”[/b] users to hold off the purchases in the Stray Cat Washing Machine until the fix.

Thank you for your understanding.

[h3][b]Updates[/b][/h3]
[*]We will be having a hotfix maintenance to resolve the issues with the Stray Cat costume on this schedule by time zone:
[list][*]UTC: DEC 6, 2021 at 4:30 AM – 5:30 AM[/*][*]PST: DEC 5, 2021 at 8:30 PM – 9:30 PM[/*][*]GMT+7: DEC 6, 2021 at 11:30 AM – 12:30 PM[/*][/list][/*][*]Please be advised to log-off from the game before the maintenance starts.[/*][*]For those who purchased the Stray Cat costume in the washing machine, you will receive at least x1 Stray Cat My Character Piece Random Box as compensation. The amount of compensation box that you'll receive will depend on the number of purchases found in the account.[/*][*]Bonus Washing Machine does not count towards the compensation.[/*][*]As of December 6, 2021 at 5:07 AM UTC, the server is now up! Thank you for your patience.[/*]

Players can enter V.HARD difficulty dungeon only after clearing the quests.
Players cannot use Resurrection Capsule item in V.HARD dungeon.
The amount of default item drop is double of the normal dungeons.
[b]Betraying Dragon’s Rack Amplifiers have been added[/b]
They can be crafted with Traitor’s Yoke and Agate of Genesis, which can be obtained from Dragon’s Execution Ground.

notes.title: Known Issues Notice – OCT 20th – Updated
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

Below are the known issues that occurred after the October 20th maintenance.

[h3][b]1. Ocean King Triggers – Salvage Result Issue[/b][/h3]
It has come to our attention that only a piece of Bloody Dazed Sea will be provided instead of four pieces after salvaging Ocean King Triggers. This issue occurs in accounts with Platinum Status. Please do not salvage Ocean King Triggers until it will be fixed during the [strike]next update on November 3rd[/strike] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/3069759028626946023][b]Hot fix maintenance on Oct 22nd[/b][/url].

[h3][b]2. Halloween Attraction Event Notice[/b][/h3]
Some users cleared the last boss in the Halloween Attraction dungeon, but it didn’t complete the dungeon quest. This is a known issue that rarely happens when killing the boss too quickly.

If you have experienced this during your Halloween dungeon run, contact us at [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]. Be reminded to choose ‘Game Play‘ as category and ‘Bug/Error‘ as your Inquiry category. Please provide us the details such as the time when it occurred and a full screenshot of your character where the quest didn’t complete after finishing the last stage.

Thank you for your understanding.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lusty Gears Drop Rate X3 Event – Extended!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We will be extending the [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210818-summer-festival-part-2/]Overflowing Lusty Gears (EX Grade) Drop Rate x3[/url][/b] event. From the previous end date of October 6, it will now end on October 20th which will be the World server’s next server update.

In line with this, the ‘[b]Meet with Lust King[/b]’ update will also be launched on [b]October 20th[/b].

[list][*]A ‘Mock Battle’ content that measures the rank of an agent has been added.[list][*]You can participate in the mock battle after completing the quest ‘Check Agent Rank’ from Celine at ‘Planar Gate’ area[/*][*]You can participate in the mock battle through ‘Mock Battle Support Terminal’ at Planar Gate with an 85 or higher-level character.[/*][*]Item Level 150 is recommended.[/*][*]You can play the dungeon for a time limit of 2 minutes.[/*][*]You can enter the mock battle once per character per day.[/*][*]The Boss of the dungeon changes every Saturday at 4 am UTC.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Mock Battle ranking system has been added.[list][*]Mock Battle is operated on a seasonal basis, and you can earn RP through playing the Mock Battle.[/*][*]RP can be obtained according to the amount of damage dealt to the boss monster.[/*][*]The obtained RP will be accumulated until the end of the season.[/*][*]When the season is renewed, the rank of the agent for the next season will be determined based on the accumulated RP acquired during the previous season.[/*][*]The mock battle rank is displayed on the character information, squad matching, investigation group search, and the UNION Arena (PVP) loading screen.[/*][*]‘Mock Battle Ranking(%)’ has been added to Ranking system.[/*][*]‘Mock Battle Ranking(%)’ reflects the highest score record within a week.[/*][*]You can claim rewards according to the range you are included.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Mock Battle rewards have been added.[list][*]You can obtain reward items according to the number of times you participated in the mock Battle within a week.[/*][*]You can only record the number of participation in the Mock Battle once per day per account.[/*][*]The mock Battle rewards can only be received once per account per round.[/*][*]The secured rewards can be claimed with all characters in the account and can only be claimed sequentially.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

Hello Agents,

We would like to announce the known bug that appeared after the latest patch update.

[list][*]The Eunha Black Suit costume causes the character to be invisible when it is equipped. This will be fixed on September 9th and after it has been applied, it should show correctly after you re-login to the game.[/*][/list]

[list][*]The Union Watch button when using a gamepad is missing. We are still investigating this issue and we will include an update in one of our patch announcements once it has been fixed. We kindly suggest using keyboard while this is under review.[/*][/list]

[list][*]Guaranteed SS Components were falsely added but these items will not be removed on this Washing Machine. We will be providing the correct items on the next Washing Machine.[/*][/list]

notes.title: SEPTEMBER 8th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png[/img]
  
[h1][b]SEPTEMBER 8th Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h1][b][u][b]Contents & System[/b][/u][/b][/h1]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210908-gremory-science-facility-update-event--packages/]▶ [b][b]PNA System Renewal & Gremory’s Science Facility[/b][/b][/url]
[list][*]New Dungeon [b]Gremory’s Science Facility[/b] has been updated.

[table][tr][td][b]Dungeon Name [/b][/td][td]
[b]Level[/b]

[b]Requirement [/b]
[/td][td][b]Recommended TCP [/b][/td][td][b]Gear Lv. [/b][/td][td][b]Entrance Restriction [/b][/td][td][b]Entrance Day [/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Gremory’s Science Facility [/td][td]88 [/td][td]15M [/td][td]160 [/td][td]Once per character per day [/td][td]WED/THU/SAT[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gremory’s Science Facility: Mild [/td][td]88[/td][td]6M [/td][td]150 [/td][td]Once per character per day[/td][td]WED/THU/SAT[/td][/tr][/table]
[list][*][b]Gremory Science Facility[/b] can be entered through Gremory’s Dimensional Gate at Planar Gate.[/*][*][b]Gremory Science Facility[/b] opens on every WED/THU/SAT.[/*][*][b]Gremory Science Facility[/b] requires ‘Doctor’s Crisis’ quest clear.[/*][*][b]Gremory Science Facility[/b] related achievements and titles have been added.[/*][*]New dungeons will be included to crew reputation.[/*][*]New dungeons will be included to EX channel bonus.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Quest dungeon [b]Gremory’s Class: Degree Course[/b] has been added.[/*][*]Operation/conquest Progress reward has been added to Gremory dungeons.[/*][*]Some dungeons will not provide PNA EXP anymore.[list][*]Crew dungeon, Commercial/ Guro/ New Seoul/ Gangnam Circuit, Legion Commander dungeons.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Some dungeons will newly provide PNA EXP.[list][*]Ancient Dragon Historic Sites, Subjugation/Battle Program dungeons.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Amount of PNA EXP from some dungeons have adjusted.[list][*]Planar Gate, Planar Gate: Deep Layer, Dream Theater, Dream Theater (Reverse).[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Methods to obtain PNA genes have been changed.[list][*]PNA Random Boxes are not obtainable from quest reward, NPC shop and dungeon clear reward (excluding first clear drop) anymore.[/*][*]New PNA Box has been added to Vending Machine [b]General Support Shop[/b] tab.[/*][*]Components of some PNA Random Boxes have been changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Evolution success rate of all PNA genes has been increased by 10%.[/*][*]Name of some PNA genes have been changed.[/*][*]Stats of some PNA genes has been improved.[/*][*]PNA EXP increase has been added to Lore Talisman and Extreme Fighter buff.[/*][/list]

▶ [b]Monster Armor Type Reorganization[/b]
[list][*]Monster armor type has been reorganized into 9 types.[list][*]Armor type options for some gears/set options/titles have been removed or modified.[*]Armor type options for chips/PNA amplifiers have been modified.[*]Armor type options for some buffs have been modified.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]New armor types have been applied to existing dungeons. Dungeon UI will show according to armor type of the dungeon.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b]PNA Mutant System[/b][/b]
[list][*]PNA Mutant System has been updated.[list][*]Click ‘MUTANT’ tab on the top of the PNA UI to use Mutant system.[*]Each Mutant provide specialized stats for each armor types. Only one Mutant can be activated at a time.[*]When [b]Auto Apply[/b] of Mutant system is ON, the Mutant will be automatically activated according to the dungeon you enter.[*]Level of Each Mutant will be increased according to PNA EXP gained by characters with PNA level 80 or higher while active and can be grown up to level 20.[*]Mutant system can be used after completing the ‘[b]Mutation Gene[/b]’ quest.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Each mutation carries a ‘[b]variant[/b]‘.[list][*]Each mutation has a ‘[b]variant[/b]‘, and with achieving certain level, the ‘variant slot’ will be opened, and you can equip the variants.[*]There are several variants in the specified mutation level, and you can select and equip one of the variants in the same row.[*]Each variant has a grade, and the higher the grade, the higher the variant’s stats.[*]When a variant achieves a certain level, an additional ‘mutation optimization bonus’ will be applied.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Restructure Mutation system that changes the grade of a variant has been added.[list][*]You can increase the grade of a variant through the ‘[b]Restructure Mutation[/b]’ button in the Mutant UI.[*]A certain amount of ‘[b]mutation material[/b]’ will be consumed when the variant level is raised, and the required amount varies for each variant type and grade.[*]‘[b]Mutation materials[/b]’ can be obtained by synthesizing PNA enhancement materials and evolution materials and can be obtained with a certain probability when clearing the Gremory Science Facility dungeon.[*]The more you repeat the synthesis of PNA enhancement materials and evolution materials, the more the required number of materials increases, and it resets at 4:00 AM UTC every day.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210908-babel-40th-expansion]▶ [b][b][b]Babel Program 40th Floor Expansion[/b][/b][/b][/url]
[list][*]Max Floor of Babel Program has been expanded from 30th to 40th.[/*][*]Entrance time per character has been changed from 6 times per a week to 7 times per a month.[/*][*]Reset schedule of Babel Program has been changed from weekly to monthly.[/*][*]Monthly reset will happen on 1st of every month at 4:00 AM UTC.[/*][/list]
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210908-character-skill-balance/]▶ [b][b]Character Skill Balance Update[/b][/b][/url]
[list][*]Some character’s skills have been adjusted. Please check the details in the provided link.[/*][*]Common Passive Skill[/*][/list][table][tr][td][u][b]Transcendental Power (Passive Skill)[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]1) All armor type damage increase option will be removed.
2) Physical/Psi Power will increase by +10 per skill level. (Skill Lv.10 – Physical/Psi Power +100)
3) Physical/Psi Crit Damage Bonus will increase by +2% per skill level (Skill Lv.10 – Physical/Psi Crit Damage Bonus +20%)
4)Attack Speed will increase by +0.5% per skill level. (Skill Lv.10 – Attack Speed +5%)[/td][/tr][/table]
▶ [b][b][b]UNION Watch Renewal[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*]UNION Watch became account content.[list][*][u][u]If the [/u][u]highest-level[/u][u] character in the account is level 20 or higher, the [/u][u]UNION[/u][u] Watch UI is displayed at the top of the character status window.[/u][/u][*]UNION Watch missions are determined according to the level of the highest-level character in the account.[*]UNION Watch and Contribution system have been integrated so that the Contribution UI is no longer displayed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]UNION Watch Missions has been categorized.[list][*]You can select the mission category in the upper left corner of the UNION Watch UI, and missions and rewards are shared by all characters in the account.[*][b]Daily Mission:[/b] This is a mission that can be progressed daily, and the mission and rewards are reset at 4:00 AM UTC every day.[*][b]Weekly Mission:[/b] This is a mission that can be progressed on a weekly basis, and the mission and rewards are reset every Saturday at 4:00 AM UTC.[*][b]Dungeon Mission:[/b] This is the same mission as the mission provided in Contribution system, and the mission and rewards are reset every day at 4:00 AM UTC.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]UNION Watch Reward has been renewed.[/*][*][u][u]UNION Watch clear achievement has been changed.[/u][/u][list][*][b]Previously:[/b] Achievements can be progressed when all UNION Watch missions cleared.[*][b]Changed:[/b] You can proceed with the achievements when you acquire UNION Watch bonus rewards from daily/weekly[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Exchange items have been updated to UNION Watch tab in Vending Machine.[/*][*][u][u]Lucky Phase Token is now movable to account storage.[/u][/u][/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Teamwork Buff Renewal[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*][u][u]Teamwork [/u][u]Buff [/u][u]System has been renewed.[/u][/u][list][*][u][u]Click the [/u][u][b]Teamwork Buff[/b] [/u][u]button in the character information list at the bottom to display the UI.[/u][/u][*]You can place the character created in your account in the team buff slot.[*]Your team’s points increase as much as the level of the placed character.[*]If team of the slot and the placed character matches, additional points will be obtained.[*]Only characters with higher promotion than regular agent/crew or resolver can be placed in the team buff slot.[*]Stats are determined according to the points acquired from each team, and the currently applied stats can be checked in the [b]Stats[/b] window.[*]After placing the character in the team buff slot, click the ‘Apply’ button to complete the placement, and the added stats will be reflected in the Total Combat Power.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
▶ [b][b]Name Tag System[/b][/b]
[list][*]New decoration – Name tag has been updated.[/*][*]Name tag system is for decorating your character’s name displayed on the top of your character model.[/*][*]Name tag system is applied per character, not per account.[/*][*]Name tag can be set in [b]Skin Pack[/b]–[b]Illust[/b]–[b]Name[/b] [b]Tag[/b] menu.[/*][*]Name tags cannot be individually selected for each category – Hub, Dungeon and UNION Arena. The selected name Tag will be displayed in everywhere.[/*][*]You cannot use the same name tag ticket while holding the permanent name tag.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Enhancement System Changes[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210824-enhancement-success-rate-increase/]Enhancement Success Rate has been greatly increased.[/url][/b][/*][*]Duration Time of Enhancement Buff Voucher has been extended from 24h to 30days.[/*][*]Enhancement Buff now allows enhancing +13 or above gears only.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Investigation Group Convenience Improvement[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*]Some improvements have been made for the convenience of the investigation group.[list][*][b]Crew Channel[/b] of the created investigation group is displayed on the Find Investigation Group page.[*]If crew channel of the selected investigation group and your character are different, you can jump to the corresponding crew channel[*]Characters in other crew channels now can be invited to the investigation group.[*]The invitee can directly jump to the crew channel of the investigation group.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]If the character invited to the investigation group is not in hub, has joined another squad, or has not cleared the required mission, invitation failure pop-up will be displayed.[/*][*]If the character invited to the investigation group is displaying another UI, the invitation failure message will not be displayed.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Transcendence Stone Convenience Improvement[/b] [/b][/b]
[list][*][u][u]Some transcenden[/u][u]ce [/u][u]stone extract crafting has been added.[/u][/u][u] [/u][list][*]Transcendence Stone Extracts of the Ocean King / Locust Hell/ Old Castle have been added[/*][/list][/list][list][*]The names of transcendence stones/extracts in the Matter Mixer and the order of the crafting list have been changed.[list][*]The names of transcendence stones/extracts have been changed to make it easier to understand the corresponding transcendence level and gear type of the item.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Chip System UI Improvement[/b] [/b][/b]
[list][*]If there is insufficient credit for chip crafting, the credit will be displayed in red.[/*][*]UI will clearly show how many chips you are crafting and the crafting count.[/*][*]When overclock EXP decreased with the chip transfer, an alert will be displayed.[/*][*]+0 gears cannot be registered to Chip Transfer UI with an alert.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Locust Hell Farming Difficulty Mitigation[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*][u][b]Notice: This will be applied during the Centum City update. We ask for your understanding.[/b][/u][/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]Trigger System Improvement[/b] [/b][/b]
[list][*][u]You can access the trigger pop-up through the [/u][u]Mission Map for a[/u][u]ll dungeons.[/u][/*][*]You can use Trigger menu without going back to hubs after clearing dungeons.[/*][*]‘[b]Trigger Preset[/b]’ feature has been added.[/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]TCP Calculation Changes[/b] [/b][/b]
[list][*]Defense Penetration options are reflected to the Total Combat Power calculation.[/*][*]Defense Penetration options have been added to some gear set options.[list][*]Fierce Dimensional Beast / Verita Trinket Set / Despair of the Unknown Closer.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
▶ [b][b][b]IF Dungeon Changes[/b][/b][/b]
[list][*]IF dungeons now share their entrance restriction.[/*][/list][list][*]IF dungeon entrance restriction has been loosened.[list][*]IF dungeon entrance restrictions have been decreased to 50%.[*]EXP/ PNA EXP/ Credits from IF dungeons have been increased to 200%.[*]Amount of drop items from monsters in IF dungeons has been increased to 200%.[*]Number of clear rewards of IF dungeons has been increased to 200%.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h1][b]Character Skill Balance[/b]
[/h1]

Here are the details of the changes that will be applied during the [b]September 8th[/b] patch update.

This skill balance development aims for the convenience of every agent. We look forward for you to enjoy these updates!

[h2][b]Common[/b][/h2]

[b](Passive Skill)[/b][/td][td]1. All armor type damage increase option will be removed.
2. Physical/Psi Power will increase by +10 per skill level. (Skill Lv.10 – Physical/Psi Power +100)
3. Physical/Psi Crit Damage Bonus will increase by +2% per skill level (Skill Lv.10 – Physical/Psi Crit Damage Bonus +20%)

3. The attack range of (Additional Bombing) / (Grab Fail – Bombing) / (Point Blank) will be increased.

The attack range of (Fire Damage) will be increased.[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Special Move: Sword Meteor[/b][/td][td]1. The description about (Special Move: Sword Meteor) skill will be added to Advanced skill.

“I was just a single star, but as for you, I hope you become someone who can embrace countless stars.”

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered
notes.content:
[h1][b]Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered[/b][/h1]

Hello Agents! 

Thank you for patiently waiting for the responses of our Developers. As we have announced on [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210727-qa-with-the-closers-world-devs/][b]Q&A with the Closers World Devs![/b][/url], please know that we have compiled the most common concerns and topics with the highest emote votes in the Discord channel. 

Below in this webpage, you will see the topic, your questions, and the answers of the Dev! We sincerely appreciate your unending support!


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Content Gap between Korea server and World Server/Roadmap[/b][/h3]

[h3][h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3][/h3]
[list][*]Can you close the content gap between Global Server and KR?[/*][*]Is it possible to decrease the amount of time of content updates in KR to global?[/*][*]Is there any chance we get a roadmap?[/*][*]Will there be a roadmap release so that the community will know what updates will happen in the future?[/*][/list][h3][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3][/h3]

The content update schedule of Closers World server is based on the stability and content consumption of players within the server. We always try our best to bring improvements and contents from the Closers Korea server that can easily be implemented in the World server. 

Some contents may take time to be launched to the World server. The more complicated the content, the more time that we need to stabilize it before adding the patch. We humbly ask for your patience while we are carefully settling the outcome of the game patch.

Also, some updates may not be feasible to the World server. All Closers servers have differences in game contents and considerably with their own server economy. If we see that the World server economy is not yet ready for a specific update, it may take time for us to decide to include it.

This August 2021, we will be announcing the Closers World Roadmap that covers updates between September 2021 to March 2022. In this arrangement, you will be able to see the plans that we optimized for the World server. We will put our best efforts to provide better contents and service for Agents who are enjoying Closers in the World server.

Please keep an eye out for updates on our website and social media pages. 


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Character Balance Patch and Patch Update[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]When will the next balance patch release?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We regularly check the character skills balance and try to adjust it where we aim for improvements in leveling. 

However, since we have 18 or more characters, it will take us for a while to set equal strength to every character considering that each of them has its own concepts and skills. 

Please know that we are mindful and cautious in terms of the skill balance, we will slowly make improvements towards a better gaming experience. 

We would like to ask your understanding that sometimes we are not able to apply a series of KR balance patch all in one patch update due to the game structure. We will try to adjust updates that we will apply in the future.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]KR Server Collaborations[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Will we have any collab event in the future like the Hatsune Miku one?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

Unfortunately, we are not allowed to provide collaborations contents outside countries included in the agreement.

We hope to provide a new collaboration for all Agents worldwide. We will work hard to grab those chances!


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Character Jump Event[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Are we likely to get more jumping events like KR?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

Please look forward to another Character Jump Event around the 2nd half of 2021!

Also, we will gradually bring great events from the KR server, and of course, independent events designed for the World server including those that we have launched until now.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]SP Gap between Teams[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
About the gap of SP between Rattus and Other Teams, will Naddic adjust the amount of SP book to make it fair for other teams (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, and Wildhuter) Thank you.
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We can’t directly confirm if we will be adjusting the amount of SP books since there are other ways to obtain skill points. However, our team will look for ways to balance the SP between the teams in Closers.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Skill Localization + Similar to KR Localization[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is there any plans for the localized terminology such as Seulbi (sylvi) and Magical (psi), etc
[/*][*]
Will J skills name stay as they’re currently or will they be changed to their KR names? Hundred Fists -> Omega 3 Rush
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We have found that there are some old skill localization errors and we have fixed it during the scheduled maintenance. We aim for a good quality localization, and we continue to look for those errors to correct them.

This is not limited to localization issues but also with other bugs that you have encounter in-game. The bug reports that we receive from Agents have helped us a lot to speed up the process to fix bugs and reducing these kinds of issues. We highly appreciate it if we could ask a bit of your time to report the bugs that you have encountered to our Customer Support ([url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url] or email: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url]).

Also, we have received several requests to change some localized words to make them similar to the original names in the KR server, especially Sylvi. We ask for your patience as we will have further discussions about this and if there will be any updates, we will make a separate announcement.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Community Page or Forums[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is it possible to add a community page within the main website where players can put up questions, suggestions, guides, free board posts as well as art page?
[/*][*]
Do you plan to have an official forums where players could post guides, discussions, and post suggestions and could receive a feedback?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We understand the importance of the forum feature to the World server community. We would like you to know that we have been preparing it, however, we are not certain when we will be able to launch it.

Rest assured that we will make an announcement once we have any updates about this feature.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Closers World Market/Cash Shop Prices[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Can the cash shop price be adjusted to fit the global culture and cater to larger audiences?
[/*][*]
Can the prices of N-Coin and events be revised to be friendlier to the majority, instead of just the heavy spenders?
[/*][*]
Can the cash shop price be adjusted to fit the global culture and cater to larger audiences?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

For the accumulative charge/washing machine purchase rewards, we ask for understanding that those are bonus items that provide additional value from your actual charges/purchase. However, we will consider adding various charge milestones and provide more reasonable bonus rewards to have a more satisfactory experience.

We will also try to design more affordable packages and sales for small spenders. We seek your understanding that it’s hard for us to lower the default pricing of the products because it can harm the market value of items. We were able to maintain the market value of items for years and not only with the shop pricing but also with the content/event rewards. In the past update, we have considered the requests from Agents who are not using USD. To make some adjustments due to concerns about the expensive exchange rate, we have changed the default pricing of the Washing Machine from 100 to 90.

We will keep on reviewing your suggestions about the shop costs and try to provide products that fit the value of your purchases.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Product Suggestions[/b][/h3]

[h3][u][b]Questions, Feedback/Suggestions[/b][/u][/h3]
[list][*]
Enhancement Buff Voucher -> Permanent Cash Shop Item.
[/*][*]
Please add old costume sets to the N-Coin shop permanently.
[/*][*]
Can Naddic bring back old costumes to the shop and not washer machine?
[/*][*]
Please add a giftable Visual Slots pack to the N-Coin Shop.
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answers[/u][/b][/h3]

Feedbacks/Suggestions that we have considered:
[list][*]We will add a year-around Enhancement Buff Voucher to the UNION Store with monthly purchase restriction.[/*][/list]
[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Black Market[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Will Private Black Market be implemented?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We have received many requests on adding the private Black Market feature that has been introduced in KR and CHN servers. At this point, no other servers have this feature due to concerns about game abuse that can occur due to the ability of players creating fake accounts.

In the World server, we cannot receive your personal information due to legal restrictions, therefore it is not possible to have a similar account creation procedure where mobile number authentication is required. For this reason, it made us difficult to introduce this feature to our server.

However, we understand your difficulties in trading without the private Black Market feature. We have been finding other ways to apply restrictions that avoids game abuse activity but still be able to enjoy this kind of feature. We will inform you within a separate announcement when we have finalized our direction.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Training Room[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is that possible that this game will have a training room?
[/*][*]
Can we get a training dummy or testing room. It could be nice to test either for PvE damage on certain entities or even just to sandbag test damage outputs.
[/*][*]
Possible training room to test out damage, and to practice rotations against certain bosses.
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We are glad to announce that we have the actual plan for the Training Room content in the future, however, we are unable to provide the exact update schedule for it. We kindly ask for your patience regarding this.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Contribution Shop[/b][/h3]

[h3][u][b]Question[/b][/u][/h3]
[list][*]
Please consider adding Elite Status, Enhancement Buff Voucher and +14 Gear Booster to the Contribution Shop.
[/*][*]
Can the price for normal phase wings in the contribution shop be decreased from 90,000 to a more reasonable and obtainable number, such as 30,000 or 40,000?
[/*][*]
Would it be possible to add transparent costume pieces to the contribution shop to make them more accessible to f2p players?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We will review and analyze the usage data of the Contribution and UMP shop first, then we will see if we could consider renewal and improvements on these features.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Craft Discount for Alts[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Alts any plans to make alts gearing be a bit less of a chore.
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We will support alts character gear farming with more events that could help them obtain gears easier than before. In this way we can gradually make it as a replacement for the craft discount system.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Revamp on New Player Game Experience + Old Character Gameplay[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Will there be a revamp of the new player experience?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We will be introducing a support system for New/Returning players in the future update. For a meantime, we will renew the current New/Returning system’s events to support that could encourage them to keep enjoying Closers with you.

As for the basic level design, especially for the old characters, we have gradually and keep on renewing the leveling of old teams since the past patch updates. There will be more revamps on old contents that are scheduled to be applied in the World server.

We apologize that old characters and content went outdated after we have introduced the new patch. We will keep on re-organizing the old characters/contents to provide a more fun and worthy gameplay experience.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Incentives for Helping Other Players[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Will there be any other beneficial implementation on some raid dungeons to be incentive for carries to help out strangers rather than the people in their crew only?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

A special buff will be provided as a benefit reward for New/Returned players and for those who are helping them. To activate it to all members, the New/Returned player and the user who helps them should be together in a squad.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Crew System/Content Improvements & Renewal[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is there a plan to revamp the Crew UI and system?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We have a development plan for the Crew Renewal system. However, since we recently focused on developments for new contents, it caused delays to finalize this feature. We truly wanted to improve the Crew content experience of our players, and this is one of our long-term missions. We kindly ask for your patience as it may take us for a while to fully apply this to Closers World server.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Squad Members Matching / iLevel Requirement[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Any plans to have a better queue or party forming system? 
[/*][*]
For some raid room settings, what if we could make it so that we can set x tcp to join
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We are currently developing an improved system for Squad matching such that players will be able to set the requirements/restrictions. Please keep an eye out for updates on our website and social media pages.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Reduce Loading Time[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Will the number of waiting for “Loading Screens” to load be decreased?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We have greatly improved the client loading speed during updates in the past couple of years. Internal research for further improvements is still on-going and it will be applied to the server gradually.

Regarding the suggestions on allowing entrance to other dungeons inside the dungeon, this kind of system is complicated to be added, but we will find other ways to reduce inconvenience due to loading.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Game Launcher without Web + Changing Default Browser of the Game Launcher[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Can you guys at least make the game default browser to something else other than I.E? And make a stand alone client pls.
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

I’m afraid to say this but currently it is difficult for us to provide an independent launcher that is not going through the website. We seek your understanding regarding this.

For the default web browser, since I.E. is outdated we are trying to change it to the default web browser that is set from your PC. We will do our best to fix it during the scheduled updates, any news about this will be announced through website notice.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Return AOS[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
(AOS) Please consider bringing back AOS
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

Unfortunately, there’s no plan to bring AOS back to the server as official content. There have not been many players who enjoyed this content when we launched it. We truly apologize if we are unable to provide a satisfactory answer regarding this. We will put our best efforts to develop contents that are better than the AOS mode.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Gear Drop Rate[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Did the EX gear drop rate really added into the game? Since no one still drop it until now[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We have checked the actual drop log of EX gears and confirmed that they currently exist in the game.

But since the amount of it is lower than expected, we will have an X3 drop rate event for EX gears from August 18th to October 6th. Hopefully more Agents could get a chance to obtain EX gears during this event.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Increase Enhancement Success Rate[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]With the increase of cap confirmed for +22 on gear, will there be anything done to address this change?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

The default enhancement rate will be greatly increased with the upcoming September 8th update. It will be similar to the update that applied to KR server last July 29th. Further information about the changes that we have made will be posted in a separate announcement post.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Housing/Gardening[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Are there going to be more items for the house and farm at a later point?
[/*][*]
Will the housing and gardening be updated?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We have plans to renew the outdated My Room exploration rewards. Please keep yourself updated by visiting our website regularly.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]User Interface[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Questions[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Will there ever be UI scaling for ultrawide resolution?
[/*][*]
Can we have a UI scaling interface?
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We are working on how we can apply UI updates to the whole system without issues. We are unable to provide an exact schedule, but it is planned to be applied to the server.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Raid Time[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]When will you add 21 hour raid opening time, arent we CLOSERS “WORLD”?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

Raid time for Beelzebub and Asmodeus will be changed to 4:10 AM – 2:00 AM, UTC (total 21 hours and 50 mins) with the August 18th update considering worldwide time zone.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Adding Difficult Content[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can we release actual difficult content?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We understand that gameplay difficulty level is important for online games, especially for RPGs like Closers online.

As we aim for this, we would like to announce that Mock Battles will be introduced to Closers World server soon. This is a chance to prove your character’s strength and your abilities. Also, the latest raid content that was updated in KR server provides a challenge mode requiring huge TCP and sophisticated control techniques to clear the stage.

Please look forward to the content Roadmap that will be announced soon for more information about the actual update schedule for these contents. We will keep working on creating challenging but worthwhile contents.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Daily Reset Time Fix[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can be daily server reset fixed? Daily buff upgrade come in several hours after daily reset & sector entry for some dungeons still I guess.[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

Please submit contact us with your client’s Log file if you find/encounter any weird time reset in-game.

Send your Support Inquiry here: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url]

Or send us an email to: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url]


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Gamepad – Quick slot[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Please allow us to configure the “Swap quick slot bar” key using Gamepad buttons (or make it enabled like LT+ RT or LB + RB). Thank you[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We will be checking this issue including the other Gamepad features as well. We will find a way to provide a better gamepad play experience for all Agents.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Patch Error / IP Ban Error[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Patcher update failed. Maintenance error. These two are common issues I see occurring with new users.
[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

If you run into patch errors, kindly provide us with details of the error that you have encountered and your current log file (CLOSERS Game Folder > Log).

We need to check the logs to find what caused it to occur. Please note that the cause of the error varies case by a case basis.

For the web login issue or known as ‘IP Error’, please submit a Support inquiry or an email and mention your IP address, once we have this, we will review it further.

Send your Support Inquiry here: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url]

Or send us an email to: [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url]


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Exclusive Content for World Server[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Do you have any plans to release custom contents for World server? Or anything that will differentiate it from other servers beyond the fatigue system to incentivize players from actually playing in this server rather than some other server like KR or JP or CN?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We will consider providing Agents a World server exclusive in-game reward.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Gameplay Guide/Mini Wiki for Players[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Will there be a mini wiki/guide (can be community sourced and dev/staff vetted) on the website?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We will be adding more informative content to our web guide step-by-step, such as a guide for gear farming.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Costume Conversion 100% at higher price[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]On other servers, Synchro fibers cost a little more NCoin, but have a 100% success rate. Can global obtain that as well? The chance of failure doesn’t seem particularly enticing for any player and even discourages them from obtaining it. Having 100% Synchro fibers would actually encourage players to buy and make signature costumes.[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

The 100% costume conversion is a feature that is exclusive in the CHN server since they are not able to trade signature/unique costumes.

We ask your understanding as we believe that the current system is better for protecting the value of items in the World server.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Emote ‘on/off’ Sound Option in Hub[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can we have a different audio option to mute music from emotes they are annoying as hell instead of having to mute all the audio or moving HUB.[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We are sorry to hear about the inconvenience. We will include a mute option for this to our future sound setting improvement development.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Regional servers such as EU[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Any chance for an EU server? Ping is an issue for some.[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We understand the concerns of users from the EU, unfortunately, we will maintain one unified server for Closers World. This is to vitalize multiplay and market trade between players within a server.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]OTP Authentication[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can we have OTP authentication?[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We will review legal restrictions related to the authentication and development cost for this. Please keep an eye out for updates on our website.


[h3]▶[b]Topic[/b]: [b]Washing Machine for each team/not all character[/b][/h3]

[h3][b][u]Question[/u][/b][/h3]
[list][*]Possible change for Bitna to only roll your Character or your Character’s Team when the costume pool is for all the members.[/*][/list][h3][b][u]Answer[/u][/b][/h3]

We will consider team Washing Machine for some of the costumes in the future.

[h1][b]Summer Events Re-cap and Update![/b][/h1]

Hello Agents,

We appreciate your feedback and suggestions. Due to your overwhelming support specifically to those who wanted the official merchandise, here are the changes that we applied and a summary to easily know how to get that!

The more raffle tickets that you have, the more chances of winning![/*][*]2021 Beach Towel Raffle Ticket will expire on September 8, 2021, at 9:00 AM UTC, but the data will be collected during the maintenance and winners will be announced on September 10th.[/*][*][b]10 lucky players[/b] will be chosen as winners![/*][/list][list][*]To know the other events that is related to the exchange ticket, visit this link:[/*] [list][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210721-summer-events-summer-festival--burnout-paradise/][b]Summer Events (Summer Festival + Burnout Paradise)[/b][/url][/*] [/list][/list]

[list][*]Create digital art, hand-drawn art, or a painting that is related to ‘Summer’ and ‘Closers’.[/*][*]Join the Closers World Discord and submit your entry to [b]#closers-summer-art-contest [/b]channel.[/*][/list][url=https://discord.com/invite/w7hShma][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png[/img][/url]
[list][*]The winners will be decided through votes! 50% will be decided by the public through Discord heart react and 50% will be based on the vote of from the Naddic Art Team.[/*][*]A total of [b]8 Winners[/b] will win a huge amount of N-coins, but the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winners will win the Closers Summer Swimsuit Beach Towel Set (Official Physical Merchandise)![/*][*][b]Warning! [/b]Once the art was proven not originally created by the participant, they will be permanently banned from any community events in the future. [/*][*]This event ends on August 16, 2021, at 12:00 AM UTC.[/*][*]Winners will be announced on August 18, 2021, and they will be contacted through Discord on the same account that they have used to participate.[/*][/list][list][*]Visit this link for more details:[/*] [list][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210721-closers-summer-fan-art-contest/][b]Closers Summer Fan Art Contest[/b][/url][/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e30ba4fc5ac9ba5fa4373f0642b5715e208f110e.png[/img]

[list][*]You are not only getting N-coins from your purchase, but you could also get rare item rewards when you reach a milestone![/*][*]All item rewards will be given based on the total amount of N-coins charged on the account during the event period. [/*][*]The [b]top 10 players[/b] will receive a 2021 Summer Swimsuit Beach Towel set![/*][*]Want to know if you are included in the Top 10 or not? On August 4th, you got only 1 chance to ask about it via [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]Support[/b][/url] inquiry until August 25t.[/*][*]As an update, we have added UMP to each milestone, and we will be adding more winners of the official merch![/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

It has come to our attention that there are two unintended tuning options that were included in the following costumes:

[list][*]2,3-star Checkered Flag Umbrella (A), (B), (C)[/*][*]2,3-star Dimension Runner Sunglasses (A), (B), (C)[/*][*]2,3-star Azure Romance Brooch (A), (B), (C)[/*][*]2,3-star Office Life Employee Card (A), (B), (C)[/*][*]2,3-star Eunha’s Moonlight Edge Necklace (A), (B), (C)[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
The unintended tuning options are the Attack Speed (%) and the Damage Bonus during Empowered State.

These tuning options will be removed from the listed costumes during the August 4th update. However, if you currently have these tuning options, it will remain as it is unless you manually change it with a tuning component.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Scheduled Temporary Maintenance – June 24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]
              
Hello Agents,

This is to inform you with the following concerns that occurred after the June 23rd update. To correct the issues that will be mentioned below, we will be having a temporary maintenance during this schedule by time zone:
[list][*]UTC: June 24, 2021 at 2:00 AM – 3:30 AM UTC[/*][*]PDT: June 23, 2021 at 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM PDT[/*][*]GMT+7: June 24, 2021 at 9:00 AM – 10:30 AM GMT+7[/*][/list]
[b]1st Concern: Content of the #8 1st Tab Chain Discount[/b]

The #8 1st Tab Chain Discount that should have a SS Guaranteed D Component: Costume appears to be providing a SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear box.

As compensation for this issue, we won’t be removing the SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear box which means that you will be getting two (2) items from the #8 1st Tab Chain Discount. Also, this will now be the default content of the #8 Chain Discount from now on.
[list][*]For players who claimed the #8 1st Tab Chain Discount from the delivery box before the temporary maintenance that will happen to the said schedule, you will be receiving an SS Guaranteed D Component: Costume to your mail. This item will be sent during the maintenance.[/*][*]For players who were not able to claim the #8 Chain Discount item from the delivery box, the item will automatically change to a x1 SS Guaranteed D Component: Costume + x1 SS Guaranteed D Component: Gear box during the maintenance.[/*][/list]
[b]2nd Concern: Cool Summer All-in-One Package[/b]

The All-in-One package should contain Normal D Component instead of SS Guaranteed D Component. We have temporarily removed the Cool Summer All-in-One Package from the store and we will update it correctly during the maintenance.

We have removed the incorrect item from users that were able to obtain it. Credits will be removed according to the amount that were already consumed. Further information about this will be explained to those who were affected in this issue.

Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[b][url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url][/b]

notes.title: Divine Battle Event Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

It has come to our attention that the schedule for the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210609-divine-battle/][b]Divine Battle Event[/b][/url] – Running Time ended earlier than the posted schedule.

We regret to inform you that the event was only scheduled for a week and we found that it is not possible for us to change the event period once it starts. We apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

Below is the schedule of the Divine Battle Event that is currently running at this time:

[table][tr][td][u][b]Running Time[/b][/u][/td][td]June 9, 2021 4:00 AM – June 16, 2021 4:00 AM (1 week)[/td][/tr][tr][td][u][b]Finale[/b][/u][/td][td]June 16, 2021 4:00 AM – June 23, 2021 4:00 AM (1 week)[/td][/tr][tr][td][u][b]Curtain Call[/b][/u][/td][td]June 23, 2021 4:00 AM – June 30, 2021 4:00 AM (1 week)[/td][/tr][/table]
To compensate this, we will be giving all agents the following items on June 23, 2021 until July 7, 2021.
[list][*]Dogra Scissors X3[/*][*]Magra Scissors X3[/*][*]D Coin X30[/*][*]Gear Booster Fuel I X30[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
Along with this, we will be extending the Finale period of the 11th Divine Battle for the next season. This can can give you enough time to earn more points during that extended period.

[b]Divine Battle 11th Duration Plan[/b]
[list][*]2 Weeks Running Time, 2 Weeks Finale, then 1 Week Curtain Call[/*][/list]
Thank you for your understanding.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Eunha Pre-Creation (Event + Starter Pack)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/789758208806b41909f79fdca930934ffb2c86d6.jpg[/img]



[i][h3]“I look at the wonders of the sky and see myself among the stars. In the dark hours before sunrise, constellations came apart and fell in burning streaks. From a full spiral, I became a galaxy.. known as Eunha”[/h3][/i]
[previewyoutube=N8M55UJA9aA;full][/previewyoutube]

Be prepared for the knife-wielding action of Eunha in Closers World!
Pre-create and join in events to have a head start.

notes.title: Seha’s Birthday
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7530d64d41092f8465e30aaa487dff8cb67c31b.png[/img]

[h1][u]Happy Birthday, Seha![/u][/h1]

Time to let your console rest, let us unwrap new games, and eat plenty of treats!

All agents will get a [b]Birthday Celebration Box[/b] containing [b]x1 Elite Status (1-Day), x10 Greater Phase Fiber, x10 Luck Stabilizer, [/b]and [b]x20 Piece of Cake![/b]
